chapters.title: Chapter 151 -151-Immortal Singularity? Mass-Produce It and Spend It Freely!
paragraphs: Sirenfolk were good—very good.
They were one of the strongest races among the myriad planes, backed by an immensely powerful heritage.
Umdi hurried over with an eager little trot, his face plastered with a flattering smile.
"My lord, I am a Guiding Emissary of the Dranor Plane. You may simply call me Umdi."
The Sirenfolk powerhouse hovered in midair and cast him a lofty glance from above.
"So you’re the guide? My clan mentor told me that everything here is arranged by you?"
Umdi nodded at once.

"Yes, yes, exactly! As expected of someone from the Sirenfolk—one of the great races of the higher worlds. You must already know the rules of the Dranor Plane. May I ask how I should address you, my lord?"
The Sirenfolk expert lifted his chin proudly.
"Nujer! Among my generation of the Sirenfolk, I crush all opposition. None can stand against me!"
The smile on Umdi’s face deepened even further.
"Just as expected of the number one Sirenfolk genius of this generation! On this journey into Heavenscar, you will surely seize first place!"
He paused, then edged a little closer.
"It is truly my honor to have encountered you, my lord. How about I first escort you back to the hall so you may rest a while?"
Nujer bared his teeth in a grin.
"Very well."
The news spread as though it had grown wings, sweeping across the entire Dranor main city in the blink of an eye.
Umdi, while on duty, had received a Sirenfolk prodigy—and not just any prodigy, but a ruthless monster at the mid-legendary grade.
The whole city erupted at once.
The Sirenfolk were one of the great races among the countless planes, a top-tier power among top-tier powers.
And for this prodigy to possess mid-legendary-grade strength made him all the more extraordinary.
The great families all pulled out the treasures they had hidden away for years, then rushed over with the most outstanding descendants of their clans in tow, eager to pay a visit.
Though Umdi had been the first to make contact with Nujer, that did not stop the other families from trying to win him over.
In truth, even before this Sirenfolk powerhouse had arrived, quite a few prodigies had already come one after another.
The major families were casting as wide a net as possible, unwilling to let even one slip through their fingers.
As long as those prodigies let a tiny bit of wealth leak from between their fingernails, it would be enough for these families to make a fortune.
And if one of those prodigies happened to take a liking to a daughter of their clan and leave behind a bloodline, that would be even more perfect.
For a time, Umdi’s home became the most closely watched place in the entire city.
And that Sirenfolk powerhouse, Nujer, became the one and only center of attention that day.
Polaris Zone, Imperial City of the Empire.
[Notice: You have used "Replica Crystal" and successfully obtained "Fragment of the Immortal Singularity" ×10,000!]
[Notice: You have used "Replica Crystal" and successfully obtained "Fragment of the Immortal Singularity" ×10,000!]
[Notice: You have used "Replica Crystal" and successfully obtained "Fragment of the Immortal Singularity" ×10,000!]
Daniel looked at the mountain-like pile of Fragment of the Immortal Singularity before him, the corner of his lips curling upward slightly.
This time, he had replicated a total of ninety thousand fragments.
When fused together, those fragments could condense into eighteen hundred points of Immortal Singularity.
Heavenscar was a place where prodigies of all races fought for supremacy. Every opponent there would be an incomparably powerful genius of the highest order.
Without thorough preparation, going there would be no different from courting death.
And Daniel’s preparation was simple: stockpile more Immortal Singularity.
This substance had another name as well—divine matter.
Legendary-grade powerhouses could slowly refine it through their own godhood. Aside from that, the only other way to obtain it was by fusing fragments together.
A low-tier legendary-grade expert would refine no more than five hundred points of Immortal Singularity in an entire lifetime.
A mid-tier one, no more than eight hundred.
A high-tier one, no more than one thousand.
As for the transcendent ones, they generally possessed more than a thousand.
Daniel still could not fuse with a godhood himself. That would have to wait until he reached a higher level of reincarnation.
So for now, he could only synthesize Immortal Singularity through fragments, which was essentially exploiting a loophole.
Of course, things obtained through external means were much more wasteful to use.
For example, if a legendary-grade powerhouse only needed five hundred points to break a powerful crowd-control effect, he would need to spend a thousand.
Fortunately, Daniel had Replica Crystals and could obtain Immortal Singularity in massive quantities.
He could practically use Immortal Singularity wholesale.
This time alone, he had stockpiled eighteen hundred points of it—comparable to the entire reserves of a transcendent legendary-grade powerhouse.
And as long as he wanted to, he could replicate even more at any moment.
Daniel sorted through his backpack one last time. Only after confirming that everything was in order did he give a brief word to the powerhouses under his command.
At present, Polaris Zone only had one hostile force left: the Undead Cataclysm.
And even that had been deliberately preserved by him as training material for the players.
If he wanted to wipe it out, he could destroy the Undead Cataclysm’s passageway at any time.
But on second thought, slaughtering them all was not as useful as penning them up and letting the players of Polaris Zone farm EXP and equipment from them.
All in all, every possible source of future trouble had now been thoroughly eliminated.
He drew in a deep breath and took out a thick stack of Heavenscar Passes.
Flash!
A stream of golden light swallowed his entire body.
Whoosh—!
[Ding! You have discovered the "Dranor Plane"! Contribution Points +500,000!]
Daniel appeared within an ancient magic array.
He glanced around and found that he was standing inside a magnificent palace, with towering stone pillars and a vaulted ceiling painted with murals of revolving stars.
"Dranor Plane?"
He frowned slightly. So he had not been sent directly to Heavenscar after all.
In his imagination, it had been some place akin to an arena.
At that moment, a young man walked toward him.
A line of text floated above the man’s head:
[Guiding Emissary · Liam]
Liam quickly stepped forward and said respectfully, "Honored lord, I am Guiding Emissary Liam, responsible for receiving prodigies from other worlds. May I ask how I should address you?"
Daniel suddenly understood.
This Guiding Emissary was probably the equivalent of a beginner’s guide.
"Faustus," he said flatly.
Liam bowed at once.
"Lord Faustus, welcome to the Dranor Plane."
He paused, then continued, "Please allow me to explain the rules of Heavenscar."
Daniel nodded.
Liam began, "Heavenscar is located within Dranor main city. To enter Heavenscar, one needs one hundred tickets."
"You may gather one hundred together with other prodigies from foreign worlds, which is more cost-effective; or you may consume one hundred tickets on your own and enter alone."
As he said this, he glanced at Daniel.
Daniel thought to himself, I already have more than a hundred tickets myself. There’s no need to split with anyone else.
He signaled for Liam to continue.
Liam went on, "Once inside Heavenscar, whether you live or die is uncertain. The trials within are ever-changing, and only after entering can one learn the specifics."
"If you wish to leave Heavenscar and return to your original world, you need only come back to the magic array here."
Daniel understood.
"Where is Heavenscar?"
Liam offered him a parchment map with both hands.
"Heavenscar changes location every day, but with this map, you can track the place where it appears."
Daniel accepted the map.
[Ding! You have obtained the special item "Heavenscar Tracking Map (Rare · Unique)"!]
He unfolded the map. On it, a point of light flickered somewhere, shaped like a round mirror.
"It’s here."
Daniel put away the map and stepped forward.
[Flash].
Whoosh—!
His figure vanished from the spot in an instant.

chapters.title: Chapter 152 -152-Cannon Fodder for Heavenscar
paragraphs: Whoosh—!
The magic array at the reception point suddenly lit up.
Liam was dumbfounded.
Was the array broken or something?
Faustus had only just left—how was another one already here?
At that moment, a young man stepped out of the magic array.
The instant the youth planted one foot outside the formation—
Boom!
The entire Hall of Guidance shook violently!
Liam felt the world spin around him as the tremor knocked him flat onto the ground.
Then, immediately after that, an utterly terrifying aura spread outward from the boy’s body.
Pop! Pop! Pop—!
Bang! Bang! Bang—!
Countless porcelain vessels and ceremonial objects throughout the hall could not withstand the pressure of that aura and exploded one after another.
Liam’s eyes widened, and his breathing turned ragged.
"Th-This... what realm is this? I’ve never encountered such a terrifying presence in my life!"
The boy’s expression changed abruptly. He quickly pulled his foot back and let out an awkward laugh, muttering under his breath.
"Oops. Forgot to hold back a little..."
In the blink of an eye, that horrifying pressure vanished completely.
The boy walked over to Liam, squatted down in front of him, and asked with a cheerful grin,
"You’re the guide, right? Have you seen anyone from the Starlight Folk?"
"The Starlight Folk?"
Liam’s mind spun rapidly, and he suddenly remembered that a prodigy from the Starlight Folk really had come by a few days ago.
He hurriedly nodded.
"Yes, yes, yes... but he’s already entered Heavenscar."
The boy flashed a wide grin.
His body gradually turned transparent, then disappeared completely.
Liam wiped the cold sweat from his forehead and remained frozen there for a long while, unable even to get back to his feet.
"Too terrifying... far too terrifying..."
"Just which supreme race did that prodigy come from?"
Following the markers on the map, Daniel found the entrance to Heavenscar.
When he looked up, he saw a gigantic mirror of irregular shape suspended in the sky, its surface reflecting a firmament full of stars and a sea of rolling clouds.
He flew over and pressed his hand against it.
[Ding! Do you wish to enter "Heavenscar"? Entry requires one hundred tickets.]
"Yes."
[Ding! You have entered "Heavenscar"! Detection complete: you possess 8 Fortune Points. Please assign your Fortune Points to a faction.]
A new interface immediately appeared before Daniel’s eyes—the faction selection screen for Heavenscar.
There were only two options on it:
[Holy Faction] (highlighted): No Fortune Point requirement.
[Empyrean Faction] (grayed out): Requires more than 20 Fortune Points.
Daniel considered it for a moment.
"Two factions. One has no requirement, while the other needs 20 Fortune Points..."
He only had 8 Fortune Points on him, so the Holy Faction was his only choice.
Following the prompt, he invested all 8 of his Fortune Points into it.
[Ding! The "Fortune Point Rankings" have been unlocked! You may now view the Fortune Points of participants there.]
[Notice: Your mission has been updated.]
Daniel checked the mission first.
The faction interface before him shifted into Heavenscar’s mission panel.
[Mission]: Eliminate the [Empyrean Faction]!
[Accept] [Decline]
Daniel did not hesitate.
Since he had already chosen a faction, there was no way he would decline.
[Ding! You have accepted the mission "Eliminate the Empyrean Faction."]
[Notice: The map of "Heavenscar" has been unlocked.]
Daniel opened the Fortune Point Rankings.
[Fortune Point Rankings]
Rank 1: Hailis; [Starlight Folk]; Fortune Points: 21.2 million
Rank 2: Kahn; [Divine Race]; Fortune Points: 10 million
Rank 3: Magna; [Nether Race]; Fortune Points: 9.89 million
Rank 100: Faustus; [Human Race]; Fortune Points: 8

[Note: Failing a mission will cause Fortune Points to go negative; completing missions grants Fortune Points. Every time a race’s Fortune Points exceed 10, 100, 1,000... that race will receive a reward. Every time they drop below -10, -100, -1,000... that race will suffer a punishment.]
After reading the rankings, Daniel was completely speechless.
The Human Race had only 8 Fortune Points. Compared with the other races, it looked pitifully shabby.
"So this is basically using a race’s Fortune Points as gambling chips?"
he muttered. "And now that I’m in, there’s no backing out."
He shook his head and opened the map of Heavenscar.
The map marked things with perfect clarity—the territories of the Holy Kingdom and the Empyrean Kingdom were immediately distinguishable.
He glanced over it, failed to glean much from a quick look, and directly opened the mission interface instead.
[Eliminate the Empyrean Faction] (Heavenscar)
Mission Objectives:
Repel the Empyrean Faction’s assault — Reward: 10 Fortune Points
Maintain the Holy Faction’s rule — Reward: 20 Fortune Points
Completely eradicate the Empyrean Faction — Reward: 50 Fortune Points
Special: The reward threshold for this mission is 30 points. If the Fortune Point reward you obtain exceeds 30, it will definitely trigger an [Advanced Mission], and the difficulty will double.
Mission Description:

The Holy Kingdom and eighteen duchies jointly govern this land. But the newly enthroned king has tormented the kingdom’s people until their lives have become unbearable. Seizing the opportunity, the Empyrean Kingdom has risen in rebellion under the banner of overthrowing the Holy Kingdom’s tyranny. For a time, the people of the Holy Kingdom have responded in droves, many duchies have defected, and countless powerhouses have flocked to their side...
Mission Duration: Until either the Holy Kingdom or the Empyrean side is completely annihilated.
After reading the mission details, Daniel’s expression changed slightly.
"So the Holy Faction are the villains... and the Empyrean Faction are the righteous side."
He shook his head with a bitter smile.
No wonder the Holy Faction had no entry requirement...
The difficulty of joining them and actually completing the mission was absurdly high.
On the other hand, joining the Empyrean Faction might practically guarantee an effortless win, which was why the Fortune Point requirement was so high.
Daniel understood now.
Probably only people from weaker races like his had no choice but to join the Holy Faction.
As for those dominant races that strode across the countless worlds of the universe, they had all gone to the Empyrean Faction.
To put it bluntly, the weaker races were nothing more than sparring partners and disposable props for the great races to amuse themselves with in Heavenscar.
At that thought, a vicious glint flashed through Daniel’s eyes.
He closed the interface and pondered for a moment.
Judging from the map, the Empyrean Kingdom was already devouring the Holy Kingdom’s territory.
At this rate, it would not be long before they reached the Imperial City itself.
In other words, the Holy Kingdom was on the verge of collapse.
But before long, he had already figured out what he should do.
Following the directions on the map, he flew toward the Imperial City of the Holy Kingdom.
Holy Kingdom, Imperial City.
The king of the Holy Kingdom was holding a grand banquet, entertaining his ministers.
Fine wine and exquisite dishes were everywhere, while songs and dances filled the air.
Servants moved in long lines, carrying delicacies from the mountains and the seas in and out without pause.
Hovering above the royal palace, Daniel frowned at the scene below.
"No wonder the Holy Kingdom ended up in this state."
Shaking his head, he descended directly into the palace hall.
The instant he appeared, the guards in the palace were alarmed.
Clang! Clang—!
The guards drew their swords and pointed them straight at Daniel.
"Who are you? How dare you trespass into the royal palace!"
Daniel did not even spare them a glance. His cold gaze swept across the great hall before quickly locking onto the king of the Holy Kingdom seated above.
"I’m here for your king."
"Insolence!"
"Where did this lowborn wretch come from, daring to disrespect His Majesty!"
"Seize this peasant and throw him into the dungeon!"
The guards were furious, shouting one after another.
"Ahem..."
At that moment, the king of the Holy Kingdom cleared his throat and cast Daniel a haughty glance.
"So many powerhouses are scrambling to join my faction, yet none of them are as arrogant as you... Still, I will not stoop to the level of a lowborn cur like you."
"But if you fail to show any real ability, I will not spare you!"
The moment he finished speaking, the ministers immediately began showering him with flattery.
"Your Majesty’s breadth of mind is as vast as the sea itself—a truly sage king!"
"His Majesty’s bearing is extraordinary, truly worthy of being a great ruler of an age!"
"This is what a true king looks like! With a sovereign such as you, the Holy Kingdom is certain to shine for all eternity!"

No wonder the Holy Faction had no entry requirement...
The difficulty of joining them and actually completing the mission was absurdly high.
On the other hand, joining the Empyrean Faction might practically guarantee an effortless win, which was why the Fortune Point requirement was so high.
Daniel understood now.
Probably only people from weaker races like his had no choice but to join the Holy Faction.
As for those dominant races that strode across the countless worlds of the universe, they had all gone to the Empyrean Faction.
To put it bluntly, the weaker races were nothing more than sparring partners and disposable props for the great races to amuse themselves with in Heavenscar.
At that thought, a vicious glint flashed through Daniel’s eyes.
He closed the interface and pondered for a moment.
Judging from the map, the Empyrean Kingdom was already devouring the Holy Kingdom’s territory.
At this rate, it would not be long before they reached the Imperial City itself.
In other words, the Holy Kingdom was on the verge of collapse.
But before long, he had already figured out what he should do.
Following the directions on the map, he flew toward the Imperial City of the Holy Kingdom.
Holy Kingdom, Imperial City.
The king of the Holy Kingdom was holding a grand banquet, entertaining his ministers.
Fine wine and exquisite dishes were everywhere, while songs and dances filled the air.
Servants moved in long lines, carrying delicacies from the mountains and the seas in and out without pause.
Hovering above the royal palace, Daniel frowned at the scene below.
"No wonder the Holy Kingdom ended up in this state."
Shaking his head, he descended directly into the palace hall.
The instant he appeared, the guards in the palace were alarmed.
Clang!
Clang—!
The guards drew their swords and pointed them straight at Daniel.
"Who are you?
How dare you trespass into the royal palace!"
Daniel did not even spare them a glance.
His cold gaze swept across the great hall before quickly locking onto the king of the Holy Kingdom seated above.
"I’m here for your king."
"Insolence!"
"Where did this lowborn wretch come from, daring to disrespect His Majesty!"
"Seize this peasant and throw him into the dungeon!"
The guards were furious, shouting one after another.
"Ahem..."
At that moment, the king of the Holy Kingdom cleared his throat and cast Daniel a haughty glance.
"So many powerhouses are scrambling to join my faction, yet none of them are as arrogant as you...
Still, I will not stoop to the level of a lowborn cur like you."
"But if you fail to show any real ability, I will not spare you!"
The moment he finished speaking, the ministers immediately began showering him with flattery.
"Your Majesty’s breadth of mind is as vast as the sea itself—a truly sage king!"
"His Majesty’s bearing is extraordinary, truly worthy of being a great ruler of an age!"
"This is what a true king looks like!
With a sovereign such as you, the Holy Kingdom is certain to shine for all eternity!"

chapters.title: Chapter 153 -153-Where Is My Treasury?
paragraphs: Listening to this crowd heap flattery upon flattery, Daniel felt a wave of disgust rise in his chest.
He walked forward directly. "You want to see what I can do? Fine. But I do have to wonder how much wealth you actually possess."
"Pfft... Hahaha!"
The king burst into laughter the moment he heard that.
"I sit atop an entire kingdom! The rare treasures in my royal treasury are beyond counting!"
His tone dripped with pride. "If I so wished, I could pave the entire Imperial City with treasure!"
Daniel’s eyes lit up.
Raising Stellar Wrath, he smiled. "So you really are rich."
The king sneered. "Of course. I could casually take out a tiny fraction of my treasures and crush you to death with them."
Daniel bared his teeth in a savage grin and swung Stellar Wrath.
"Then I’d very much like to see that."
[Skyfall Strike]!
[Permafrost Prison]!
[Thunder Abyss]!
Apocalyptic forbidden spells erupted into existence, blanketing the entire royal palace in the blink of an eye!
"Enemy attack!"
"The Royal Guard! Protect His Majesty at once! Protect the king!"
"This man really is an assassin! What are you useless guards even doing?!"
The elite royal protectors at the king’s side—those transcendent legendary-grade experts—felt that aura of absolute destruction and their expressions changed drastically.
Never in their wildest dreams had they imagined that someone would actually dare strike at the king—the very ruler of the kingdom!
Several Transcendent Peak powerhouses moved at once to shield the king, intending to spirit him away.
Daniel coldly threw out a single sentence:
"You idiots aren’t going anywhere."
Without another word, he directly poured one thousand points of Immortal Singularity into his skills.
[Wind’s Embrace]!
With that thousand points of Immortal Singularity reinforcing it, this restraining skill became absurdly powerful.
Even if those Transcendent Peak guards wanted to break through it, they simply did not have enough Immortal Singularity to pour into the attempt.
At this moment, this move was a dead end.
The Transcendent Peak experts could do nothing but stare helplessly as meteor-like rain of fire smashed the entire palace into the ground.
Countless kingdom powerhouses died on the spot.
[Ding! You have killed the transcendent legendary-grade expert "Cassius"! Obtained gold coins +950,000! Obtained "Blade of the Holy Kingdom (legendary-grade)"!]
[Ding! You have killed the transcendent legendary-grade expert "Wangor"! Obtained gold coins +910,000! Obtained "Guardian Shield of the Holy Kingdom (legendary-grade)"!]
[Ding! You have killed the transcendent legendary-grade expert "Chester"! Obtained gold coins +980,000! Obtained "Silver Armor of the Holy Kingdom (legendary-grade)"!]
Roar—!
At that very moment, a layer of earthen-yellow light suddenly burst forth from the Holy Kingdom’s king, wrapping his entire body tightly within it.
But as the forbidden spells continued their relentless destruction, that yellow radiance grew thinner and thinner.
Daniel swept his gaze across the ruins. Aside from the king, not a single living soul remained in the palace.
Only then did he stop.
The forbidden spells ceased.
By now, the Holy Kingdom’s king was pale as paper.
A ruler of an entire nation—yet at this moment of life and death, he had been frightened nearly out of his wits.
Daniel stared at him and asked in an unhurried tone,
"So... where is my treasury?"
The Holy Kingdom’s king froze.
Wait—what?
That was his treasury. Since when had it become Daniel’s?!
But the moment he looked into Daniel’s cold, expressionless face, he understood instantly.
The only reason he was still alive had nothing to do with national fortune protecting his body.
It was simply because Daniel had chosen to spare him.
Hands trembling, the king fumbled a key out of his robes and threw it toward Daniel.
"It... it’s inside the palace. That’s the key."
Daniel’s gaze locked onto the key.
[Flash]!
He appeared at the spot where it was about to land and caught it firmly in his hand.
In that brief instant, the Holy Kingdom’s king used some unknown secret art and vanished with a whoosh.
It was hardly surprising that the ruler of an entire kingdom had a few life-saving methods hidden away.
Daniel did not care in the slightest.
After all, the mission had made it perfectly clear: his target was the Empyrean Faction. It had never specified how he was supposed to treat the Holy Faction.
He was certain that most people who received this mission would obediently join the Holy Faction and sell their lives for the king.
But he would not.
As long as one had enough strength, what did a king amount to?
Rules were made for the weak.
The strong could not only ignore rules—they could personally rewrite them.
Just like now.
So what if he killed the king of the Holy Kingdom?
Would the Holy Kingdom collapse immediately?
If it would not, then he might as well devour the Holy Kingdom’s wealth first, then slowly have his fun with the Empyrean Faction.
The Holy Kingdom’s treasury really was inside the palace.
The entire palace had been plowed over again and again by forbidden spells, leaving ruins and broken walls everywhere.
And yet this place alone still retained a stretch of relatively intact structures.
With the key in hand, Daniel opened the doors to the Holy Kingdom’s royal treasury.
Rumble—!
The moment the doors swung open, he froze.
Everywhere he looked, dazzling treasures were piled up like mountains, too many to count.
There were countless things inside that even he had never seen before.
Daniel did not stand on ceremony.
He looted the entire treasury clean.
[Ding! You successfully sold "Origin Stone" to "Doom Guild," triggering Millionfold Boost. Obtained gold coins +1! Obtained "Astral Origin Crystal (supreme-grade)" ×1,000,000!]
[Ding! You successfully sold "Sword of the Holy Kingdom" to "Doom Guild," triggering Millionfold Boost. Obtained gold coins +1! Obtained "Blade of Sacred Edict (supreme-grade)"!]
[Ding! You obtained "Endless Star Chart (Divine-grade · Sealed)" ×1!]
[Ding! You obtained "Astral Portal (Divine-grade · Sealed)" ×1!]
[Ding! You obtained "Egg of the Star Behemoth (Divine-grade · Sealed)" ×1!]
[Ding! You obtained "Spatial Expansion Magic Array (Divine-grade · Sealed)" ×1!]
[Ding! You obtained "Time Reversal Magic Array (Divine-grade · Sealed)" ×1!]
The flood of system notifications exploding in his ears like a tidal wave filled Daniel with delight.
Divine-grade!
A quality above even supreme-grade—Divine-grade!
Divine-grade treasures were the very pinnacle of all items!
In all his previous lives, he had only ever heard of such a rank. Yet today, his backpack had been stuffed full of them!
One had to remember—this was an otherworldly plane, unrestricted by the game version.
Theoretically, treasures of any rank could appear here.
So obtaining Divine-grade items was not strange at all.
But in the Stellar World Zone, such a thing would have been utterly unimaginable!
Under normal circumstances, even supreme-grade items were already objects of desperate yearning beyond the reach of countless players.
At that moment, another system notification suddenly rang out!

[Heavenscar Announcement: The Human Race’s "Faustus" has bathed the Holy Kingdom’s royal palace in blood and attempted to assassinate the Holy Kingdom’s king! The king of the Holy Kingdom has now issued a royal decree declaring the Human Race’s Faustus the eternal enemy of the Holy Kingdom—from this day onward, all Holy Kingdom powerhouses shall kill him on sight!]
[Heavenscar Announcement: The Human Race’s "Faustus," mighty beyond measure, has destroyed the Imperial City of the Holy Kingdom! Special reward granted: Title "Extreme Assassin (supreme-grade)"!]
Listening to the announcements ringing in his ears, a faint smile slowly rose on Daniel’s lips.

chapters.title: Chapter 154 -154-Did He Blow Up His Own Headquarters?
paragraphs: [Ding! You have completed the branch objective "Starlit" for the class change quest "Human Starlight"! Current quest progress: 1/3.]
[Starlit: Successfully obtain a supreme-grade title in Heavenscar!]
Daniel looked at the title he had just earned.
[Ultimate Assassin (Supreme-grade)]
Effect: While this title is equipped, you may deploy Hunting Domain within a 3000 x 3000 area.
[Hunting Domain (Active)]: Reduces all attributes of designated targets, whether single or multiple, by 10%.
[Hunting Domain (Passive)]: For every 20% HP lost, your Attack Power increases by 20%.
Description: A god of slaughter who walks among mountains of corpses and seas of blood—an existence feared by all enemies.
After reading it, the smile on Daniel’s face grew even brighter.
As expected of a supreme-grade title.
Its effects were overpowered and tyrannical.
He immediately equipped it.
[Ding! You have equipped the title "Ultimate Assassin"!]
This class change quest required him to complete three stages of objectives.
Starlit was already done. What remained now was to obtain the achievement "Supreme-grade Heavenly Wrath" and to reach the summit of Cloudcrest Peak!
Daniel then began sorting through the spoils from this trip.
There were indeed quite a few Divine-grade treasures, but unfortunately, every single one of them was sealed.
He casually took one out.
[Endless Star Chart (Divine-grade · Sealed)]
Use: Records the locations of the major star realms and star regions within the Endless Starfield, and marks the territories and strongholds of the various factions scattered across the cosmos.
Status: Sealed.
After reading it, Daniel suddenly felt enlightened.
This was a map of the starry universe!
Not only did it include star realms and star regions, it even clearly marked the various factions spread throughout the Endless Starfield.
It was also the first time he had realized just how vast the structure of this world truly was.
"Star realms... star regions..."
He could not help but sigh in wonder.
In all his past lives, every player had been too busy resisting one catastrophe after another. None of them had ever had the chance to step beyond Earth.
But now, he stood at the very peak of the player base and at the forefront of the game itself.
Perhaps one day, he really would leave this planet and witness that far more distant sea of stars for himself.
He lowered his gaze to the Star Chart in his hand. If he ever intended to venture into the Endless Starfield in the future, this map would be the foundation of everything.
Unfortunately, it was still sealed for the time being.
He tapped open the seal information, and a line of annotation appeared.
[Sealed]: This item has been locked by a mysterious power. To unseal it, one must use a special item or possess strength at the peak of the supreme-grade realm.
A flicker passed through Daniel’s eyes.
He stored the Star Chart in his inventory and did not bother inspecting the other Divine-grade items any further.
Since they were all sealed anyway, none of them would be of immediate use.
Still, as long as he could obtain a special item for unsealing, or enlist the help of a peak supreme-grade powerhouse, breaking those seals would not be difficult.
Then he suddenly recalled the final reward for this class change quest—the Version Unlock Scroll!
In other words, once he completed this quest, a new game version would open.
By then, the shackles limiting the world’s strength level would be broken, and supreme-grade experts would finally appear in the world.
When that time came, dealing with these sealed treasures would be easy!
He then glanced over the rest of the loot.
There were very few Divine-grade items, and not many supreme-grade ones either. Most were just equipment or universal cosmic currency, with only a handful that were truly useful.
There were, however, mountains of legendary-grade items...
All kinds of building blueprints, tools, treasures, and companion eggs were included, though most of them were beneath his notice.
As for items below legendary-grade, they made up more than ninety percent of the total.

He gave them only a rough glance before losing interest. He planned to toss them into the chain stores, guild storage, or legion warehouse after he returned, and let the players of World Zone 616 and the Polaris Region purchase whatever they wanted.
Heavenscar, Empyrean Kingdom faction.
At that moment, countless powerhouses felt an inexplicable jolt in their hearts.
Almost at the same instant, they all turned to look in the direction of the Holy Kingdom Imperial City, where a terrifying surge of destructive power had briefly erupted moments earlier.
The intensity of that force was absolutely no weaker than the full-force strike of a high legendary-grade expert.
If that had been all, it would not have been too shocking.
What Otherworldly Prodigy did not have a few trump cards hidden away?
Without methods that surpassed their peers, how could they suppress an entire generation, or even stand proudly at the summit of the myriad worlds?
What truly stunned everyone was where the incident had taken place.
That was the very core of the Holy Kingdom—the most heavily guarded forbidden ground of all.
Who would dare run wild there?
Any strong expert from the Empyrean Faction would be detected the moment they approached the palace.

And within the palace itself, not only were there numerous Transcendent legendary-grade powerhouses stationed there, but layers upon layers of forbidden magical arrays had also been laid down. Even supreme-grade experts would not dare act recklessly there.
Unless the one who made the move was an Otherworldly Prodigy of the Holy Faction.
Because members of the same faction naturally would not be guarded against too heavily.
But when they thought about it again, all the experts felt that something was wrong.
Why would a prodigy of the Holy Faction destroy their own base camp?
That made no sense at all!
Shouldn’t the normal script have been this: gain the Holy Kingdom king’s favor, receive an official title, and then lead troops to crusade against the Empyrean Faction?
The Otherworldly Prodigies racked their brains and still could not make sense of it.
Right then, a sudden announcement exploded across Heavenscar.

[Heavenscar Announcement: Human "Faustus" has bathed the Holy Kingdom palace in blood and assassinated the King of the Holy Kingdom! The King of the Holy Kingdom has issued a royal decree declaring the human Faustus the eternal enemy of the Holy Kingdom. All people under heaven may kill him!]
[Heavenscar Announcement: The human "Faustus" has displayed monstrous ferocity and obtained the title "Ultimate Assassin (Supreme-grade)"!]
Boom—!
All of the Otherworldly Prodigies in the Empyrean Faction were left dumbfounded.
What kind of joke was this?!
There really was an Otherworldly Prodigy who dared make a move inside the Holy Kingdom palace?
Not only had he attacked, he had even destroyed the palace and assassinated the king... Was this man insane?
"Faustus? Isn’t that the human guy at the very bottom of the Fortune Points rankings?"
Some prodigies of the non-human races, who often kept track of changes on the rankings, immediately recalled Daniel’s name.
At first, they had assumed he was just some cannon-fodder nobody.
So what if he was a human prodigy?
In front of the prodigies of truly great worlds and powerful races, these so-called geniuses from backwater places were worth nothing at all.
At best, they were only somewhat stronger than ordinary people in talent and Fortune Points.
But this Faustus seemed... different.
Was he really this ferocious?

He had only just entered Heavenscar, yet he was already stirring up chaos—and not just ordinary chaos, but a disaster big enough to tear the sky open. Slaughtering the palace, assassinating the king... He was completely deranged!
"Faustus... Could he be a spy planted by our Empyrean Faction?"
Some of the Empyrean Faction’s prodigies were utterly bewildered.
And the prodigies of the Holy Faction were even more confused.
"What the hell is going on? Who is this Faustus?"
"The palace has been destroyed—doesn’t that mean our nest has basically been uprooted? How is the Holy Faction supposed to keep playing now?"
"Damn it! Faustus, just let me run into you—I’ll kill you for sure. Wait... which faction is he from?"
"He should be from the Empyrean Faction, right? Otherwise why would he target the Holy Kingdom?"
"Or maybe he’s from the Holy Faction. Otherwise, how could he have even entered the palace?"
"Hiss—Is there something wrong with his brain? If he’s from the Holy Faction, why would he assassinate his own king? What kind of twisted mind does that take?"

He planned to toss them into the chain stores, guild storage, or legion warehouse after he returned, and let the players of World Zone 616 and the Polaris Region purchase whatever they wanted.
Heavenscar, Empyrean Kingdom faction.
At that moment, countless powerhouses felt an inexplicable jolt in their hearts.
Almost at the same instant, they all turned to look in the direction of the Holy Kingdom Imperial City, where a terrifying surge of destructive power had briefly erupted moments earlier.
The intensity of that force was absolutely no weaker than the full-force strike of a high legendary-grade expert.
If that had been all, it would not have been too shocking.
What Otherworldly Prodigy did not have a few trump cards hidden away?
Without methods that surpassed their peers, how could they suppress an entire generation, or even stand proudly at the summit of the myriad worlds?
What truly stunned everyone was where the incident had taken place.
That was the very core of the Holy Kingdom—the most heavily guarded forbidden ground of all.
Who would dare run wild there?
Any strong expert from the Empyrean Faction would be detected the moment they approached the palace.
And within the palace itself, not only were there numerous Transcendent legendary-grade powerhouses stationed there, but layers upon layers of forbidden magical arrays had also been laid down.
Even supreme-grade experts would not dare act recklessly there.
Unless the one who made the move was an Otherworldly Prodigy of the Holy Faction.
Because members of the same faction naturally would not be guarded against too heavily.
But when they thought about it again, all the experts felt that something was wrong.
Why would a prodigy of the Holy Faction destroy their own base camp?
That made no sense at all!
Shouldn’t the normal script have been this: gain the Holy Kingdom king’s favor, receive an official title, and then lead troops to crusade against the Empyrean Faction?
The Otherworldly Prodigies racked their brains and still could not make sense of it.
Right then, a sudden announcement exploded across Heavenscar.
[Heavenscar Announcement: Human "Faustus" has bathed the Holy Kingdom palace in blood and assassinated the King of the Holy Kingdom!
The King of the Holy Kingdom has issued a royal decree declaring the human Faustus the eternal enemy of the Holy Kingdom.
All people under heaven may kill him!]
[Heavenscar Announcement: The human "Faustus" has displayed monstrous ferocity and obtained the title "Ultimate Assassin (Supreme-grade)"!]
Boom—!
All of the Otherworldly Prodigies in the Empyrean Faction were left dumbfounded.
What kind of joke was this?!
There really was an Otherworldly Prodigy who dared make a move inside the Holy Kingdom palace?
Not only had he attacked, he had even destroyed the palace and assassinated the king...
Was this man insane?
"Faustus?
Isn’t that the human guy at the very bottom of the Fortune Points rankings?"
Some prodigies of the non-human races, who often kept track of changes on the rankings, immediately recalled Daniel’s name.
At first, they had assumed he was just some cannon-fodder nobody.
So what if he was a human prodigy?
In front of the prodigies of truly great worlds and powerful races, these so-called geniuses from backwater places were worth nothing at all.
At best, they were only somewhat stronger than ordinary people in talent and Fortune Points.
But this Faustus seemed... different.
Was he really this ferocious?
He had only just entered Heavenscar, yet he was already stirring up chaos—and not just ordinary chaos, but a disaster big enough to tear the sky open.
Slaughtering the palace, assassinating the king...
He was completely deranged!
"Faustus...
Could he be a spy planted by our Empyrean Faction?"
Some of the Empyrean Faction’s prodigies were utterly bewildered.
And the prodigies of the Holy Faction were even more confused.
"What the hell is going on?
Who is this Faustus?"
"The palace has been destroyed—doesn’t that mean our nest has basically been uprooted?
How is the Holy Faction supposed to keep playing now?"
"Damn it!
Faustus, just let me run into you—I’ll kill you for sure.
Wait... which faction is he from?"
"He should be from the Empyrean Faction, right?
Otherwise why would he target the Holy Kingdom?"
"Or maybe he’s from the Holy Faction.
Otherwise, how could he have even entered the palace?"
"Hiss—Is there something wrong with his brain?
If he’s from the Holy Faction, why would he assassinate his own king?
What kind of twisted mind does that take?"

chapters.title: Chapter 155 -155-A Low Legendary Instantly Kills a High-grade!
paragraphs: Somewhere in Heavenscar.
A young man was hurrying along when he suddenly stopped and looked toward the Holy Kingdom Palace in surprise.
"The power of a forbidden spell?"
He muttered in astonishment, "This trip to Heavenscar is turning out to be pretty interesting."
He smiled.

"There’s someone at the supreme-grade level pretending to be a minor character, a prodigy from the Starlight Folk—the number one race of the Endless Starfield—and now there’s this human who refuses to play by the usual rules..."
"Tsk, tsk. They’d better be careful not to provoke the big shots above."
As though he had thought of something, the relaxed expression on the boy’s face slowly turned serious.
After looting the treasury, Daniel fell into thought.
Heavenscar was completely different from the main world.
The main world had a strength cap, with the strongest beings being no more than Transcendent Peak.
But here, he could run into supreme-grade beings at any moment—or even existences beyond supreme-grade.
He had used up quite a bit of Immortal Singularity just now, so it was time to synthesize another batch.
He took out the Replica Crystal and the Fragments of Immortal Singularity.
[Prompt: You have used "Replica Crystal" and successfully obtained "Fragment of Immortal Singularity" x10,000!]
[Prompt: You have used "Replica Crystal" and successfully obtained "Fragment of Immortal Singularity" x10,000!]
[Prompt: You have used "Replica Crystal" and successfully obtained "Fragment of Immortal Singularity" x10,000!]
In this round alone, Daniel exchanged for 200,000 Fragments of Immortal Singularity, synthesizing them into 4,000 points of Immortal Singularity.
Together with the few hundred points he had left over from before, he now had a total of 4,300 points saved up!
Looking at this considerable reserve, a smile appeared on his face.
With wealth in his pocket, he felt secure.
With this much Immortal Singularity, even if he ran into a supreme-grade powerhouse, it should still be enough to deal with the situation.
He opened the map.
This map updated in real time and clearly marked the state of the war between the Holy Faction and the Empyrean Faction.
At the moment, the Empyrean Faction held a firm upper hand.
Whether it was the native experts of Heavenscar or the prodigies who had come from all kinds of planes, the strongest group had all gone over to the side of the heavens.
By contrast, the Holy Faction was weakening with each passing day, barely hanging on through what little foundation it had left.
The map marked it clearly: the army of the heavens had already pushed into Nelson City, territory of the Holy Kingdom.
That city was now the place where the two sides would fight to the death—and also the arena where those prodigies would display their brilliance.
Daniel silently memorized the route.
In the next instant, a flash of light appeared, and he vanished from where he stood.
Outside Nelson City.
Several hundred legendary-grade experts had gathered there in a dense, oppressive mass.
On the Holy Faction side, there were slightly more Otherworldly Prodigies—around sixty of them—plus several dozen native legendary-grade experts of the Holy Kingdom.
On the Empyrean Faction side, there were a little over forty Otherworldly Prodigies, along with several dozen native legendary-grade experts from the Empyrean Kingdom.
The two sides faced each other in a tense standoff, the atmosphere thick with the smell of gunpowder.
Whoosh—!
Right at that moment,
Daniel’s figure appeared a hundred li away.
From the distance, he watched the two camps.
Technically, since he was in Heavenscar, he should have belonged to the Holy Faction.
But he had looted the Holy Kingdom treasury and driven off the king, so the Holy Faction had already branded him a wanted criminal.
And yet his mission was to destroy the Empyrean Kingdom.
Which meant one thing—he had offended both sides, and no matter where he went, he would be surrounded by enemies.
But he did not care in the slightest.

He intended to stand by and watch from the sidelines, then step in to clean things up once both sides had nearly exhausted themselves. At the same time, he could also gauge the strength of these Otherworldly Prodigies.
At that moment, a native high legendary-grade expert stepped out from the Empyrean Faction.
"I am General Coleton of the Empyrean Kingdom! Who dares come out and fight me?"
Coleton stood tall and straight, a greatsword gripped in his hands, its tip pointing directly at the Holy Kingdom camp.
On the Holy Faction side,
those Otherworldly Prodigies clearly did not think much of native legendary-grade experts.
The ones they truly feared were the prodigies from other worlds on the Empyrean side.
"A high legendary-grade? Nothing special. Who wants to go?"
"If no Transcendent takes the field, I can’t even be bothered. Just send someone out to deal with him."
"I’ll go."
An Otherworldly Prodigy walked out from the Holy Faction ranks.
He looked young. His skin was a deep purple, and he carried a massive hammer in each hand. Even his speaking voice was like metal striking metal—sharp and resonant.
"Stonekin. Berno."
Daniel gave him an extra glance. "Stonekin? Never heard of that race..."
Coleton frowned tightly as he looked Berno up and down.
Low legendary-grade?
Ever since these Otherworldly Prodigies had arrived, the understanding of the native experts had been completely overturned.
Coleton dared not underestimate this opponent who was only at low legendary-grade. On the contrary, he became even more cautious.
He understood very well that the weaker an Otherworldly Prodigy looked on the surface, the more terrifying they usually were in actual combat.
Berno charged forward with his hammer raised, rushing straight at Coleton.
His fighting style was just like the man himself—simple, violent, and direct.
As Coleton saw the giant hammer coming down, he raised his sword crosswise to block.
The moment that scene fell into the eyes of the Otherworldly Prodigies on the Empyrean side, they all shook their heads.
"Idiot."
"Stonekin are all about raw strength. Meeting them head-on is just asking to get smashed."
"Coleton’s finished. Who’s next?"
"I’ll go. I love beating up dumb brutes like Stonekin."
The development of the battle was exactly as expected. As Coleton raised his sword to block, there was a loud clang, and his greatsword was actually smashed bent on the spot.
Berno’s hammer came crashing straight down onto Coleton’s shoulder.
Boom!
-83.65 million!
Heavy Strike!
Coleton was blasted backward, and half his body was smashed to pieces.
A cold light flashed in Berno’s eyes as he pursued without mercy.
Daniel’s eyelid twitched when he saw that.
The damage from this Stonekin prodigy’s casual hammer blow was already close to the full-force strike of a high legendary-grade expert.
He still remembered that when Carodion had been at high-grade, even going all out without using Immortal Singularity, his damage had only been around this level.
If Immortal Singularity were added into the mix, breaking a hundred million would be effortless.
Was this the power of a prodigy who could suppress an entire era and represent a whole plane?
"Not bad."
Daniel muttered inwardly.
His strongest method was sustained output—layer upon layer, endlessly stacking upward.
The damage from any single hit might not look all that shocking, but when added together, the total could reach tens of billions!
That was why he had the right to stand above and judge these prodigies who were supposedly his peers.
Just then, Berno caught up to Coleton.
A layer of Immortal Singularity light coated his hammer—he was going for the kill!
Coleton’s face turned as white as paper.
He knew Otherworldly Prodigies were powerful, but he had never imagined the gap would be this enormous.
He even began to suspect that his own power as a high-grade expert was fake.
A low legendary-grade challenger was overwhelming him so completely that he had no power to fight back at all. Compared to the other party, his own high-grade cultivation seemed as weak as a child’s.
Coleton gritted his teeth. Golden light burst from his entire body as he used all of his Immortal Singularity to strengthen his defenses.
"Titanic Rock Smash!"
The hammer in Berno’s hand began to hum as its golden radiance surged violently!
A colossal phantom of a giant hammer appeared behind him, towering between heaven and earth, and followed his movement as it crashed down savagely toward Coleton.
Boom!
-165.68 million!
The giant hammer phantom dissipated.
And Coleton was annihilated along with it, reduced to ashes on the spot.
A high legendary-grade expert had died just like that—without the slightest power to resist!

chapters.title: Chapter 156 -156-A World-Shaking Reversal, the Pride of a Lesser Race
paragraphs: The native legendary-grade fighters of the Empyrean Faction all turned pale.
Coleton had actually been smashed so thoroughly by a single hammer strike that not even ashes were left behind!
The strength of that Stonekin Otherworldly Prodigy was truly terrifying!
Yet the Otherworldly Prodigies themselves all remained calm, as if they had already known this would be the outcome.
The reason they were called prodigies was because they possessed the power to kill enemies across ranks as easily as breathing.
Which one of them was not the favored child of Fortune Points in their own world?
Which one of them had not ruled their own domain with absolute dominance, invincible against all rivals?
Which one of them did not hold countless trump cards in hand, with top-tier talents to match?
This result was only natural.
"Stonekin skills really are impressive when it comes to raw power. I wonder how far Berno has trained."
"Who cares how far he’s trained? Once Harris gets here, everyone on the other side is finished."

"Obviously. Harris of the Starlight Folk is a prodigy among prodigies. I heard he went to climb Cloudcrest Peak. No idea whether he’ll make it to the top—no one has reached the summit in nearly a thousand years..."
"Forget about him for now. Are we really going to let a mere Stonekin from some minor race act this arrogantly in the Endless Starfield?"
"Relax. I’ll handle Berno in the next round."
"Then we’ll leave it to you..."
Daniel watched coldly from the sidelines.
These Otherworldly Prodigies had far too many hidden cards. Killing across ranks was as natural to them as eating and drinking.
Now it depended on how the Empyrean Faction responded.
The best outcome would be for them to send someone out to fight Berno head-on. Only then could he more clearly assess just how much these prodigies were truly worth.
When Otherworldly Prodigies fought against Heavenscar’s native powerhouses, it was nothing but one-sided domination.
The only battles truly worth watching were life-and-death struggles between prodigies themselves.
Very soon, a figure wrapped in ghostly green flames, with chains clattering all over his body, stepped out from the crowd.
He looked at the Stonekin youth Berno and spoke in an indifferent tone.
"Netherkin. Vogan."
Berno raised his twin hammers in front of himself defensively, his face expressionless.
Vogan studied him with interest for a few moments, then suddenly bared his teeth in a grin.
Boom—!
In an instant, heaven and earth changed color.
Clatter, clatter...
Countless chains shot out from Vogan’s body, blotting out the sky like a surging tidal wave as they rushed toward Berno.
Facing that overwhelming, mountain-crushing assault, a fierce light flashed through Berno’s eyes.
He remembered the instructions of the mentors and elders of his race before he had departed—
"Berno, once you step into Heavenscar, you will no longer represent only yourself. Behind you stand tens of thousands of Stonekin brethren."
"The fate and future of the Stonekin will rest in your hands."

"You may face danger, suffer setbacks, even be driven into hopeless despair. But you must remember—if you fall, the Stonekin will be left to suffer endless heavenly calamities. I believe that from that burden, you will draw strength."
"That is the strength to protect your people, the sacred power our Stonekin have always revered. It will make you invincible."
In Berno’s vision, there was nothing but deadly chains.
His eyes turned blood-red as he let out a thunderous roar.
Whoosh! Whoosh!
His two giant hammers tore through space and smashed viciously toward Vogan.
Vogan gave a cold smile and casually pointed.
A chain shot out like a living creature and sent both giant hammers flying away.
Bang—!
Golden light erupted across Berno’s body as he transformed into a streak of light and charged straight at Vogan.
A wave of sighs rose from the Holy Faction.
Anyone could see that the gap in strength between Berno and Vogan was simply too large.
Vogan had only used a portion of his power, yet it was already enough to leave Berno utterly powerless to resist.
"Berno... hold on."
"...Sigh. Even if he holds on, what can it change? This is the sorrow of all of us minor races."
"From the moment we entered Heavenscar and were forced to join the Holy Kingdom’s side because our Fortune Points were too low, our fate was already sealed."
"Are we minor races only destined to be tools? Why is Heavenscar so unfair?!"
"Fairness? Only the weak seek fairness!"
One prodigy from a small race clenched both fists tightly. The moment he thought of what awaited his people next, his whole body began trembling uncontrollably.
That was rage too great to suppress!
"Berno is going to lose. Who can deal with Vogan of the Netherkin?"
"...Vogan is too strong. We’re no match for him..."
Meanwhile, over on the Empyrean Faction side, everyone remained completely at ease.
Watching Vogan dominate the fight, they were not the slightest bit surprised.
"We’ve already won this battle."
"In the entire history of Heavenscar, the Empyrean Faction has never lost. This time will be no different."
"With Vogan of the Netherkin alone, he could probably sweep through every prodigy on the other side!"
Clatter! Clatter! Clatter!
The chains lashed like countless tentacles, striking Berno again and again.
With every strike, the HP above his head dropped sharply.
-40 million!
-48.2 million!
-32.52 million!
Even more chains wrapped around Berno’s limbs, then wound around his entire body like spider silk, cocooning him completely.
Seeing this, Daniel frowned slightly.
"Netherkin? Another race I’ve never heard of... Still, Vogan’s strength is indeed far above Berno of the Stonekin."
He could tell that Vogan had not even used his full power.
As for Berno, he had already been completely suppressed.
"Die, trash!"
Vogan shouted.
A purple glow spread across the countless chains—he intended to grind Berno to death alive!
Boom—!
A world-shaking explosion erupted from within the mass of chains.
Whoosh! Whoosh! Whoosh!
The chains spread apart, revealing empty air inside.
A smile appeared on Vogan’s face.
But in the next moment, his expression changed.
Cries of shock erupted simultaneously from both the Holy Faction and the Empyrean Faction.
"Berno!"
"How is that possible? He didn’t die to that attack?!"
"What a teleportation move! Berno, incredible!"
Daniel saw it clearly as well.
One of the giant hammers that had been knocked away had somehow transformed into Berno himself.
Whoosh—!
Berno turned into a streak of golden light and shot straight toward Vogan.
He used the secret technique of the Stonekin once again.
In the void, an enormous phantom of Berno and a giant hammer appeared. Following his movement, it came crashing down violently toward Vogan.
Anyone paying close attention would notice that the giant hammer in the phantom’s hands had already turned into a blood-red ball of fire.
Golden flames were blazing all over Berno’s body—he was burning Immortal Singularity!
His face twisted savagely as he poured all his strength into that final hammer strike and roared:
"Die for me—!"
Vogan only had time to use Immortal Singularity to protect his body.
The giant hammer smashed into him without the slightest suspense.
Boom—!
Crack! Crack! Crack...
Broken chains fell one after another from the sky.
Vogan, powerhouse of the Netherkin, died on the spot.
At the same time, the phantom behind Berno dissipated, and his aura plummeted sharply.
Pfft!
Golden blood flowed from his eyes, ears, nose, and mouth.
His body hovered unsteadily in midair, swaying as if he could fall at any moment, yet he still kept his back ramrod straight.
"We may not be as strong as you great races, but we are not spineless weaklings for you great races to bully at will!"
"The Stonekin may be weak, but we have never lacked the courage to challenge fate! Even someone as weak as me can still bring down a powerhouse from your great races!"
"So what if we’re ants? Even ants can topple an elephant!"
Berno was already so weak he could barely hold on, but he refused to let himself fall.
He swept his gaze over the people opposite him, then slowly flew back toward the Holy Faction.

"Relax.
I’ll handle Berno in the next round."
"Then we’ll leave it to you..."
Daniel watched coldly from the sidelines.
These Otherworldly Prodigies had far too many hidden cards.
Killing across ranks was as natural to them as eating and drinking.
Now it depended on how the Empyrean Faction responded.
The best outcome would be for them to send someone out to fight Berno head-on.
Only then could he more clearly assess just how much these prodigies were truly worth.
When Otherworldly Prodigies fought against Heavenscar’s native powerhouses, it was nothing but one-sided domination.
The only battles truly worth watching were life-and-death struggles between prodigies themselves.
Very soon, a figure wrapped in ghostly green flames, with chains clattering all over his body, stepped out from the crowd.
He looked at the Stonekin youth Berno and spoke in an indifferent tone.
"Netherkin.
Vogan."
Berno raised his twin hammers in front of himself defensively, his face expressionless.
Vogan studied him with interest for a few moments, then suddenly bared his teeth in a grin.
Boom—!
In an instant, heaven and earth changed color.
Clatter, clatter...
Countless chains shot out from Vogan’s body, blotting out the sky like a surging tidal wave as they rushed toward Berno.
Facing that overwhelming, mountain-crushing assault, a fierce light flashed through Berno’s eyes.
He remembered the instructions of the mentors and elders of his race before he had departed—
"Berno, once you step into Heavenscar, you will no longer represent only yourself.
Behind you stand tens of thousands of Stonekin brethren."
"The fate and future of the Stonekin will rest in your hands."
"You may face danger, suffer setbacks, even be driven into hopeless despair.
But you must remember—if you fall, the Stonekin will be left to suffer endless heavenly calamities.
I believe that from that burden, you will draw strength."
"That is the strength to protect your people, the sacred power our Stonekin have always revered.
It will make you invincible."
In Berno’s vision, there was nothing but deadly chains.
His eyes turned blood-red as he let out a thunderous roar.
Whoosh!
Whoosh!
His two giant hammers tore through space and smashed viciously toward Vogan.
Vogan gave a cold smile and casually pointed.
A chain shot out like a living creature and sent both giant hammers flying away.
Bang—!
Golden light erupted across Berno’s body as he transformed into a streak of light and charged straight at Vogan.
A wave of sighs rose from the Holy Faction.
Anyone could see that the gap in strength between Berno and Vogan was simply too large.
Vogan had only used a portion of his power, yet it was already enough to leave Berno utterly powerless to resist.
"Berno... hold on."
"...Sigh.
Even if he holds on, what can it change?
This is the sorrow of all of us minor races."
"From the moment we entered Heavenscar and were forced to join the Holy Kingdom’s side because our Fortune Points were too low, our fate was already sealed."
"Are we minor races only destined to be tools?
Why is Heavenscar so unfair?!"
"Fairness?
Only the weak seek fairness!"
One prodigy from a small race clenched both fists tightly.
The moment he thought of what awaited his people next, his whole body began trembling uncontrollably.
That was rage too great to suppress!
"Berno is going to lose.
Who can deal with Vogan of the Netherkin?"
"...Vogan is too strong.
We’re no match for him..."
Meanwhile, over on the Empyrean Faction side, everyone remained completely at ease.
Watching Vogan dominate the fight, they were not the slightest bit surprised.
"We’ve already won this battle."
"In the entire history of Heavenscar, the Empyrean Faction has never lost.
This time will be no different."
"With Vogan of the Netherkin alone, he could probably sweep through every prodigy on the other side!"
Clatter!
Clatter!
Clatter!
The chains lashed like countless tentacles, striking Berno again and again.
With every strike, the HP above his head dropped sharply.
-40 million!
-48.2 million!
-32.52 million!
Even more chains wrapped around Berno’s limbs, then wound around his entire body like spider silk, cocooning him completely.
Seeing this, Daniel frowned slightly.
"Netherkin?
Another race I’ve never heard of...
Still, Vogan’s strength is indeed far above Berno of the Stonekin."
He could tell that Vogan had not even used his full power.
As for Berno, he had already been completely suppressed.
"Die, trash!"
Vogan shouted.
A purple glow spread across the countless chains—he intended to grind Berno to death alive!
Boom—!
A world-shaking explosion erupted from within the mass of chains.
Whoosh!
Whoosh!
Whoosh!
The chains spread apart, revealing empty air inside.
A smile appeared on Vogan’s face.
But in the next moment, his expression changed.
Cries of shock erupted simultaneously from both the Holy Faction and the Empyrean Faction.
"Berno!"
"How is that possible?
He didn’t die to that attack?!"
"What a teleportation move!
Berno, incredible!"
Daniel saw it clearly as well.
One of the giant hammers that had been knocked away had somehow transformed into Berno himself.
Whoosh—!
Berno turned into a streak of golden light and shot straight toward Vogan.
He used the secret technique of the Stonekin once again.
In the void, an enormous phantom of Berno and a giant hammer appeared.
Following his movement, it came crashing down violently toward Vogan.
Anyone paying close attention would notice that the giant hammer in the phantom’s hands had already turned into a blood-red ball of fire.
Golden flames were blazing all over Berno’s body—he was burning Immortal Singularity!
His face twisted savagely as he poured all his strength into that final hammer strike and roared:
"Die for me—!"
Vogan only had time to use Immortal Singularity to protect his body.
The giant hammer smashed into him without the slightest suspense.
Boom—!
Crack!
Crack!
Crack...
Broken chains fell one after another from the sky.
Vogan, powerhouse of the Netherkin, died on the spot.
At the same time, the phantom behind Berno dissipated, and his aura plummeted sharply.
Pfft!
Golden blood flowed from his eyes, ears, nose, and mouth.
His body hovered unsteadily in midair, swaying as if he could fall at any moment, yet he still kept his back ramrod straight.
"We may not be as strong as you great races, but we are not spineless weaklings for you great races to bully at will!"
"The Stonekin may be weak, but we have never lacked the courage to challenge fate!
Even someone as weak as me can still bring down a powerhouse from your great races!"
"So what if we’re ants?
Even ants can topple an elephant!"
Berno was already so weak he could barely hold on, but he refused to let himself fall.
He swept his gaze over the people opposite him, then slowly flew back toward the Holy Faction.

chapters.title: Chapter 157 -157-Farce
paragraphs: At this moment, countless Otherworldly Prodigies were staring at the Stonekin genius who had created a miracle.
What he had done, and what he had said, struck a powerful chord deep within the hearts of the prodigies on his side.
If fate refuses to give us a choice, then we will fight until we beat fate itself!
Weakness, perhaps, is nothing more than an excuse one makes for one’s own failure.
As long as one is willing to risk everything, even the strongest opponent is not impossible to defeat.
Ever since Heavenscar opened, the Holy Faction had never once won.
The reason was simple: the prodigies from the great races and great worlds of the Endless Starfield had all banded together.
Meanwhile, those born into lesser races had no choice at all. They could only join the Holy Faction, the side that was doomed to lose.
They were not like the powerhouses of the great races.
Those prodigies from the great races had plenty of Fortune Points to spare. They could afford to lose. At worst, they would just lose some Fortune Points.
But these lesser-race prodigies could not afford defeat!
What they represented was not themselves alone, but the countless members of their race and plane.
Death itself was not frightening.
What was frightening was that once they died, their people would be forced to endure endless heavenly calamities, generation after generation.
The same was true for the human race.
Daniel took a deep breath. He could not afford to lose either.
Because he represented all of humanity.
If humanity’s Fortune Points ever dropped into the negative, the human race would suffer even harsher punishment.
He absolutely could not allow that to happen.
He did not want humanity to relive the disasters of his past lives ever again.
They had been too miserable, like an endless nightmare from which no one could ever wake.
"That’s right. Even an ant has the right to lift its head and look at the stars."
Daniel clenched his fists silently.
He swore that he would lead humanity to crush every calamity and every obstacle.
He would lead humanity to witness that vast, boundless starry sky!
Watching Vogan get killed by what was essentially a "sneak attack," the prodigies of the Empyrean Faction fell silent for a moment.
Vogan of the Netherkin had been very strong, yet he had still died at the hands of Berno of the Stonekin.
They were surprised, but they did not think it was all that extraordinary.
Within their faction, Vogan was only at a middling level.
And on the Holy Faction’s side, how many would dare risk their lives the way Berno had?
Berno had only won by taking an unconventional path and getting lucky.
Now that the prodigies of the Empyrean Faction were on guard, what waves could the Holy Kingdom side possibly stir up anymore?
"It’s time to end this farce."
At that moment, a figure stepped out from the Empyrean Faction.
The man was tall, and his entire body radiated a sacred aura.
The moment the prodigies of the Holy Faction saw him, they all sucked in a sharp breath.
"Kahn! A prodigy of the Godkin!"
"Wasn’t he supposed to have gone to Cloudcrest Peak with Harris? Why is he here?"
"No wonder Harris dared go climb the summit before finishing his mission. So he left Kahn here to keep watch."
The prodigies of the Empyrean Faction also revealed looks of anticipation.
They all knew that the prodigies of the Godkin were absurdly powerful.

After all, Kahn had once single-handedly broken through a border fortress of the Holy Kingdom, slaughtered a large number of legendary-grade experts, and even instantly killed Otherworldly Prodigies without the slightest suspense!
"Kahn is probably in a hurry to finish things here so he can go join Harris in reaching the summit..."
"The moment Kahn makes his move, the ending is already decided—unless the other side suddenly produces a dark horse on his level."
"Everyone stay sharp. The other side might go all out and try to overwhelm us in a group fight..."
Kahn walked through the void.
With every step he took, it felt as though he were stomping directly on the hearts of the opposing prodigies.
Kahn swept his gaze across every person in the Holy Faction, his eyes glowing with sacred light, dazzling to the extreme.
Not a single opponent dared meet his gaze head-on.
"Godkin, Kahn."
He came to a stop, his tone utterly calm.
The Holy Faction instantly erupted into chaos.
"How are we supposed to fight this? That’s Kahn!"
"He’s the one who took on an entire fortress by himself and even instantly killed three non-human prodigies!"
"There’s no way a single person can defeat him!"
Instantly killing native powerhouses—even Transcendent legendary-grade ones—did not strike them as particularly shocking.
Because their own side could do the same.
But instantly killing three prodigies?
That achievement was simply too outrageous.
Daniel was also staring fixedly at everything before him.
"Godkin..."
A trace of memory flickered through his eyes.
In his previous lives, after the game and reality had begun to merge and the heavenly calamities erupted, humanity had suffered terribly.
More than once, human powerhouses had contacted the God Realm, begging it to send powerful experts to save the human race.
But from beginning to end, the Godkin had not sent even a single shadow.
In the end, humanity stopped pinning its hopes on the God Realm and instead stumbled onward, surviving on its own.
Thinking of that connection, Daniel could not help looking at Kahn a few more times.
Kahn truly was formidable. At the very least, in terms of sheer presence alone, he had already crushed everyone on the other side.
But if the Godkin were this terrifying, why had they not helped humanity?
Why had they stood by and watched while humanity struggled on the edge of death?
Was it simply because humanity was just one of the countless planes under the jurisdiction of the God Realm, so insignificant it was less than an ant?
He still remembered how humanity had suppressed the Abyss Rift, blocking the invasion of the Demon Realm on behalf of the God Realm.
Humanity had literally been fighting for the God Realm!
And yet the Godkin had abandoned humanity to die.
At that thought, Daniel’s gaze grew complicated.
Within the Holy Faction,
someone suddenly shouted at the top of his lungs, "Attack together! No single person can beat Kahn!"
"That’s right! We carry the hopes of our race on our backs. Our individual lives don’t matter, but we cannot betray the expectations of the billions of our people!"
"I may never return. I may lose as well... but before that happens, let me first offer up my final blessing for my race!"
Whoosh! Whoosh! Whoosh!
Dozens of Otherworldly Prodigies suddenly charged out, bringing with them the native legendary-grade powerhouses as they rushed toward the Empyrean Faction.
The prodigies of the Empyrean Faction had long been expecting this move. Many wore disdainful expressions as they stepped forward to meet them.
Boom! Boom! Boom!
Godscar instantly exploded into chaos.
The melee had begun!
Daniel watched it all coldly. "I’ll clean up the aftermath at the end."
His heart was icy, without the slightest trace of softheartedness.
The life or death of those Holy Faction prodigies had nothing to do with him!
Aside from being responsible for humanity, he had no need to be responsible for anyone else.
The best outcome was for both sides to batter each other bloody. That way, he would save some effort later.
The battle raged on continuously.
From within Godscar, miserable screams rang out from time to time, and every so often several corpses would fall from the sky.
Some were native legendary-grade experts and prodigies from the Holy Faction. A very small number were legendary-grade experts and prodigies from the Empyrean Kingdom.
The battle went on for a long time.
Then, at a certain moment...
Godscar suddenly fell silent.
When that twisted expanse of space dispersed, it revealed the side that had won in the end.
As expected, it was the Empyrean Faction.
At this point, all of the Empyrean Faction’s native legendary-grade experts had died, leaving behind only a dozen or so prodigies.
Quite a few of them were injured, some lightly, some heavily.
Only powerhouses like Kahn of the Godkin and Magna of the Netherkin were completely unscathed.
"The prodigies of the Holy Faction really did have some skill. Aside from having a thinner foundation, their talents weren’t actually that much worse than ours."
"There’s still a gap. If you compare them to the very top great races, they’re far behind."
"Exactly. Among the Netherkin’s two prodigies, Vogan only died because he was careless. Magna’s completely fine, and Kahn doesn’t even need mentioning."
"No matter what, this mission should be complete now. All that’s left is to push into the Imperial City, and it’ll be over!"
