After reading it, Daniel understood everything clearly.
Just as he had suspected—Kelly was the lifeline of this instance.
His luck was not bad at all. The moment he entered, he had run into her immediately, unlike the other players who had likely been scattered to random corners of the map.
Still, to be absolutely safe, he took out a Replica Crystal and stockpiled several hundred thousand points of Immortal Singularity.
Kelly stood nearby, watching curiously as he handled all sorts of things she could not understand. She said nothing and simply observed him in silence.
After putting everything away, Daniel smiled at her and softened his voice.
"The other sacrifices... are they in the valley too?"
Kelly nodded. "They’re all gathered near the wooden huts."
Daniel blinked. "Take me there."
Kelly led him deep into the valley.
Several large wooden huts stood in a row, and hundreds of children were scattered around them.

Every single one of them looked dull and lifeless, their spirits utterly drained. Even when they saw Kelly and Daniel approaching, they remained listless, their eyes empty, as if they could not even be bothered to lift their eyelids.
Daniel frowned and looked at Kelly in confusion.
Kelly pursed her lips. She understood his question and answered in a low voice,
"They all think they were abandoned by their people and their families. It hurt too much... they couldn’t bear it... so they became like this."
Hearing that only made Daniel even more puzzled.
Wasn’t Kelly the same? She too had been chosen as a sacrifice. She too had been abandoned by her parents. So why was she different from these children?
Not only had she not fallen apart, she was always smiling. Even when she had mistaken him for a Soul Devourer, she had not seemed especially miserable.
He did not ask the question aloud, yet suddenly he understood.
Why had Kelly said that no one wanted to play with her?
Because someone who could still raise her head and look at the white clouds in the sky even in the depths of despair... was destined to be lonely.
Buzzzzz—
Just then, a black mass suddenly surged across the sky in the distance.
The moment Kelly saw it, her face turned deathly pale.
At the same time, the children who had been sitting there in numb silence all changed expression as well. Some of them were so terrified that they turned and ran blindly toward the outside.
It was obvious.
The Soul Devourers had arrived!
As Daniel watched terror and chaos spread through the area, killing intent surged in his eyes.
"You damned beasts!"
"You will pay for your sins!"
He shot into the air and charged straight toward that black cloud.
Kelly clasped her hands together tightly and stared at his back with nervous eyes.
In her heart, she silently prayed for Daniel’s safety.
Daniel flew into the sky, and the black cloud abruptly came to a halt.
The cloud was made up entirely of Soul Devourers, their bodies wrapped in black mist.
The moment they saw Daniel flying toward them, every one of them changed expression.
"Who are you? Why are you in our ranch?"
The leading dark figure barked the question harshly.
"The one who will punish you."
Daniel’s body trembled, and ninety-nine clones instantly burst into existence around him.
"You dare devour and oppress my human race—die!"
He drew Stellar Wrath, and arrows poured down like a torrential storm.
"Hunting Domain!"
"Shadowfont!"
"Skyfall Strike!"
"Thunder Abyss!"
"Permafrost Prison!"
Tens of thousands of forbidden spells erupted all at once, changing the very color of heaven and earth.
In Daniel’s field of vision, damage numbers cascaded like a waterfall.
In almost a single instant, the army of Soul Devourers was nearly wiped out beneath the tide of forbidden spells.
"How is this possible?! That kind of power... forbidden spells?!"
"Damn it! Since when could the human race wield forbidden spells?!"
"The human race barely has a few legendary-grade powerhouses, and this man can actually use forbidden spells?!"
Even in death, they could not understand what kind of being had slaughtered them.
Since when had humanity possessed such a terrifying expert?
The kill notifications rang nonstop in Daniel’s ears.
In the span of a single minute, he had butchered the entire group of Soul Devourers until not one remained.
Only then did the killing intent in his eyes finally recede a little.
Whether in Aetheria or in Heavenscar, he had dared to kill even the lofty Godkin.
And these Soul Devourers—creatures from who knew where—actually dared to threaten humanity and demand human sacrifices?
What a joke.

chapters.title: Chapter 175 -175-Puppets to Be Toyed With by Other Races
paragraphs: Daniel flew back to Soul Devouring Vale, and a system notification immediately rang out.
[Ding! You have completed the stage quest.]
The first stage—slaying the Soul Devourers—was already finished.
What came next was escorting Kelly back to a human city.
He landed beside Kelly and spoke calmly.
"From now on, humanity will never have to offer sacrifices to the Soul Devourers again."
Seeing that he had returned completely unharmed, Kelly broke into a bright smile and nodded vigorously.
"Big Brother Faustus, you’re amazing!"
"The mighty Soul Devourers were like paper in front of you."
"I want to become a truly great powerhouse like you—someone who stands tall and unshakable beneath the heavens!"
Boom—!
The moment Kelly finished speaking, her aura suddenly surged.
A flicker of surprise flashed across Daniel’s eyes as he cast Detect.
[Kelly (Exalted-grade)]
"Uh... she advanced to Exalted-grade just like that?"
Though he had been mentally prepared, he was still startled.
The quest description had indeed said Kelly would grow stronger during the process, but he had never expected it to happen at this speed.
The moment he completed the quest, she leveled up along with it.
A hidden instance really was worthy of its name—even the characters inside it would grow with the storyline.
Steadying himself, he prepared to move on to the second phase.
"Let’s go,"
he said to Kelly. "I’ll take all of you back to Starlight City."
A bright light instantly flared in Kelly’s eyes.
Starlight City—a great human city!
Returning there meant returning to the human world. It meant they would never again have to wait in despair for the Soul Devourers.
"That’s wonderful, we can go home!"
Kelly was overjoyed.
As soon as she spoke, she ran off to find the others who had also been offered as sacrifices.
Daniel stood where he was and watched.

He discovered that Kelly was actually quite interesting. Borrowing the momentum of his complete annihilation of the Soul Devourers just now, she managed to persuade everyone with only a few words and smoothly became the leader of the group.
And he also noticed that the boys and girls Kelly had rallied had all grown stronger as well.
Though they had not reached Kelly’s Exalted-grade, they had at least advanced to epic-grade.
Daniel shook his head, inwardly marveling once more that this instance was anything but simple.
After gathering the group, Kelly walked over to him and said softly, "Big Brother Faustus, we’re ready to go."
Daniel smiled and nodded. "Good."
Somewhere inside the hidden instance.
Several players stared blankly at the town before them.
The terrain of this place—and even the town’s name—looked far too much like a certain main city in the main world.
"Black Godfather, you’re not mistaken, right? This is it?"
Black Godfather was so excited his whole face had turned red.
"How could I possibly be mistaken?!"
He pointed at the town and shouted, "This—this is Luminara!"
Hiss—!
The players beside him all sucked in a sharp breath.
Good grief. If they had not known Black Godfather well enough to practically share the same pair of pants, they would have spat in his face on the spot.
How could one of the Seven Great Main Cities, the grand and mighty Luminara, possibly be this shabby little town in front of them?
And yet this shabby little town just happened to be called Luminara!
"Oh right, Black Godfather—you’re supposed to know Stellar’s history better than anyone, aren’t you?"
"Tell us, then. What exactly happened a hundred thousand years ago?"
Black Godfather took a deep breath, nodded, and slowly began:

"A hundred thousand years ago, the human race had spread everywhere, but they were treated like marionettes by the non-human races of every realm. Those outsiders manipulated humanity into fighting itself, turning human society into complete chaos."
"It was an age so chaotic it couldn’t have been any worse. Humanity could barely survive, and war was everywhere."

"But a hundred thousand years ago, the Soul Devourers were wiped out, root and branch, by some mysterious Strength. At the same time, humanity’s own stronghold—Starlight City—was reduced to flat ground by a meteor that fell from the sky!"
"Hiss... no way. Could it be that..."
Daniel led the group out of the valley, and a notification immediately rang in his ears.
[Hint: You have discovered "Starlight City"!]
In an instance, there was no such thing as traveling normally.
The scene transition was seamless. They were directly teleported to the quest location.
Daniel lifted his eyes and looked toward the great city before him.
Towering. Massive. Its architectural style carried a sense of raw brutality.
Savage. Rough.
Those were his most direct impressions.
Starlight City?
He ran through the cities of Aetheria in his mind. Among the nine main cities, there was no place by that name.
At this moment, Starlight City was in the middle of a war.
Inside and outside the city, blades and spears glinted everywhere as countless human warriors fought like mad.
The battle cries thundered through the air. Both sides had bloodshot eyes, as if they bore irreconcilable hatred for one another.
Daniel frowned.
Every war he had fought in the game had been against foreign races. This was the first time he had ever seen humans slaughtering other humans.
They were all human—was this really necessary?
It did not take long before he understood.
Kelly cried out in shock, "The Brula Tribe has attacked!"
The children behind her also exclaimed one after another.
"So the Divine Tongue Tribe and the Brula Tribe have finally gone to war?"
"Then... doesn’t that mean we can’t go home anymore?"
"Heh... maybe our homes are already gone!"
Listening to their discussion, Daniel pieced together the situation.
This seemed to be a war between two human tribes—but why had they chosen to wage civil war inside the city itself?
He spoke up and asked, "Kelly, what exactly are the Divine Tongue Tribe and the Brula Tribe?"
Kelly sighed and said, "The Divine Tongue Tribe is the main force within Starlight City. They have a population of several million! Their backer is the sirenfolk."
"The Brula Tribe is equally powerful, but behind them stand the shadowkin."
She lowered her head, and her voice was filled with sorrow.
"In truth, this world also has the Godkin, the Undead Realm, the realm of the elves... They all support us humans, but they also treat us like toys for their amusement."
"If they want us to live, we live. If they want us to die, then we die."
"When they get bored, they stir up conflict among humans and make us kill one another. The fighting never ends—just so they can satisfy their idle entertainment."
"Big Brother Faustus... don’t you think that’s tragic?"
Tragic?
It was far beyond tragic. It was utterly miserable!
Daniel’s face had already darkened halfway through hearing it.
By the time she finished, his fists were clenched so tightly they crackled.
His expression turned grim, and his heart sank to the bottom.
He simply could not imagine that the humans here had actually become... become this spineless!
How had humanity fallen to this point?
A wave of killing intent suddenly exploded from his body.
"Big Brother Faustus?"
Kelly asked timidly.
Daniel stared fixedly at the human battlefield before him, his teeth grinding audibly.
"Humanity should not be like this! Humanity should not be this spineless!"
Kelly asked carefully, "Then... what should humanity be like?"
Daniel’s voice had grown hoarse from fury.
"Humanity should stand united! Humanity should straighten its own spine! Humanity should stand on equal footing with every other race!!"
He looked deeply at Kelly.
"In any case, humanity is not a toy for other races to play with!"
Kelly silently engraved his words in her heart. Looking up at him, she said with both admiration and seriousness,
"Big Brother Faustus, you’re right!"
"If humanity really could become what you described... how wonderful that would be."
"Big Brother Faustus, I... I want to help you."
Daniel looked at Kelly’s earnest face and gave a bitter smile, shaking his head.
Just then, the system notification suddenly exploded again.
[Ding! You have completed the quest [Soulreaving Moment]!]
[Ding! You have received the next-stage quest [Tribal Soul]!]
[Hint: Your quest log has been updated. Please check it for details!]

chapters.title: Chapter 176 -176-Tribal Soul — Queen Kelly
paragraphs: Daniel opened his quest log.
[Tribal Soul (Quest Chain)] (Hidden Instance)
Quest Difficulty: Exalted-grade
Objectives:
Raise "Kelly" into a leader of humanity. Pass on to her your ideals for humanity’s survival and place in the world.
After reading it, Daniel closed the interface.
Kelly’s importance in his heart rose yet another level.
The quest was actually asking him to cultivate Kelly, and even to teach her his ideals about how humanity should survive and establish itself in the world.
Could Kelly possibly have some extraordinary origin?
He looked at her deeply.
"Look at this battlefield," he suddenly said. "If you had the power to control everything, what would you do?"
Kelly froze for a moment, then smiled.
"If I had that kind of power, I’d make them stop fighting."
Daniel blinked. "And how would you make them stop?"
Kelly put away her smile and answered seriously, "I’d go talk properly with the leaders on both sides."
Daniel laughed and shook his head.
"You’re thinking too simply. The true culprits are the forces standing behind them!"
"I’ll teach you the easiest way."
Kelly looked at him curiously.
Daniel drew in a deep breath. "Beat them into submission. If they refuse, they die!"
"You have to beat them until they’re afraid, until they tremble, until they kneel and beg for mercy!"
"Smash the old world to pieces, then mold an entirely new one from the ruins."
His body slowly rose into the air, while his voice continued to drift into Kelly’s ears.
"The old humanity must die. Only then can a new humanity live."
Whoosh, whoosh, whoosh—!
He flew into the skies above Starlight City.
At once, the two legendary-grade human leaders stopped fighting and raised their heads to look at him.

The endless rain of meteors caused destruction so horrifying that it chilled the soul.

The great sturdy city walls, which in the minds of the people had seemed as solid as iron, were smashed into powder in the blink of an eye.
How many powerful warriors had once been each other’s nightmares? And yet under this forbidden spell, they were reduced to ash in an instant.
Terrifying.

"A... a forbidden spell!"
"Aren’t forbidden spells supposed to belong only to top races like the Godkin?!"

"You are not submitting to me. You are submitting to her."

"We pay our respects to Queen Kelly!"

Rays of light flashed across their bodies, and their strength instantly rose to Exalted-grade.

At the same time—
Kelly’s aura began to rise madly, breaking through the threshold of legendary-grade in the blink of an eye.
Daniel flew back to her side.

Daniel smiled faintly.
"I’ve already told you about the kind of human world I want."

"Of course! Big Brother Faustus, I’m willing to help you."
Daniel said calmly,
"Good. Then be a proper Queen Kelly and do exactly as I told you."
Kelly’s eyes became firm.

Daniel nodded and smiled.

Luminara Town?

It couldn’t possibly be... Luminara, could it?
He shook his head and did not think further about it.
Kelly subdued the two legendary-grade experts—
Sili and Karint!
With those two helping her, the scattered remnants of the armies were quickly gathered up.
Daniel watched with his own eyes as that cheerful girl transformed from innocent and inexperienced, to capable, from capable to shrewd, and from shrewd to steady and composed.
Her growth was astonishingly fast—far beyond anything Daniel had imagined!
"Big Brother Faustus, let’s set out."
Kelly revealed a bright, happy smile.
In front of others, she could wear many different faces. But in front of Daniel, she was always that same slightly naïve young girl.
Daniel nodded.
Shua—!
The next moment, just like when they had first left Soul Devouring Vale, the scene inside the instance shifted once more.
This time, everyone around him vanished.
Even Kelly was gone!
In their place stood a small city rising from the ground before him.
Luminara City!

chapters.title: Chapter 177 -177-The Person More Important Than Anything Else
paragraphs: Daniel stared in astonishment at the small city that had appeared so suddenly.
At this moment, Luminara City already faintly resembled the Luminara of the main world, carrying its outline and shadow. For some reason, it filled him with a sense of familiarity—and shock.
Just then—
"Guild Leader! It’s the Guild Leader!"
"Holy shit, we finally found the boss!"
"We finally found our backbone. What the hell is this place..."
"I was seriously thinking about killing myself just to quit the instance. This place is way too creepy..."
Guild members came rushing in from every direction. The moment they saw Daniel, it was like they had found their real older brother.
Daniel smiled.
"How did all of you end up here too? Looks like we’ve reached the key story point of the instance."
Some of the players immediately reacted.
"Guild Leader, are you saying this scene is the turning point of the whole instance?"
Daniel nodded. "That’s right. Otherwise, we wouldn’t all be gathering here."
At the same time, a thunderous announcement suddenly echoed throughout the instance.
[Instance Announcement: "Queen Kelly" is about to ascend the throne!]
[Instance Announcement: Queen Kelly’s ascension has enraged the races of the star sea!]
[Godkin: Queen Kelly is a rebel of the human race. She is leading humanity into an abyss of eternal doom!]
[shadowkin: Queen Kelly has stolen the rights of the various races and blinded humanity’s future!]
[Voidspirit Race: Queen Kelly seeks to manipulate humanity into provoking its suzerain races. Her crimes are unforgivable!]
The moment Daniel heard the system announcement, his expression darkened.
A cry of shock suddenly rang out from among the players.
Black Godfather exclaimed, "So that’s it—I get it now!"
"In history, a hundred thousand years ago, Queen Kelly rose out of nowhere and was crowned as one of humanity’s Three Kings! This instance is letting us personally experience an entire era!"
Daniel froze for a moment when he heard that, and then a flash of realization shot through his mind.
Inside Luminara City.
Countless palace maids were attending to Kelly’s appearance, helping her into imperial robes and fastening at her waist the longsword that symbolized royal authority.
But at this moment, Kelly looked distracted.
"What time is it now?"
Her voice was cold, filled with majesty.
The maids around her stood in trembling silence.
One braver maid finally answered.
"Your Majesty, there are ten minutes left before the coronation ceremony begins."
"Ten minutes?"
A deep struggle flashed through Kelly’s eyes.
She bit her lip lightly and silently murmured in her heart,
Big Brother Faustus, where exactly did you go? Why haven’t you appeared even now?
Today is my coronation ceremony. You told me to become Queen Kelly properly—and I did it.
But... did you see it?
At that very moment, a tremor suddenly flickered through Kelly’s eyes.
"Prepare the dragon mount!"
Her shout split apart the stillness of the entire chamber.
"Y-Your Majesty... did you say... prepare the dragon mount now?"
The cosmetic boxes in the maids’ hands nearly fell to the floor.
The coronation was right in front of them—why would Her Majesty need a mount now?
Kelly’s gaze turned icy as she barked, "What are you still standing there for? Go!"
"Y-Yes, Your Majesty!"
Roar—! Roar—!
Not long afterward, a dragon’s cry rang out from deep within the palace walls, shaking the entire palace until it hummed.
Kelly shot to her feet and dismissed all the maids.
Then she strode across the threshold, her trailing robes flying behind her like battle banners.
"Your Majesty!"
An elderly official hurriedly rushed over to stop her.
"Where are you going?"
Kelly cast him a cold glance.
"To find someone."
"F-find... someone?"
The official’s eyes nearly bulged out of their sockets.
Kelly could not be bothered with him and continued forward.
But after only a few steps, two towering figures like iron walls blocked her path.
They were Sili and Karint, the two legendary-grade experts.
"Your Majesty, the coronation ceremony is about to begin. You absolutely must not behave improperly!"
"That’s right, Your Majesty—the greater cause comes first!"
Kelly did not even lift her eyelids.
"I’m going to find someone."
Sili’s eyes had already reddened.
"This person... could they possibly be more important than the billions of human subjects?"
"Yes."
Kelly did not hesitate for even half a second.
Sili’s face instantly froze, as though someone had dumped a basin of icy water over his head.
Karint said sharply,
"Your Majesty, could this person possibly be more important than your ideals of reviving humanity?"
Kelly’s steps suddenly stopped.
She lifted her head and looked at the flying dragon circling across the sky. The wind stirred by its wings brushed across her face.
Her voice was calm, yet it left absolutely no room for negotiation.
"That’s right."
Karint opened his mouth, but not a single word came out.
Whoosh—!
Kelly leapt onto the dragon’s back.
She cast one final glance at the countless living beings within the city. There was no attachment in that look—only resolve.
Then, with one powerful beat of its wings, the dragon shot into the sky like a streak of light.
Roar! Roar! Roar—!
Outside Luminara City.
A dragon-shaped shadow dove down from the clouds and landed steadily in front of Daniel.
Swish—!
A figure jumped down from the dragon’s back and landed before him.
It was Kelly!
Daniel looked at her.
Because of the instance’s scene transitions, it felt as though the two of them had never really been separated.
But he knew that was only the result of accelerated time.
Now, Kelly’s power had already surged to the peak of legendary-grade. Her posture was tall and straight, and all the youthful immaturity she once had was gone from her bearing and brows.
Only those eyes remained just as they had always been—clear and bright!
Kelly looked at Daniel and grinned, exactly the same way she had the first time she met him in Soul Devouring Vale.
"Big Brother Faustus, you really came."
Daniel nodded and laughed as well.
"Of course. Today is your coronation ceremony!"
Kelly’s smile grew even brighter.
"With Big Brother Faustus here, I’m not afraid even if I have to stand against the entire star sea."
Daniel took a deep breath.
"I’ll be there."
"Today is Queen Kelly’s grand coronation, and also the perfect day to welcome the descent of gods and demons. This time... can you do it?"
Kelly’s gaze was as steady as stone atop a mountain peak.
"No problem."
Daniel brought her back to Luminara City.
The guild players followed behind their guild leader like little tails.
"WTF? What is going on here? The Guild Leader directly connected with the most mysterious Queen Kelly in history!"
"Did you see the way Queen Kelly looks at the boss? Doesn’t it kind of feel like... you know?"
"Stop talking nonsense. This is an instance! Queen Kelly is a figure from a hundred thousand years ago."
"Exactly. At the end of the day, this is just like a temporary experience—it’s not actual time travel."
"Get ready. I’ve got a feeling a wave of enemies is definitely about to come charging in."
"Get ready for what? The ones coming are all ruthless monsters like the Godkin and shadowkin. Who can you even beat?"
"I can’t beat them, but the Guild Leader can! Can’t I just cheer from the sidelines?!"
"That... actually makes sense..."
Daniel stepped onto an invisible staircase and entered the bounds of Luminara City.
At the same time, the system notification rang out.
[Ding! You have completed the quest [Tribal Soul]!]
[Hint: The final quest [To the Last Drop of Blood] has begun! Please check your quest log for details!]
Daniel’s gaze shifted slightly as he opened the quest log.
[To the Last Drop of Blood (Quest Chain)] (Hidden Instance)
Quest Difficulty: Exalted-grade
Quest Objective: Kill all invading enemies!
Quest Description:

Queen Kelly has resolutely rejected the threats and coercion of the gods and demons from all realms. She is the only human force in this world that has never been manipulated by the hands of the non-human races. If humanity refuses to obediently become puppets and slaves of other worlds, then the entire myriad realms will regard them as enemies that must be eradicated! Protect Queen Kelly, and slaughter every enemy who dares invade.
Time Limit: 9:58:58
Quest Reward: Hidden Instance [Flame of Heritage] Unlock Scroll, forbidden-grade Archer Class Awakening Scroll ×1

Quest Description:
Queen Kelly has resolutely rejected the threats and coercion of the gods and demons from all realms.
She is the only human force in this world that has never been manipulated by the hands of the non-human races.
If humanity refuses to obediently become puppets and slaves of other worlds, then the entire myriad realms will regard them as enemies that must be eradicated!
Protect Queen Kelly, and slaughter every enemy who dares invade.
Time Limit: 9:58:58
Quest Reward: Hidden Instance [Flame of Heritage] Unlock Scroll, forbidden-grade Archer Class Awakening Scroll ×1

chapters.title: Chapter 178 -178-Blood-Soaked Slaughter, Unafraid of Gods and Demons
paragraphs: After reading the quest panel, Daniel understood everything at once.
[To the Last Drop of Blood] was the final battle of this hidden instance.
And the reward for clearing it just happened to be the starting point of the next instance.
That next instance was the main storyline of the game’s new version: [Flame of Heritage].
So everything had been linked together all along, one chain interlocking with the next.
What surprised him even more was the Class Awakening Scroll.
With that item, he would no longer need to take another class advancement quest.
He was only level 170 right now, but once he completed the [Holy Angel Legion] class change quest, he could use that scroll directly.
At that thought, he suddenly stopped walking.
Kelly looked at him in confusion.
Daniel said calmly, "I’ll wait here for the powerful enemies of the non-human races. You go prepare for the coronation ceremony."
He was a forbidden-grade archer, a class with rather unusual traits.
Protection had never been his strength.
Destruction was.
If a real battle broke out and he dropped a forbidden spell at full force, Luminara City would probably be reduced to ruins.
So he could only remain outside the city gates.
Kelly smiled faintly and said softly, "All right."
Riding her dragon steed, she flew toward the city.
The moment Kelly returned, the human powerhouses finally let out relieved sighs.
They had truly thought Her Majesty was not coming back.
Mounted on her war dragon, Kelly looked down upon her people and declared in a ringing voice, "Continue the ceremony!"
The master of ceremonies heard the order and hurriedly shouted, "Continue the ceremony! War drums—sound!"
Boom! Boom! Boom!
At once, rhythmic war drums thundered across the city, each beat like the pulse of the earth itself.
"They’re finally here."
Daniel hovered in midair, his robes snapping loudly in the wind.

At the edge of his vision, boundless black clouds came surging forward. On the ground below marched infantry and cavalry clad in black robes and black armor, stretching so far that no end could be seen.
"The Soul Devourers!"
They were the first non-human race to appear.
This time, they had mobilized everything they had. Their numbers reached several million.
When the players below the city walls saw the Soul Devourers, their eyes turned red with rage.
"Brothers, enough talk! The ones in the sky are for the guild leader—those on the ground are ours!"
"Stop yapping and kill these non-human bastards!"
"Charge!"
Several hundred players brandished their weapons and rushed headlong toward the millions-strong army of Soul Devourer warriors.
Watching them, Daniel’s lips curved upward slightly.
"After today, there will be no more Soul Devourers left in this world."
Whoosh—
His figure flashed and vanished.
When he appeared again, he was already charging straight into the black clouds.
"Hunting Domain!"
"Shadowfont!"
Inside the clouds were nothing but legendary-grade experts of the Soul Devourers.
"Arrogant human, you seek death!"
"Surround him! I’ll savor his flesh bit by bit and make him die in agony!"
"Cripple him!"
In an instant, attacks from the Soul Devourer elites poured down like a storm, blotting out the sky as they smashed toward Daniel.
Whoosh!
Daniel used Flash and slipped out of their encirclement in an instant.
When he reappeared, ninety-nine clones had lined up in the void behind him in perfect formation.
"Skyfall Strike!"
"Permafrost Prison!"
"Thunder Abyss!"
Terrifying forbidden spells surged forth like a wrathful tidal wave, and the heavens and earth changed color.
Every Soul Devourer expert was swallowed within their range.
Only now did they finally taste what true despair felt like.
A dense flood of kill notifications exploded in Daniel’s ears like a tsunami.
He did not even spare them a glance.
The loot dropped in this instance no longer meant anything to him.
In almost the blink of an eye, the Soul Devourer elites were completely annihilated.
Daniel stepped out from the Godscar.
At that very moment, yet another army of non-human races arrived—it was the Shadowkin.
And within their formation were several terrifying presences, beings at the transcendent legendary-grade.
"You there, blocking the path ahead—what exactly do you mean by this?"
In the distance, a Shadowkin expert shouted sharply.
Daniel answered indifferently, "I’m borrowing your heads for a little amusement."
"Idiot!"
The Shadowkin expert’s face darkened, and he no longer bothered wasting words.
Whoosh!
Murderous intent boiled in Daniel’s eyes as he shot into the air to meet them head-on.
Inside Luminara City.
Tap.
Tap, tap!
Kelly ascended the high platform step by step.
Before her lay more than a million human subjects prostrated on the ground.
"Queen Kelly!"
"May Queen Kelly’s radiance endure forever!"
"Long live Her Majesty the Queen!"
The cries shook the heavens, the crowd roaring like a boiling sea.
Yet Kelly’s gaze was fixed on the distant horizon.
A bloody battle was raging there.
Countless corpses and torrents of blood were falling from the Godscar like a storm.
"May Her Majesty the Queen deliver her address!"
The crowd instantly fell silent. Millions of eyes turned toward their queen.
A blazing battle intent burned in Kelly’s eyes.
She suddenly drew her sword, its edge cold as frost.
"The ideal our human race pursues—equality and dignity—shall never cease!"
"Whoever stands in the way of that path, humanity shall declare war upon!"
"Whoever seeks to enslave us, humanity shall strike down!"
"The warriors of mankind are willing to fight for all living beings, fearing neither death nor gods nor demons—until the very last drop of blood is shed!"
The moment her words fell, the roar of the human people rose like mountains collapsing and seas overturning.
"War! War!!"
"Fear neither death nor gods nor demons!"
"Hunting Domain!"
"Shadowfont!"
"Skyfall Strike!"
"Permafrost Prison!"
"Thunder Abyss!"
At this moment, Daniel was like a supreme god who governed life and death.
Under wave after wave of forbidden spells, countless Shadowkin experts screamed in agony inside the spell zones.
Those Shadowkin who had once stood high above all others, who had enslaved countless races and regarded all life as ants, were just as fragile before Daniel.
"This is impossible! Since when did the human race produce someone this monstrous?"
"If a supreme-grade being doesn’t appear, who could possibly defeat him?!"
"Damn it, where did this freak even come from?!"
In no more than a few breaths, the Shadowkin army had been slaughtered to the last man.
Once again, the players’ understanding of Daniel’s combat power was completely overturned.

They themselves were fighting fiercely against the lesser enemies on the ground, and plenty of them had already fallen. But compared to their guild leader, their battle looked like little more than primitive men swinging clubs.
"So this is the guild leader’s true strength?"
"Good lord... one forbidden spell from the guild leader could blow an entire forest to pieces!"
"The key point is, it’s infinite forbidden spells! His MP seems bottomless, and they’re all instant-cast! Who the hell can withstand that?"
"Holy shit, this is our guild leader’s power!?"
"You’ve got to be kidding me. Back in the Battle of Desperation, he wiped out hundreds of millions of monsters in two days—did you think that was a joke? Do you even know what a forbidden spell is?"
"This is way too absurd, isn’t it? Isn’t he basically a walking nuclear strike? Wherever he goes, everything gets flattened!"
Daniel stepped out from the battlefield of the Demon Realm.
The Godkin, the Demon Realm, the Undead Realm, the Spirit Realm...
The experts of the myriad worlds of the star sea came pouring in like a flood.
The sheer scale of it was so vast that words could hardly describe it.
On the enemy side alone, there were over ten thousand legendary-grade experts!
With such an overwhelming number of legendary-grade beings, even a supreme-grade existence could probably be buried alive under sheer numbers.
Yet the players were not the least bit worried for their guild leader.
Numbers?
To the great god Faustus, that was never a problem at all.

chapters.title: Chapter 179 -179-Farewell, Kelly’s Gift
paragraphs: Watching this scene unfold, Daniel clenched Stellar Wrath so tightly that it creaked in his grip.
He turned into a streak of light and charged forward at the very front of the battlefield!
So what if there were over ten thousand experts?
You lofty, high-and-mighty beings—when had any of you ever truly looked at lives as insignificant as ants?
Today, I’ll make you bow those arrogant heads!
"Kill—!"
Countless experts surged forward, and a storm of skills rained down on Daniel from all directions.
Daniel drew Stellar Wrath, and forbidden spells poured forth in a torrent!
Millions of burning meteors fell from the heavens, while great flakes of snow drifted gently downward.
But every single snowflake was a lethal weapon.
Countless bolts of lightning infused with thunder element struck the legendary-grade experts like they had gone mad.
Strings of damage numbers floated into the air.
At some point, a fine drizzle began to fall from the sky.
A rain the color of blood.
It was a scene of madness and carnage taken to the absolute extreme.
Kelly stood in the rain, letting it soak her.
She was already a peak legendary-grade powerhouse. She could have kept every drop from touching her.
But in this moment, she deliberately allowed the rain to fall on her body.
Her gaze never once left the distant battlefield on the horizon.
That was the core battlefield.
If the human race won, they would have hope of rising up and becoming masters of their own fate.
If the human race lost, they would remain forever the slaves of the non-human races.
And at this very moment, the outcome of victory or defeat rested entirely on one person.
Faustus!
Under Daniel’s relentless bombardment of forbidden spells, many legendary-grade experts did not even last a second before being instantly killed.
Faced with such terrifying forbidden spells, those legendary-grade experts went completely mad.
"How can a human possibly know forbidden spells?!"
"Are all you Godkin idiots? You actually passed forbidden spells to the human race?!"
"Godkin, you fools! Don’t tell me this is all some act you staged yourselves?!"
"An act? More like certain idiots never expected to be bitten back by their own slaves!"
As they died, the experts of every race screamed curses at the Godkin.
They could not understand it. Forbidden spells were supposed to be the Godkin’s most closely guarded secret—so how could this human use them?
Naturally, the first ones they suspected were the Godkin.
After all, it was the Godkin who had backed two of the Three Human Emperors, and they were the strongest force in this starry expanse.
But the Godkin experts themselves were dumbfounded.
Forbidden spells were the Godkin’s secret arts. How could they possibly have been handed to a human so casually?

And yet what was happening before their eyes was undeniable—a human expert was using forbidden spells to slaughter more than ten thousand legendary-grade powerhouses without leaving a single survivor.
"Which idiot did this?!"
"I refuse to accept this!"
The Godkin experts no longer even bothered to argue.
And arguing was pointless anyway, because death would soon come for them as well.
Boom!
With a thunderous crash, the Godscar dissipated.
A figure appeared once more.
Daniel stepped out of the Godscar and looked toward the players’ side of the battlefield.
By now, only a handful of players remained.
Those few who had managed to hold out until the end lasted only a few seconds more before they too were killed by the non-human races from the various worlds of the star sea.
Daniel coldly drew back Stellar Wrath.
"Permafrost Prison!"
Crash!
Once again, every living thing on the ground was wiped out in an instant.
At the same time—
[Ding! You have completed the quest [To the Last Drop of Blood]!]
[Notice: You have obtained the activation scroll for the special instance [Flame of Heritage].]
[Notice: You have obtained [forbidden-grade archer Class Awakening Scroll (Level 180)] ×1!]
The quest chain was complete!
Daniel ignored the Class Awakening Scroll for now. He still could not use it yet.
Instead, he took out the instance activation scroll.
[Flame of Heritage (Special Instance)] (Exclusive to Faustus)
Usage Requirement: legendary-grade
Current Status: Cannot enter
Daniel let out a long breath.
Well, this instance sure was picky.
It required legendary-grade status to enter, and he was still a ways off from that threshold. For now, he could only set it aside.
He stuffed the scroll into his inventory and lifted his head to scan the surroundings.
As far as the eye could see, there was not a single living creature left.
"So it’s finally over."
The moment he spoke, the entire space trembled with a buzzing rumble, as if someone had flipped it over from below.
"Scene transition—"
Daniel had gone back and forth inside this instance several times already. He was long used to it.
His expression did not change. He simply let the world before his eyes turn with a great whoosh, like the flipping of a page.
When he could see clearly again, he found that he was standing in Soul Devouring Vale once more.
It was still that same bright afternoon, with crystal-clear lake water and a soft breeze as smooth as silk.
Only now, the lakeshore was empty.
The girl who had once sat there barefoot washing her feet was nowhere to be seen.
It was as though it had all been a dream, leaving nothing behind when he awoke.
[Ding! The instance will close in three minutes.]
[Ding! The instance will close in one minute.]
Listening to the system’s cold countdown, Daniel did not hurry. He merely stood there in silence.
Then suddenly—
A streak of golden light shot across the distance, its trailing glow like a golden sword cleaving the sky in two.
Whoosh!
Clad in dazzling golden armor, Kelly landed hard in front of him, kicking up a gust of wind.
Daniel’s eyes lit up.
[Ding! The instance will close in fifty seconds.]
Fine beads of sweat covered Kelly’s forehead. She had clearly flown here at top speed, yet she did not even bother wiping them away.
She smiled at Daniel, though there was a trace of urgency in it. "Big Brother Faustus... are you leaving?"
Daniel smiled faintly. "Mm. It’s time for me to go back."
Kelly’s smile froze on her face.
She lowered her head, her voice so soft it was almost as if she feared disturbing something fragile. "Then... in the future... will I still be able to see you again?"
"Yes."
Daniel answered without the slightest hesitation.
"Really?"
Kelly suddenly lifted her head, and her eyes lit up like two lamps being kindled.
Seeing the look on her face, Daniel could not help but laugh.
"A legendary-grade expert can live for hundreds, even thousands of years as if it were nothing. As long as you live well, we’ll meet again sooner or later."
"Then it’s a promise! When the time comes, let’s meet here again, all right?"
Kelly looked at him eagerly.
Daniel nodded and agreed.
Only then did Kelly smile again, her eyes curving like crescents, as sweet as if she had stolen honey.
Suddenly, she extended one hand, palm down, fingers curled into a fist.
"Big Brother Faustus, I have something for you."
Daniel blinked. "What is it?"
"Just hold out your hand..."
Kelly’s cheeks flushed slightly red.
Daniel extended his hand.
He felt something warm fall into his palm, like a small stone that had been lying in the sun.
[Ding! The instance will close in five seconds.]
[Ding! The instance is about to close!]
The last thing Daniel saw was Kelly’s blushing smile, bright as the most radiant light in all of Soul Devouring Vale.
Whoosh—!
The scene before his eyes suddenly changed.
He had returned to the main world.
Squinting slightly, he looked around. It was broad daylight in Aetheria.
And the place where he stood was, unexpectedly, just outside Luminara.
Whether that landing point was coincidence or random chance, he had no idea.
He shook his head, still thinking about what had just happened.
The item Kelly had stuffed into his hand at the very end had not even triggered a system notification.
Could this "gift" be some kind of special item?
He lowered his head and slowly opened his palm.
Resting in his hand was a bracelet woven from multicolored cords.
The craftsmanship was not especially fine. It carried a rough, handmade quality, but every knot had been tied securely. It was obvious that real care had gone into making it.
"Hm?"
He leaned in for a closer look.
There were actually several strands of golden hair woven into the bracelet as well, twisted tightly together with the colored cord.
This was...
Kelly’s hair?
Daniel fell silent.

"Big Brother Faustus... are you leaving?"
Daniel smiled faintly.
"Mm.
It’s time for me to go back."
Kelly’s smile froze on her face.
She lowered her head, her voice so soft it was almost as if she feared disturbing something fragile.
"Then... in the future... will I still be able to see you again?"
"Yes."
Daniel answered without the slightest hesitation.
"Really?"
Kelly suddenly lifted her head, and her eyes lit up like two lamps being kindled.
Seeing the look on her face, Daniel could not help but laugh.
"A legendary-grade expert can live for hundreds, even thousands of years as if it were nothing.
As long as you live well, we’ll meet again sooner or later."
"Then it’s a promise!
When the time comes, let’s meet here again, all right?"
Kelly looked at him eagerly.
Daniel nodded and agreed.
Only then did Kelly smile again, her eyes curving like crescents, as sweet as if she had stolen honey.
Suddenly, she extended one hand, palm down, fingers curled into a fist.
"Big Brother Faustus, I have something for you."
Daniel blinked.
"What is it?"
"Just hold out your hand..."
Kelly’s cheeks flushed slightly red.
Daniel extended his hand.
He felt something warm fall into his palm, like a small stone that had been lying in the sun.
[Ding!
The instance will close in five seconds.]
[Ding!
The instance is about to close!]
The last thing Daniel saw was Kelly’s blushing smile, bright as the most radiant light in all of Soul Devouring Vale.
Whoosh—!
The scene before his eyes suddenly changed.
He had returned to the main world.
Squinting slightly, he looked around.
It was broad daylight in Aetheria.
And the place where he stood was, unexpectedly, just outside Luminara.
Whether that landing point was coincidence or random chance, he had no idea.
He shook his head, still thinking about what had just happened.
The item Kelly had stuffed into his hand at the very end had not even triggered a system notification.
Could this "gift" be some kind of special item?
He lowered his head and slowly opened his palm.
Resting in his hand was a bracelet woven from multicolored cords.
The craftsmanship was not especially fine.
It carried a rough, handmade quality, but every knot had been tied securely.
It was obvious that real care had gone into making it.
"Hm?"
He leaned in for a closer look.
There were actually several strands of golden hair woven into the bracelet as well, twisted tightly together with the colored cord.
This was...
Kelly’s hair?
Daniel fell silent.

chapters.title: Chapter 180 -180-Angel King, Holywing Angels
paragraphs: At the same time—

[World Announcement: Player "Faustus" has successfully activated the hidden instance [Ancient Echo]! All players may complete the prerequisite quest to obtain an instance key and enter the instance to personally experience the arduous struggle of humanity’s ancestors one hundred thousand years ago!]
The moment the announcement came out, the entire world of Stellar exploded.
An instance!
And a hidden instance at that!
One run inside meant a huge profit no matter what!
It did not take long before some players stumbled upon instance keys while doing their daily quest chains, while others got them as direct drops from monsters.
Like people flocking to a market fair, everyone rushed into the instance in swarms.
But when they came back out, every one of them wore a strange expression.
Because it did not take long for everyone to discover one thing—
Each player’s experience inside the instance was different!
There was, however, one detail that everyone noticed after coming out.
At the entrance to Soul Devouring Vale, two statues had been erected.
The more some players looked at those two statues, the more familiar they seemed.
"That guy... doesn’t he look exactly like our guild leader Faustus?"
"The woman looks familiar too. Isn’t that Queen Kelly?"
"Hiss— our guild leader is truly unbeatable! He actually got involved with Queen Kelly, one of the Three Human Emperors!"
"Tsk tsk, what do you mean ’got involved’? Aren’t you tired of living in this game? But seriously, whatever happened to Queen Kelly afterward?"
"She mysteriously disappeared! A hundred thousand years ago, Queen Kelly suddenly vanished without a trace. Otherwise, how could her faction have been wiped out?"
"That’s right. After that, it was Emperor Abraham’s turn to unite the human race, and then he turned around and acknowledged the Godkin as his masters."
"Holy shit, the people writing history were way too lazy, weren’t they? ’Mysteriously disappeared’? That’s such a half-assed explanation!"
"Exactly. I could make up something better with my feet!"
Daniel had gained quite a few benefits from this trip through the instance.
The Class Awakening Scroll from the final quest reward would save him quite a bit of trouble in the future.
As for the exclusive instance called [Flame of Heritage], one look was enough to tell him that it was absolutely tied to the main storyline of the new version. It was definitely no simple thing.
Unfortunately, neither of those items could be used right now, so he tossed them into his inventory to gather dust for the time being.
Then he sat down and sorted through the matters currently at hand.
The first issue: the full-scale World War had not started yet!
That was because the mainstream player base still fell a little short in both level and numbers, though by his estimate, it would not be long now.
When that time came, he not only intended to participate—he also meant to seize every benefit for himself.
For example, the Temples of the Gods in every World Zone.
Each World Zone had two supreme-grade slots, and he was determined to claim them.
Then there were the non-human race factions in each World Zone. Every faction had one or two supreme-grade powerhouses.
He planned to recruit every single one of those non-human supreme-grade experts into his own ranks.
That way, he would gain a whole army of supreme-grade enforcers under his command.
There was also the matter of developing the Aerial Realm.
Right now, the players’ levels were still too low. Dealing with the monsters of the Aerial Realm was a bit too difficult for them.
They naturally could not handle legendary-grade monsters yet, meaning they could only farm the ordinary ones.
But those monsters dropped neither experience nor gold coins, which made them poor targets for player growth and a waste of time.
It would be best to wait until the players reached a leveling bottleneck before arranging for them to begin opening up the Aerial Realm.
Of course, the most pressing matter at the moment was still his class change quest!
The class change quest he had accepted was [Form the Holy Angel Legion], which meant he had to make a trip to the Angel Plane.
After the new version launched, the entrance to the Angel Plane would appear, but Daniel could not be bothered with all that trouble.
"I’ve got an Angelic Crystal in my hands!"
Daniel’s eyes lit up.
With that thought, he took out the Angelic Crystal.
[Ding! Are you sure you want to use [Angelic Crystal]? Note: After use, you will be directly teleported to the [Temple of Heavenly Light] in the Angel Plane!]
Daniel’s face lit up with excitement. "Use it! Use it!"
[Ding! Use successful. Beginning teleportation!]
Whoosh—!
When he opened his eyes again, he had already arrived in the Angel Plane!
[Ding! Congratulations, you have discovered the Angel Plane. Contribution Points +1,000,000!]
While listening to the system notification, Daniel looked around.
He was standing inside a grand hall so luxurious it was almost absurd.
Everything was made of crystal—crystal walls, crystal ceilings, even the lamp stands were crystal!
The entire hall glittered so brightly it was almost blinding.
Just as the legends said, the angel race really did love all things shiny.
In front of Daniel stood a statue of the Angel King.
He casually threw an appraisal skill at it.
[Angel King Statue (peak supreme-grade)] (Angel King avatar)
"Supreme-grade?"
Daniel blinked and instantly understood.
This Angel Plane, like his Aerial Realm, was a small world.
And the maximum power a small world could bear was only supreme-grade. It did not matter how powerful the Angel King’s true body was—it could never descend here in full.
So the one remaining here was definitely just an avatar. The true body could be anywhere else.
Still, not having to face the Angel King at supreme-grade was excellent news!
After all, he still had a quest hanging over him.
He had to train at least one hundred Holywing warriors.
He had no intention of wasting time here. As long as he kept quiet, gathered some equipment, and developed steadily, that would be enough.
Daniel turned and headed straight out of the angelic temple.
Whether he came to the Angel Plane or not was one thing—but now that he was here, there was no way he was going back empty-handed.
The moment he left, the statue of the Angel King behind him slowly opened its eyes.
It let out a cold snort and muttered to itself,
"This human bears a blood-deep enmity with my angel race, yet he somehow obtained an Angelic Crystal?"
"And he thinks I’m going to grant his wish? Dream on!"
Daniel flew high above the Angel Plane.
The Angel Plane was not particularly large—about the same size as Aetheria.
He remembered that in his previous life, one player had acquired a hidden class called Hymn Priest.
That person had once revealed on the forums that the Angel Plane had no fewer than a million Holywing Angels.
Holywing Angels—every last one of them was a legendary-grade warrior of the angel race!
What a terrifying force that was!
Daniel could understand it, though.
Like the other top-tier races, the angels were an innate race.
In other words, as they aged, their strength naturally rose with them.
As long as they were not useless, simply reaching adulthood was enough for them to attain legendary-grade.
Unlike races such as humans, beastfolk, sea folk, and dwarves, who had to struggle desperately in battle and push themselves constantly in order to enter the ranks of the strong.
So the fact that the angel race had over a million Holywing Angels was not strange at all.
If not for the difficulty of their reproduction, their numbers would probably have been even greater.
As Daniel was thinking over these things, he had already flown above a city.
Holy Light City!
The moment he came to a stop above Holy Light City, several hundred angel patrol guards flew toward him.
"No further! Who are you?"
"Do you have a pass?"
Of course Daniel did not.
He gave the patrol guards an up-and-down look and discovered that every last one of them was legendary-grade.
So these were the Holywing Angels?
They looked fairly young. They should be quite suitable as enforcers.
When the angel patrol captain saw that Daniel said nothing and that his eyes were still darting around shiftily, he immediately grew angry and signaled his subordinates to prepare for battle.
Daniel frowned.
Were all angels this hot-tempered?
He tossed out a calm reply. "You want to fight? Then come."
The moment he finished speaking, he drew back Stellar Wrath!
"Wind’s Embrace!"
"Hunting Domain!"
"Shadowfont!"
"Aetherlance!"
Whoosh, whoosh, whoosh—!
Several arrows glowing with holy radiance shot out and pierced straight through the angel captain before him!

[Ding! You have killed the angel expert Riels. You have obtained [Holywing Battle Armor (legendary-grade)], [Holy Feather (legendary-grade)], [Blood of Angel (legendary-grade)], gold coins +2,000,000!]

chapters.title: Chapter 181 -181-The Wrath of the Angel King
paragraphs: The patrol captain... had died just like that!?
The minds of the patrol angels buzzed blankly, and every one of them froze in shock.
For tens of thousands of years, no one had ever dared to make a move in the Angel Plane.
To kill an angel expert on the angel race’s own territory—this was nothing short of overturning the heavens!
Very quickly, once they came back to their senses, the angel warriors’ eyes turned red as they stared at Daniel.
"Kill him! He dared to murder one of our angel race—his crime is unforgivable!"
"Riels! No! Why did you kill Riels?!"
"Capture him and force him to tell us who sent him!"
As they shouted, the patrol angels hurled all kinds of skills at Daniel in a storm.
"So stupid?"
Daniel shook his head helplessly. It seemed he had still been too soft just now.
Could these foolish angels really not see the difference in strength between the two sides?
He drew Stellar Wrath once more!
"Wind’s Embrace!"
"Hunting Domain!"
"Shadowfont!"
"Aetherlance!"
[Ding! You have killed the angel expert Kenka. You have obtained [Holywing Gauntlets (legendary-grade)], [Holy Feather (legendary-grade)], [Blood of Angel (legendary-grade)], gold coins +1,800,000!]
[Ding! You have killed the angel expert Aaron. You have obtained [Holywing Sword (legendary-grade)], [Holy Feather (legendary-grade)], [Blood of Angel (legendary-grade)], gold coins +2,100,000!]
[Ding! You have killed the angel expert Zorrod. You have obtained [Holywing Scepter (legendary-grade)], [Holy Feather (legendary-grade)], [Blood of Angel (legendary-grade)], gold coins +2,100,000!]
Daniel blinked away from every incoming attack.
Each time he pulled back Stellar Wrath, the angel experts before him collapsed as if they were made of paper.
In one breath, he killed more than a dozen angel experts!
Only when fear began to appear on the faces of the remaining angels did he stop.
"By the Angel King... is this human a devil?!"
"Angel King, how did this human break into our world?!"
"I... I am one of the bravest Holywing Angels. I-I cannot submit..."
Daniel swept a cold glance across the surviving angel experts, his voice as frigid as ice.
"Surrender, or die."
At that moment—
A shrill war horn suddenly resounded throughout the entire Angel Plane!
At once, countless answering horns echoed from every corner of the Angel Plane.
Then, an enraged roar exploded between heaven and earth!
"You wretched human! You dare spill blood in my Angel Plane—you deserve death!"
The patrol angels’ faces immediately lit up with joy when they heard that voice.
"It’s the Angel King!"
"His Majesty has arrived!"
"That damned human—His Majesty will definitely tear him apart!"
Daniel curled his lip and gave a cold laugh.
So what if the Angel King had come?
It was nothing more than an avatar.
Woooo—!
Woooo—!
Woooo—!
It was as if the Angel Plane had been jolted awake by the Angel King’s furious roar.
Every corner, every patch of sky rang with the cries of Holywing Angels.
In the blink of an eye, countless Holywing Angels swarmed in from all directions, a black mass so vast it blotted out the sky.
At that same moment, a dazzling golden figure descended with overwhelming pressure.
The Angel King had arrived!
Daniel glanced around.
By now, several thousand Holywing Angels had already surrounded him so tightly that not even water could leak through.
Every one of these angels was legendary-grade.
And the Angel King himself was a peak supreme-grade existence.
Yet Daniel’s expression did not change in the slightest.
"Human! You dared slaughter my people!"
The Angel King’s voice was like thunder exploding in the heavens, shaking the entire Angel Plane.
In furious rage, he demanded, "Lowly human, who gave you the courage?!"
Daniel frowned slightly and said flatly, "Lowly?"
"You angels really do think far too highly of yourselves."
His gaze swept across the thousands upon thousands of Holywing Angels before him, a faint sneer curling at the corner of his mouth.
Murderous intent surged in the Angel King’s eyes as his enormous wings spread wide in the air.
"Erase him!"
The several thousand Holywing Angels who had long been prepared attacked at once.
Some chanted ancient holy hymns under their breath, drawing on the elemental power of heaven and earth.
Others relied on their incomparably powerful bodies and charged straight at Daniel with savage force.
At that moment, let alone Daniel—
Even a supreme-grade expert would have a hard time if besieged by so many Holywing Angels.
But Daniel was not supreme-grade.
He was even more troublesome than a supreme-grade expert!
A great number of negative curses came crashing down on him all at once, only to be instantly purified in the blink of an eye.
Completely unhurried, he used movement skills to blink from one opening to another, instantly summoning ninety-nine clones while drawing back Stellar Wrath at the same time!
"Hunting Domain!"
"Shadowfont!"
Under the enhancement of Hunting Domain and Shadowfont, the Holywing Angels’ strength seemed to plummet by half in an instant!
"Skyfall Strike!"
"Permafrost Prison!"
"Thunder Abyss!"
The moment those three forbidden spells were unleashed, they exploded into tens of thousands of manifestations in an instant!
The area of effect was so vast that it covered every single Holywing Angel.
Seeing this, the Angel King’s eyes nearly popped out of their sockets in shock.
"What kind of joke is this?"
"This human is actually this powerful?!"
In the blink of an eye, countless Holywing Angels fell beneath the violent bombardment of fire, ice, and thunder.
Under the forbidden spells, innumerable Holywing Angels were reduced to ashes.
System notifications rang nonstop in Daniel’s ears.

After killing so many legendary-grade experts, he had obtained a huge quantity of high-quality legendary-grade equipment and materials. Once he sold them to the guild, a single round of Millionfold Boost feedback would be enough to net him an enormous profit!
By now, the Angel King was almost insane with rage.
He wanted to save his people, yet he could do nothing.
Daniel’s forbidden spells were too fast and too destructive.
Several thousand Holywing Angels were being cut down like grass, and the Angel King’s heart ached so badly it felt like it was shattering.
"Holy Light Divine Realm!"
The Angel King completely lost control and used a divine domain that only a supreme-grade powerhouse could wield.
A crack suddenly tore open in the void, and within it appeared a terrifying phantom of the Angel King.
The destructive force of the forbidden spells was completely blocked by that phantom.
The Angel King roared, "Today, my angel race will never let this go!"
At that moment, Daniel’s forbidden spells also came to a stop.
Because every last Holywing Angel was already dead!
Faced with the Angel King’s threat, he did not care in the slightest.
"Aren’t you afraid I’ll turn your entire Angel Plane upside down?"
The Angel King roared back, "If you exterminate my angel race, then I’ll exterminate your human race!"
Daniel’s expression turned grave.
Although things had developed a little off course, fortunately he had already prepared a backup plan.
Acting tough, were they?
Then let’s see how tough they really are.
He took a deep breath and spread open his fingers.
"Come out."
The moment the words left his mouth, the Ring of Void on his hand flashed.
Whoosh! Whoosh! Whoosh! Whoosh!
Four figures appeared out of thin air.
Carodion, Aliris, Yilin, and Yier!
Four supreme-grade human experts.
"My King!"
All four supreme-grade experts turned toward Daniel in unison.
The instant the Angel King saw Daniel summon four supreme-grade experts at once, a bad feeling immediately rose in his heart.
This... was going to be trouble.
Daniel looked at the Angel King with open mockery, a cold sneer lifting his lips as he said icily,
"Kill it."

Daniel glanced around.
By now, several thousand Holywing Angels had already surrounded him so tightly that not even water could leak through.
Every one of these angels was legendary-grade.
And the Angel King himself was a peak supreme-grade existence.
Yet Daniel’s expression did not change in the slightest.
"Human!
You dared slaughter my people!"
The Angel King’s voice was like thunder exploding in the heavens, shaking the entire Angel Plane.
In furious rage, he demanded, "Lowly human, who gave you the courage?!"
Daniel frowned slightly and said flatly, "Lowly?"
"You angels really do think far too highly of yourselves."
His gaze swept across the thousands upon thousands of Holywing Angels before him, a faint sneer curling at the corner of his mouth.
Murderous intent surged in the Angel King’s eyes as his enormous wings spread wide in the air.
"Erase him!"
The several thousand Holywing Angels who had long been prepared attacked at once.
Some chanted ancient holy hymns under their breath, drawing on the elemental power of heaven and earth.
Others relied on their incomparably powerful bodies and charged straight at Daniel with savage force.
At that moment, let alone Daniel—
Even a supreme-grade expert would have a hard time if besieged by so many Holywing Angels.
But Daniel was not supreme-grade.
He was even more troublesome than a supreme-grade expert!
A great number of negative curses came crashing down on him all at once, only to be instantly purified in the blink of an eye.
Completely unhurried, he used movement skills to blink from one opening to another, instantly summoning ninety-nine clones while drawing back Stellar Wrath at the same time!
"Hunting Domain!"
"Shadowfont!"
Under the enhancement of Hunting Domain and Shadowfont, the Holywing Angels’ strength seemed to plummet by half in an instant!
"Skyfall Strike!"
"Permafrost Prison!"
"Thunder Abyss!"
The moment those three forbidden spells were unleashed, they exploded into tens of thousands of manifestations in an instant!
The area of effect was so vast that it covered every single Holywing Angel.
Seeing this, the Angel King’s eyes nearly popped out of their sockets in shock.
"What kind of joke is this?"
"This human is actually this powerful?!"
In the blink of an eye, countless Holywing Angels fell beneath the violent bombardment of fire, ice, and thunder.
Under the forbidden spells, innumerable Holywing Angels were reduced to ashes.
System notifications rang nonstop in Daniel’s ears.
After killing so many legendary-grade experts, he had obtained a huge quantity of high-quality legendary-grade equipment and materials.
Once he sold them to the guild, a single round of Millionfold Boost feedback would be enough to net him an enormous profit!
By now, the Angel King was almost insane with rage.
He wanted to save his people, yet he could do nothing.
Daniel’s forbidden spells were too fast and too destructive.
Several thousand Holywing Angels were being cut down like grass, and the Angel King’s heart ached so badly it felt like it was shattering.
"Holy Light Divine Realm!"
The Angel King completely lost control and used a divine domain that only a supreme-grade powerhouse could wield.
A crack suddenly tore open in the void, and within it appeared a terrifying phantom of the Angel King.
The destructive force of the forbidden spells was completely blocked by that phantom.
The Angel King roared, "Today, my angel race will never let this go!"
At that moment, Daniel’s forbidden spells also came to a stop.
Because every last Holywing Angel was already dead!
Faced with the Angel King’s threat, he did not care in the slightest.
"Aren’t you afraid I’ll turn your entire Angel Plane upside down?"
The Angel King roared back, "If you exterminate my angel race, then I’ll exterminate your human race!"
Daniel’s expression turned grave.
Although things had developed a little off course, fortunately he had already prepared a backup plan.
Acting tough, were they?
Then let’s see how tough they really are.
He took a deep breath and spread open his fingers.
"Come out."
The moment the words left his mouth, the Ring of Void on his hand flashed.
Whoosh!
Whoosh!
Whoosh!
Whoosh!
Four figures appeared out of thin air.
Carodion, Aliris, Yilin, and Yier!
Four supreme-grade human experts.
"My King!"
All four supreme-grade experts turned toward Daniel in unison.
The instant the Angel King saw Daniel summon four supreme-grade experts at once, a bad feeling immediately rose in his heart.
This... was going to be trouble.
Daniel looked at the Angel King with open mockery, a cold sneer lifting his lips as he said icily,
"Kill it."

chapters.title: Chapter 182 -182-Slaying the Angel King, Uproar!
paragraphs: The four supreme-grade experts turned their heads and stared coldly at the Angel King, without the slightest hesitation in their eyes.
Even if Daniel had ordered them to die, they would not have frowned, let alone when all they had to deal with was a peak supreme-grade Angel King... avatar.
Boom! Boom! Boom! Boom!
The four supreme-grade human powerhouses decisively unleashed their respective divine realms.
Though they had not yet reached their peak states, they were still elites personally cultivated by Daniel, equipped with the best gear and the strongest skills.
"Attack!"
With a loud shout, Carodion charged first at the Angel King.
The other three supreme-grade experts followed immediately and attacked as well.
Faced with the siege of four supreme-grade humans, the Angel King gritted his teeth and endured it head-on.
A small world could not contain a Divine-grade lifeform. The Angel King’s true body had always roamed the starfields, and what remained here was merely an avatar.
But even an avatar of a Divine-grade being was no simple opponent.
Daniel drew back Stellar Wrath, burning Immortal Singularity like mad to amplify his skills.
"Hunting Domain!"
"Shadowfont!"
"Wind’s Embrace!"
"Aetherlance!"
Under the enhancement of Immortal Singularity, Daniel’s skills became monstrously powerful.
The negative statuses hanging on the Angel King could no longer be cleansed so easily.
If the Angel King wanted to remove them, he would have to burn even more Immortal Singularity.
And Daniel’s attack power soared by more than a hundredfold in an instant!
This time, Daniel was fighting without regard for cost.
The consumption of Immortal Singularity alone was dropping by several hundred points per second!
And the Angel King truly was formidable.
Facing the encirclement of four supreme-grade human experts, plus Daniel—the lunatic who was spending Immortal Singularity with utter abandon—he struggled badly, yet still held on.
The four supreme-grade humans had only recently advanced. Going head-to-head against an old monster at the Angel King’s level, they were injured within moments.
But Daniel was not worried in the least.
The Immortal Singularity in his hands was spent on them as if it were worthless, wave after wave without restraint.
No matter how serious their injuries were, they were nearly healed in the blink of an eye.
At this moment, Daniel was like one of those all-purpose players in an instance run.
He could deal damage, heal, and support—there was nothing he could not do.
With that absurd ability to keep them alive indefinitely, the four supreme-grade experts quickly beat the Angel King into utter misery.
"Damn it—!"
The Angel King howled in pain.
Not even in his dreams had he expected that after countless tens of thousands of years of peace, he would fall into the hands of these humans today.
The angel race was one of the innate races, an existence even the Godkin and Shadowkin would not lightly provoke.
And yet now, they had actually been driven to this state by the human race, whom they viewed as ants?
These humans were simply unforgivable!
"Wait—I cannot lose!"
"If I lose, what will happen to the angel race?"
The Angel King suddenly realized the true weight of the situation.
Not even during the world-destroying war of antiquity had he thought about this question.
He had stood tall through endless ages and weathered countless storms, yet only now did he finally begin to worry about his people.
Seeing that he was already faltering, Daniel immediately gave the order.
"Stop holding back. Kill him!"
The four supreme-grade human experts were now at full strength.
With Daniel’s nearly inexhaustible supply of Immortal Singularity backing them, this was the most lavish battle they had ever fought in their lives.
They threw every trump card they had at the Angel King all at once.
The Angel King was driven to the absolute brink.
"My King!"
Carodion suddenly shouted and, together with the other three, flashed to the side.
Daniel, who had long understood the timing with them, grinned.
"Skyfall Strike!"
Blood-red damage numbers burst wildly above the Angel King’s head.
Boom—!
With a thunderous explosion, the Angel King avatar’s body was blown to pieces.
System notifications rang in Daniel’s ears.
[Ding! You have killed "Angel King Avatar"!]
[You have obtained the special item [Primal Spirit (supreme-grade)] ×1!]
[You have obtained the special item [Introduction to Elemental Laws (supreme-grade)] ×1!]
[You have obtained [Spear of Holy Light (SSS-grade forbidden spell)] ×1!]
This time, killing the Angel King had yielded an absurd number of valuable rewards.
Materials, currency, and experience had piled up like mountains.
But Daniel did not even bother looking at most of it. His eyes were fixed only on those few rarest treasures.
The new version had already launched, and although Divine-grade lifeforms still could not appear in this world, the upper limit for Divine-grade equipment and materials had now been unlocked!
At that thought, Daniel sold off several of the spoils without hesitation.
[Ding! You sold [Primal Spirit (supreme-grade)] ×1 to Doom Guild for 1 copper coin, triggering Millionfold Boost!]
[The sold item belongs to the special material category. Please choose: quality boost / quantity boost!]
"Quantity boost!"
[Ding! Congratulations! You obtained 1 gold coin! You received [Primal Spirit (supreme-grade)] ×1,000,000!]
[Ding! You sold [Introduction to Elemental Laws (supreme-grade)] ×1 to Doom Guild for 1 copper coin, triggering Millionfold Boost!]
[The sold item belongs to the special item category. Please choose: quality boost / quantity boost!]
"Quality boost!"
[Ding! Congratulations! You obtained 1 gold coin! You received [Essence of Elemental Laws (Divine-grade)] ×1! (As the upper limit has been unlocked, the item grade will be automatically upgraded)]
[Ding! You sold [Spear of Holy Light (SSS-grade forbidden spell)] ×1 to Doom Guild for 1 copper coin, triggering Millionfold Boost!]
[Congratulations! You obtained 1 gold coin! You received [Arrow of Judgment (epic-grade forbidden spell)] ×1! (As the upper limit has been unlocked, the item grade will be automatically upgraded)]
Millionfold Boost!
The Angel King’s drops had already been outrageously overpowered to begin with, but after this multiplication, they became absurd beyond absurd.
After reading the system messages, Daniel trembled slightly with excitement.
But it still was not over!

[World Announcement: Player "Faustus" has killed "Angel King · Avatar"! He has become the first player to kill a peak supreme-grade Boss! Special rewards granted: Contribution Points +5,000,000! Gold coins +10,000,000!]
[Additional special reward granted to player "Faustus": special item [Heart of Immortality (supreme-grade)]!]
The world announcement rang out three times in a row, instantly stunning every player into silence.
A supreme-grade Boss!
Supreme-grade rewards!
Wasn’t this combat power way too outrageous!?
The overjoyed Daniel had no idea that the World Channel had already exploded completely.
"What the hell... we just took down an epic-grade chief and were feeling amazing, but compared to Faustus, we’re complete trash!"
"Holy shit! Peak supreme-grade! Faustus actually killed the Angel King’s peak supreme-grade avatar?!"
"Is Faustus even still human? We’re over here getting beaten to tears by Exalted-grade bosses, while he’s already out there slaughtering gods..."
"What do you mean ’still human’? Faustus stopped being human a long time ago. He’s a god!"
"The way you phrased that sounds weirdly like an insult."
"Forget whether it’s an insult or not, I’ve only got one question—who else is there? In this entire game, who else can even challenge Faustus?"
