chapters.title: Chapter 183 -183-The Heaven-Defying Effects of the Eternal Sacred Heart
paragraphs: The players were so excited they could barely speak coherently.
Messages on the World Channel were refreshing at a terrifying speed—so fast that no one could even tell who was saying what anymore.
Some people dug up the old posts mocking Faustus and started slapping faces one by one.
Others were already doing the math in their heads—if they could follow a godlike figure like him, maybe they could get a share of the spoils too...
But beneath all that excitement and noise was something else entirely:
the entire player base’s almost blind worship of Faustus.
He was no longer merely the "number one player."
He had become a god among players—the absolute ceiling that all others could only look up to and never hope to reach.
Yet inside the encrypted channels of the major guilds, the atmosphere was completely different.
The core group of Eternal Hawk had been silent for a long time.
At last, someone broke the deadlock.
"Guild Leader... are we still recruiting?"
Whitehead Falcon said nothing.
"How about... we apply to join Doom Guild too? I heard the treatment there are pretty good."
"Are you insane? We’re still one of the top guilds. You want us to become someone else’s lackeys?"

"One of the top guilds? Open your eyes and look at the rankings. Doom Guild’s score is hundreds of times ours! Faustus alone could erase our entire guild from the map. What exactly are you still trying to hold onto?"
Silence fell over the channel again.
Whitehead Falcon let out a sigh, his voice as hoarse as sandpaper scraping stone.
"If any of you have connections... go ask whether Doom Guild is still taking people. Uh... don’t make it public. Ask in private."
The moment those words came out, everyone understood—
even the guild leader had folded.
One had to know, this was the man once hailed as the one seated upon the throne of all Earth’s gold coins!
And yet even he had helplessly given up on resisting, even he had no choice but to admit defeat.
That alone was enough to show just how terrifying Faustus’s strength had become.
As unbelievable as it sounded, no one was actually that surprised.
Those who stood at the upper echelons of Earth had long since realized that this game was not merely a game.
Stellar was an eerie existence that was on the verge of merging with reality itself!
Even its absurd magic and monsters...
All of that meant the entire power structure of Earth was destined to be overturned!
It could be said that whoever controlled the greatest strength in the game would become the one who held the right to speak in the future world!
And by now, the situation could not have been clearer.
With his unrivaled power and influence, Faustus stood alone at the summit, looking down upon all players from on high.
If they still insisted on resisting as before, clinging to their little circles and stubborn pride, then the price would be simple:
they would be flung farther and farther behind by Doom Guild,
until at last they became nothing more than the most insignificant dust in the future world.
Inside the encrypted channel, one private message after another was quietly sent out.
Each was humbler than the last.
Each posture lower than the one before it.
World Zone 47.
At this moment, the player forum was in an uproar.
The title of the pinned post was blood-red, as though it had been carved out with a knife:
"Faustus Is Already Invincible—What Are We Supposed to Fight Him With?"
The replies below were exploding at breakneck speed.

"Fight my ass! Didn’t you all see it? He solo-killed the peak supreme-grade Angel King! Our zone doesn’t even have a few supreme-grade powerhouses to begin with—what exactly are we supposed to use against him?"
"I said it a long time ago—don’t make an enemy of Faustus. None of you listened. Well? Now he’s gone and smashed straight through the angel race."
"Does anyone know if Faustus accepts players from other zones? I surrender! I’ll even be a guide for him if I have to!"
"Bro, have some backbone... and take me with you."
"It’s over, it’s over. The NPCs in our zone are still discussing how to resist him. Are they brain-dead?"
"Stop discussing it. Just surrender already. Maybe then we can still get a spot in some foreign mercenary corps."
Panic spread like a plague.
Players from the other World Zones were finally beginning to understand a single fact.
Faustus had not come to compete with them.
He had come to rule them.
Resist?
With what?
Even the Angel King’s avatar had been killed by him. Who still dared claim Faustus couldn’t do it?
Meanwhile, Faustus immediately sold off the reward.
[Ding! You have sold the special item "Heart of Immortality (supreme-grade)" ×1 to Doom Guild for 1 copper coin, triggering Millionfold Boost!]
[The sold item belongs to the special item category. Please choose: quality boost / quantity boost!]
"Quality boost!"
[Ding! Congratulations! You have obtained 1 gold coin! You have received [Eternal Sacred Heart (Divine-grade)] ×1! (As the upper limit is unlocked, the item’s grade will automatically increase.)]
Daniel’s eyes widened instantly.
He hurriedly took out the reward to inspect it.
[Eternal Sacred Heart (Divine-grade)] (Growth-Type)
Level: 1
Grade: Divine-grade
Description:
After use, it can independently condense [Immortal Singularity].
[Primal Spirit] may be used to upgrade the Eternal Sacred Heart. The higher its level, the faster it condenses Immortal Singularity, and the greater its storage limit becomes.
[Primal Spirit] may be used to sacrifice the Eternal Sacred Heart. Once the amount sacrificed reaches a certain threshold, [Divine Realm] and [Sacred Realm] may be awakened.
Special Note:
Immortal Singularity condensation rate: 1 point every 60 minutes
Storage limit: 500 points
Required for next upgrade:
500,000 points of Primal Spirit (Level 2)
Description:

The difficulty of obtaining this item rivals that of a mortal plucking the stars from the heavens with flesh and blood alone. The odds are so vanishingly small that they are akin to an ant dreaming of shaking the throne of the gods!
"Hiss—!"
Daniel sucked in a sharp breath.
This item’s effects were simply heaven-defying!
Even if a level 1 newbie obtained it, they could ascend to godhood on the spot!
And it could still continue to grow. In theory, its effects could be stacked upward without limit.
Damn!
Daniel felt that obtaining this single item alone had already made him an outrageous profit.
Without another word, he poured 500,000 points of Primal Spirit into it.
The Eternal Sacred Heart rose to Level 2. Its Immortal Singularity condensation speed shot up to 1 point every 6 minutes, and its storage cap also increased to 5,000 points.
[Ding! Would you like to use the special item "Eternal Sacred Heart"?]
"Use it!"
[Ding! You have used the special item "Eternal Sacred Heart"!]
Boom—!
Daniel’s body suddenly trembled.
"A divine spark?"
A smile curled at Daniel’s lips.
A divine spark was merely one path to godhood, nothing more.
In the Endless Starfield, there were countless races born with talents similar to the Eternal Sacred Heart.
Such beings had no interest at all in fusing with some so-called divine spark.
He had just used 500,000 points of Primal Spirit, leaving him with another 500,000 still in hand.
Primal Spirit seemed to be a universal resource, something that only innate-race supreme-grade powerhouses could drop.
The Eternal Sacred Heart required 1,000,000 points for its next level, which meant he still didn’t have enough for the time being.
But that was fine.
As long as he kept killing supreme-grade powerhouses of the innate races, he would eventually gather a steady supply.
It wasn’t really that difficult.
With that thought, he took out the rest of the rewards.
[Arrow of Judgment (epic-grade forbidden spell)]
Effect:

Shoots an arrow condensed from the ultimate light element. Upon striking the target, the arrow explodes into a rain of holy light, continuously purging all corruption within the area and dealing 300 million damage per second to enemies (scales based on the user’s output). At the same time, the power of the light element surrounds the caster, forming [Absolute Protection], which generates a shield every second capable of absorbing 300 million damage (converted from output).
Special:
Consumes 10% of MP per second.
Description:
When the arrow is loosed, it becomes light itself. Wherever that light reaches, all enemies retreat—such is the judgment of the forbidden archer.

The title of the pinned post was blood-red, as though it had been carved out with a knife:
"Faustus Is Already Invincible—What Are We Supposed to Fight Him With?"
The replies below were exploding at breakneck speed.
"Fight my ass!
Didn’t you all see it?
He solo-killed the peak supreme-grade Angel King!
Our zone doesn’t even have a few supreme-grade powerhouses to begin with—what exactly are we supposed to use against him?"
"I said it a long time ago—don’t make an enemy of Faustus.
None of you listened.
Well?
Now he’s gone and smashed straight through the angel race."
"Does anyone know if Faustus accepts players from other zones?
I surrender!
I’ll even be a guide for him if I have to!"
"Bro, have some backbone... and take me with you."
"It’s over, it’s over.
The NPCs in our zone are still discussing how to resist him.
Are they brain-dead?"
"Stop discussing it.
Just surrender already.
Maybe then we can still get a spot in some foreign mercenary corps."
Panic spread like a plague.
Players from the other World Zones were finally beginning to understand a single fact.
Faustus had not come to compete with them.
He had come to rule them.
Resist?
With what?
Even the Angel King’s avatar had been killed by him.
Who still dared claim Faustus couldn’t do it?
Meanwhile, Faustus immediately sold off the reward.
[Ding!
You have sold the special item "Heart of Immortality (supreme-grade)" ×1 to Doom Guild for 1 copper coin, triggering Millionfold Boost!]
[The sold item belongs to the special item category.
Please choose: quality boost / quantity boost!]
"Quality boost!"
[Ding!
Congratulations!
You have obtained 1 gold coin!
You have received [Eternal Sacred Heart (Divine-grade)] ×1! (As the upper limit is unlocked, the item’s grade will automatically increase.)]
Daniel’s eyes widened instantly.
He hurriedly took out the reward to inspect it.
[Eternal Sacred Heart (Divine-grade)] (Growth-Type)
Level: 1
Grade: Divine-grade
Description:
After use, it can independently condense [Immortal Singularity].
[Primal Spirit] may be used to upgrade the Eternal Sacred Heart.
The higher its level, the faster it condenses Immortal Singularity, and the greater its storage limit becomes.
[Primal Spirit] may be used to sacrifice the Eternal Sacred Heart.
Once the amount sacrificed reaches a certain threshold, [Divine Realm] and [Sacred Realm] may be awakened.
Special Note:
Immortal Singularity condensation rate: 1 point every 60 minutes
Storage limit: 500 points
Required for next upgrade:
500,000 points of Primal Spirit (Level 2)
Description:
The difficulty of obtaining this item rivals that of a mortal plucking the stars from the heavens with flesh and blood alone.
The odds are so vanishingly small that they are akin to an ant dreaming of shaking the throne of the gods!
"Hiss—!"
Daniel sucked in a sharp breath.
This item’s effects were simply heaven-defying!
Even if a level 1 newbie obtained it, they could ascend to godhood on the spot!
And it could still continue to grow.
In theory, its effects could be stacked upward without limit.
Damn!
Daniel felt that obtaining this single item alone had already made him an outrageous profit.
Without another word, he poured 500,000 points of Primal Spirit into it.
The Eternal Sacred Heart rose to Level 2.
Its Immortal Singularity condensation speed shot up to 1 point every 6 minutes, and its storage cap also increased to 5,000 points.
[Ding!
Would you like to use the special item "Eternal Sacred Heart"?]
"Use it!"
[Ding!
You have used the special item "Eternal Sacred Heart"!]
Boom—!
Daniel’s body suddenly trembled.
"A divine spark?"
A smile curled at Daniel’s lips.
A divine spark was merely one path to godhood, nothing more.
In the Endless Starfield, there were countless races born with talents similar to the Eternal Sacred Heart.
Such beings had no interest at all in fusing with some so-called divine spark.
He had just used 500,000 points of Primal Spirit, leaving him with another 500,000 still in hand.
Primal Spirit seemed to be a universal resource, something that only innate-race supreme-grade powerhouses could drop.
The Eternal Sacred Heart required 1,000,000 points for its next level, which meant he still didn’t have enough for the time being.
But that was fine.
As long as he kept killing supreme-grade powerhouses of the innate races, he would eventually gather a steady supply.
It wasn’t really that difficult.
With that thought, he took out the rest of the rewards.
[Arrow of Judgment (epic-grade forbidden spell)]
Effect:
Shoots an arrow condensed from the ultimate light element.

Upon striking the target, the arrow explodes into a rain of holy light, continuously purging all corruption within the area and dealing 300 million damage per second to enemies (scales based on the user’s output).

At the same time, the power of the light element surrounds the caster, forming [Absolute Protection], which generates a shield every second capable of absorbing 300 million damage (converted from output).
Special:
Consumes 10% of MP per second.
Description:
When the arrow is loosed, it becomes light itself.
Wherever that light reaches, all enemies retreat—such is the judgment of the forbidden archer.

chapters.title: Chapter 184 -184-Explosive! One Billion Damage with a Basic Attack!
paragraphs: An epic-grade forbidden spell!
And it was a Light-element one at that!
This skill could not only deal damage, but also wrap its user in a shield equal to that same amount of damage. It was absurd beyond belief!
Daniel learned it without the slightest hesitation.
[Ding! You have successfully mastered the epic-grade forbidden spell [Arrow of Judgment]!]
[Notice: Your skill bar has been updated. Please check the details yourself.]
After learning the skill, he immediately took out the rest of the rewards from this battle.
[Essence of Elemental Laws (Divine-grade)]
Level: ???
Grade: Divine-grade
Effect:
This item can be used to deduce the origins of the various elemental sources, allowing the creation of entirely new class skills, and even forbidden spells and forbidden-grade skills!
Deduction Requirements:
1,000,000 points of Primal Spirit to deduce one forbidden spell;
10,000,000,000 points of Primal Spirit to deduce one forbidden-grade skill.
Description:
What "Encyclopedia of Magic"? In front of this tome of profundities, that’s nothing but a pile of scrap paper...
Simple and blunt.
Daniel was completely stunned.
Forbidden spells!
Forbidden-grade skills!
This was the third time he had come into contact with something related to the forbidden.
Anything touched by that word was never ordinary—it was always heaven-defying!

Take the [Chronoverse Prologue Codex] for example. That was a top-tier forbidden skill tome, one that pointed directly toward the universe’s most fundamental spacetime laws. It was the ultimate pursuit of all true powerhouses.

Even his class change quest had once been tied to the forbidden-grade archer path. One could only imagine how terrifying the skills he would gain after officially class changing at level 200 would be.
And spacetime was not the only law in the universe.
There were also life, death, creation, destruction, prophecy, fate... all kinds of law powers as forbidden as they were incomprehensible.

Daniel remembered that in his previous lives, players on the official forums had once made their own ranking list. Of course, none of them had ever truly come into contact with forbidden power, but that never stopped them from wildly speculating.
On their [Forbidden Rankings], Spacetime was ranked first, followed by Fate, then Prophecy, Creation, Destruction, and so on...
Originally, it had only been a form of player entertainment, something made for fun.
But in this world, those forbidden laws actually existed!
And this Essence of Elemental Laws could deduce forbidden skills of that level!
It was simply so broken it bordered on insanity.
Daniel’s fingers trembled slightly as he carefully stowed the treasure away into his inventory.
Its effect was incomparably heaven-defying, yes—
but its deduction requirements were just as monstrous.
Ten billion points of Primal Spirit.
That number alone was enough to make his scalp tingle.
Better leave it for later.
This wave of rewards had been an absolute fortune.
But Daniel knew very well that he could still gain even more...
because now, Angel Plane had no master!
That was simply too wonderful.
It was the equivalent of breaking into a treasure vault—only to find that there wasn’t even a guard at the door.
At the thought, a smile spread across Daniel’s face.
The Angel King’s avatar was dead, which naturally meant Angel Plane was now ownerless.
To Daniel, the entire Angel Plane was like a lamb waiting to be slaughtered.
"In other words... Angel Plane belongs to me now!"
His eyes gleamed.
The angel race had accumulated wealth over countless ages. Who knew how many treasures they had hidden away?
With a wave of his hand, he ordered the four supreme-grade subordinates under his command to suppress the entirety of Angel Plane.
Anything in Angel Plane worth even the slightest bit of money—whether it was bricks, tiles, grass, or wood—take it all.
Not even a single hair was to be left behind.
Daniel understood the situation perfectly well:
the moment the Angel King’s avatar was destroyed, the main body wandering the Endless Starfield would definitely know at once.
But his true body could not descend. He could only send avatars.
And if one avatar was useless, what then?
Could he really send hundreds of them?
So in the short term, Daniel had absolutely no fear of the Angel King coming to settle the score.
Even if the Angel King really did smash a whole swarm of avatars into Aetheria, he still wouldn’t care.
By then, perhaps his strength would already have risen to the point where he could beat down supreme-grade experts head-on.
No matter how many avatars the Angel King sent, they would all just be walking experience points.
Daniel almost wished he would send more.
Pressure?
What was that supposed to be?
After dispatching the four supreme-grade experts to plunder in every direction, Daniel lowered his head and glanced at the [Holy Light City] beneath his feet, then suddenly dived straight down.
Holy Light City was the angel race’s only city.
Everyone living there was a descendant of the Angel King’s bloodline.
Daniel showed them no courtesy whatsoever and headed straight for the Lord’s Manor.
Whoever dared block his path would become an experience pack.
It did not take him much effort at all before he smashed apart the Lord’s Sacred Stele.
[Ding! You have destroyed the Lord’s Sacred Stele. Please choose [Occupy] or [Destroy]?]
Daniel gave a slight nod.
"Occupy."
[Notice: You have occupied [Holy Light City].]
The corners of Daniel’s lips lifted as he opened the treasury of Holy Light City.
It was packed to the brim with the wealth the angel race had accumulated over countless years.
At a single glance, he spotted piles upon piles of [Light Crystal]!
[Light Crystal (legendary-grade consumable)]
Level: !
Grade: legendary-grade
Effect:
A universal auxiliary material for sub-classes. Using a Light Crystal increases the success rate by 10%!
A universal energy material. Its specific uses depend on the situation. Current energy reserve: SS-rank!
Description:
Light Crystal, a specialty product of Angel Plane...
After reading that, Daniel felt thoroughly pleased.

Light Crystal was also a top-tier energy source—even a grade higher than the Gemstones dropped from the Aerial Realm. Its energy reserve had reached SS-rank, and who knew how many times greater that was than mana crystal.
Without blinking an eye, he emptied out the entire angel treasury from top to bottom.
The poor angel race had spent countless years building up this fortune, only for Daniel to conveniently organize his backpack for him.
Daniel took a deep breath.
The wealth in his hands was now so immense it was hard to describe.
He immediately took out the [Conqueror’s Emblem].
Upgrade! Upgrade it now!
[Ding! [Conqueror’s Emblem] has been upgraded to Level 4!]
[Ding! [Conqueror’s Emblem] has been upgraded to Level 5!]
[Ding! [Conqueror’s Emblem] has been upgraded to Level 10!]
In one breath, Daniel pushed the Conqueror’s Emblem all the way to Level 10.
His damage output had now reached one billion.
Which meant that even if he picked up a staff and casually smacked someone with it, he could still deal one billion damage!
One billion!
What kind of concept was that?
It had already left legendary-grade powerhouses far behind!
Even if that damage landed on a supreme-grade expert, it would still hurt like hell.
Of course, supreme-grade experts had their Divine Realms protecting them, so one could not judge things by raw damage numbers alone.
Just then, the four supreme-grade experts under his command returned.
"My King, we discovered the [Lake of Baptism] and the [Immortal Altar]!"
"My King, we discovered the [Valley of Angels] and the [Isle of Rebirth]!"
The moment they came back, the four supreme-grade experts began reporting their findings over one another.
Daniel’s eyes lit up, and he immediately followed them over.
The Lake of Baptism and the Immortal Altar were right next to each other.
Though it was called a lake, the Lake of Baptism was so vast it looked more like a sea.
To understand what it did, Daniel jumped straight in.
The system notifications immediately exploded.
[Ding! You have obtained 1,000 attribute points!]
[Ding! You have obtained 1,000 attribute points!]
He had only stayed in the lake for a single minute before he was forced to climb back out, because 60,000 attribute points was already the upper limit of the Lake of Baptism!
Sixty thousand points!
These attribute points were simply too easy to earn!
Daniel put every last point into Agility.
After all, with the Conqueror’s Emblem supporting his fixed damage, unless attribute points could one day provide more output than the emblem, it was still more worthwhile to keep wearing it.
After testing the Lake of Baptism, he went to the Immortal Altar.
It was a magnificent elevated platform built from crystal and gold-grade materials.
The instant he stepped onto it, a system prompt rang out.
[Ding! You have obtained 5,000 points of Immortal Singularity!]
[Ding! Your current Immortal Singularity gained has exceeded your storage limit!]

chapters.title: Chapter 185 -185-The Choice Between Survival and Glory
paragraphs: Daniel raised an eyebrow as he listened to the system notification.
"Not bad."
One could not be too greedy.
What level did 5,000 points of Immortal Singularity represent?
That was a threshold only supreme-grade powerhouses could reach.
Even a peak legendary-grade expert would at most have a capacity of a little over 2,000.
And yet, before even reaching supreme-grade himself, he already had a capacity of 5,000 points. Daniel was more than satisfied.
After testing these two sacred landmarks, a new idea immediately surfaced in his mind.
Things this good should be used to harvest players like crops and raise the overall strength of his forces!
With that thought, he looked toward the four supreme-grade experts and asked,
"Can you move these sacred lands and wonders?"
The four supreme-grade experts gave bitter smiles and shook their heads in unison.
The reason a sacred land was called a sacred land was precisely because it had been built—or born—upon certain special locations, tied directly to the angel race’s Fortune Points.
Daniel understood that logic as well, but he still felt a little regretful.
Can’t move them?
His eyes rolled slightly. If they couldn’t move them, then he would just dismantle the whole place and take it away piece by piece!
He pulled out two enormous containers.
These were supreme-grade containers he had obtained when he looted the treasury of the Holy Kingdom in Heavenscar last time. Their greatest use was that their storage capacity was absurdly vast.
"Pack up all the water from this Lake of Baptism for me!"
Daniel pointed at the lake surface. "Oh, and don’t forget the soil by the shore."
"And tear down this Immortal Altar too! The crystal, the gold-grade materials, and even the soil underneath—pack it all in!"
The four supreme-grade experts froze for a moment, unable to react at first.
Very soon, the two giant containers were stuffed full and handed over to Daniel.
After putting them away, he waved his hand grandly.
"Let’s go to the Isle of Rebirth!"
The Isle of Rebirth was, quite simply, an island.
But it was a very special island—
the entire island was covered in [Sacred Spring]!
Each one was a spring well glowing with soft radiance. Above the spring water floated countless cocoons woven from strands of light, resembling silkworm pupae.
Inside every single cocoon, an unborn angel was being nurtured.
This was the very foundation of the angel race’s reproduction!
The Sacred Springs constantly gave birth to new light cocoons, and the angel embryos within them slowly grew until the day they broke free.
Aside from the Sacred Springs, the island also contained piles upon piles of [Angel Chest].
Daniel’s eyes nearly went straight.
So many Sacred Springs, so many treasure chests...
He had struck it rich!
"Loot everything clean!"
His eyes were practically red with excitement.
Very soon, system notifications began ringing out one after another.
[Ding! You have obtained [Sacred Spring] ×1!]
[Ding! You have obtained [Angel Chest] ×1!]
[Ding! ...]
At the same time, Daniel immediately resold everything he obtained.
Considering the needs of his class change quest to build a Holywing Angel Legion, Daniel chose quantity boost by default.
[Ding! You have sold [Sacred Spring] ×1 to Doom Guild for 1 copper coin, triggering Millionfold Boost!]
[Quantity boost triggered!]
[Congratulations! You have obtained 1 gold coin! You have received [Sacred Spring] ×1,000,000!]
[Ding! You have sold [Angel Chest] ×1 to Doom Guild for 1 copper coin, triggering Millionfold Boost!]
[Quantity boost triggered!]
[Congratulations! You have obtained 1 gold coin! You have received [Angel Chest] ×1,000,000!]
Daniel stuffed the spoils into his inventory like a madman.
As much as he could fit, he took.
After all, his inventory capacity was infinite.
The four supreme-grade experts under his command watched Daniel’s frenzied behavior and all arrived at the same thought:
by the time they left, there probably would not be a single grain of dirt left in Angel Plane.
Before long, every Sacred Spring and every Angel Chest on the Isle of Rebirth had been looted clean by Daniel.
One had to know that both of these items could trigger Millionfold Boost.
Which meant that what he had effectively obtained was equivalent to the treasure of one million Isles of Rebirth!
What a terrifying amount of wealth that was!
Returning fully loaded, Daniel could not help but laugh out loud.
This class change quest had originally only required him to cultivate and enslave one hundred Holywing Angels, yet he had practically packed up the entire Angel Plane!
The only pity was that Angel Plane itself could not be moved. Otherwise, he definitely would have ripped up the land along with everything else.
Thinking of this, he asked,
"Then what kind of place is the Valley of Angels?"
Hearing the question, Carodion stepped forward.
"My King, a great number of Holywing Angels reside within the Valley of Angels."
Holywing Angels?!
Daniel’s eyes lit up.
"Let’s go to the Valley of Angels!"
Above the Valley of Angels.

The pressure of the four supreme-grade experts erupted with a thunderous boom. Their supreme-grade aura pressed down upon the more than one million Holywing Angels in the valley until all of them trembled uncontrollably.
Daniel swept his gaze over the densely packed mass of Holywing Angels before him as though he were looking over livestock from his own farm.
These Holywing Angels already knew that the supreme existence of Angel Plane—the Angel King’s avatar—had been annihilated by these humans.
At this very moment, all of them were shrouded in fear, fury, and confusion.
Daniel took in every expression on their faces.
So many Holywing Angels.
And every single one of them was legendary-grade!
If he could subjugate them all, the strength of his faction would surge once more.
Then even if he faced any great race of the star sea in the future, he would still have the power to fight.
This was the perfect time to bring them to heel. If he missed this chance, there would not be another.
Daniel turned his head and glanced at Carodion.
"Carodion, go ask them whether they’re willing to sign a soul contract."
Carodion asked, "And if they refuse?"
Daniel raised a brow.
"Refuse? Then send them to meet the Angel King."
Carodion nodded and flew with the other experts to the front of the Holywing Angels.
"You angels have two choices before you now—submission, or death?"
The Holywing Angels all fell silent.
Of course they did not want to submit.
As a top-tier race, arrogance was carved into their bones!
But in the face of life and death, that arrogance was worth less than a blade of grass.
This world was just that cruel.
If one wanted to sit firmly atop the myriad races, one had to possess the power to crush all opposition.
The Angel King was already dead. Their millions of Holywing Angels simply did not have the confidence to challenge these four supreme-grade experts.
"Glory shall not be defiled!"
One Holywing Angel suddenly roared.
"By the name of the Angel King, my angel race will never bow its head to another race, nor serve as slaves or servants!"
"You think brute force alone can make us submit? Dream on!"
Carodion’s brows furrowed as he stared coldly at him and spat out a single word:
"Kill."
Aliris swung her sword!
Slash!
A sword beam split open the void and cleaved that Holywing Angel in two with a single strike!
Golden blood poured down like torrential rain, staining the earth of Angel Plane a brilliant gold.
Carodion swept a cold gaze across the Holywing Angels before him, as though looking at lambs waiting for slaughter, and said icily,
"Who else?"
The Holywing Angels fell silent.
But at that very moment, a group of Holywing Angels suddenly erupted into motion and charged at the four supreme-grade experts.
They shouted in despair,
"You lowly humans want to enslave our angel race? Dream on!"
"Glory shall not be defiled!"
"Fight to the end!"
Carodion narrowed his eyes and let out a cold snort.
"Hmph!"
"You dare try to self-destruct in front of us? How ignorant."
"Divine Realm!"
With a wave of Carodion’s hand, an enormous phantom of Carodion, tens of thousands of feet tall, suddenly appeared in the void.
That phantom stretched out a giant palm, vast enough to blot out the sky, covering the entire Valley of Angels!
The gigantic hand seized that group of Holywing Angels in its grasp, then clenched fiercely—
Bang! Bang! Bang!
Carodion crushed the Holywing Angels alive, as easily as crushing a few insects!
Hiss—!!!
Seeing that scene, all the Holywing Angels present shuddered violently.
They buried the hatred in their eyes deep within their hearts, while their expressions gradually turned numb.
From high above, Carodion shouted once more:
"Submit... or die?"

sentences.text: Daniel raised an eyebrow as he listened to the system notification.
"Not bad."
One could not be too greedy.
What level did 5,000 points of Immortal Singularity represent?
That was a threshold only supreme-grade powerhouses could reach.
Even a peak legendary-grade expert would at most have a capacity of a little over 2,000.
And yet, before even reaching supreme-grade himself, he already had a capacity of 5,000 points.
Daniel was more than satisfied.
After testing these two sacred landmarks, a new idea immediately surfaced in his mind.
Things this good should be used to harvest players like crops and raise the overall strength of his forces!
With that thought, he looked toward the four supreme-grade experts and asked,
"Can you move these sacred lands and wonders?"
The four supreme-grade experts gave bitter smiles and shook their heads in unison.
The reason a sacred land was called a sacred land was precisely because it had been built—or born—upon certain special locations, tied directly to the angel race’s Fortune Points.
Daniel understood that logic as well, but he still felt a little regretful.
Can’t move them?
His eyes rolled slightly.
If they couldn’t move them, then he would just dismantle the whole place and take it away piece by piece!
He pulled out two enormous containers.
These were supreme-grade containers he had obtained when he looted the treasury of the Holy Kingdom in Heavenscar last time.
Their greatest use was that their storage capacity was absurdly vast.
"Pack up all the water from this Lake of Baptism for me!"
Daniel pointed at the lake surface.
"Oh, and don’t forget the soil by the shore."
"And tear down this Immortal Altar too!
The crystal, the gold-grade materials, and even the soil underneath—pack it all in!"
The four supreme-grade experts froze for a moment, unable to react at first.
Very soon, the two giant containers were stuffed full and handed over to Daniel.
After putting them away, he waved his hand grandly.
"Let’s go to the Isle of Rebirth!"
The Isle of Rebirth was, quite simply, an island.
But it was a very special island—
the entire island was covered in [Sacred Spring]!
Each one was a spring well glowing with soft radiance.
Above the spring water floated countless cocoons woven from strands of light, resembling silkworm pupae.
Inside every single cocoon, an unborn angel was being nurtured.
This was the very foundation of the angel race’s reproduction!
The Sacred Springs constantly gave birth to new light cocoons, and the angel embryos within them slowly grew until the day they broke free.
Aside from the Sacred Springs, the island also contained piles upon piles of [Angel Chest].
Daniel’s eyes nearly went straight.
So many Sacred Springs, so many treasure chests...
He had struck it rich!
"Loot everything clean!"
His eyes were practically red with excitement.
Very soon, system notifications began ringing out one after another.
[Ding!
You have obtained [Sacred Spring] ×1!]
[Ding!
You have obtained [Angel Chest] ×1!]
[Ding! ...]
At the same time, Daniel immediately resold everything he obtained.
Considering the needs of his class change quest to build a Holywing Angel Legion, Daniel chose quantity boost by default.
[Ding!
You have sold [Sacred Spring] ×1 to Doom Guild for 1 copper coin, triggering Millionfold Boost!]
[Quantity boost triggered!]
[Congratulations!
You have obtained 1 gold coin!
You have received [Sacred Spring] ×1,000,000!]
[Ding!
You have sold [Angel Chest] ×1 to Doom Guild for 1 copper coin, triggering Millionfold Boost!]
[Quantity boost triggered!]
[Congratulations!
You have obtained 1 gold coin!
You have received [Angel Chest] ×1,000,000!]
Daniel stuffed the spoils into his inventory like a madman.
As much as he could fit, he took.
After all, his inventory capacity was infinite.
The four supreme-grade experts under his command watched Daniel’s frenzied behavior and all arrived at the same thought:
by the time they left, there probably would not be a single grain of dirt left in Angel Plane.
Before long, every Sacred Spring and every Angel Chest on the Isle of Rebirth had been looted clean by Daniel.
One had to know that both of these items could trigger Millionfold Boost.
Which meant that what he had effectively obtained was equivalent to the treasure of one million Isles of Rebirth!
What a terrifying amount of wealth that was!
Returning fully loaded, Daniel could not help but laugh out loud.
This class change quest had originally only required him to cultivate and enslave one hundred Holywing Angels, yet he had practically packed up the entire Angel Plane!
The only pity was that Angel Plane itself could not be moved.
Otherwise, he definitely would have ripped up the land along with everything else.
Thinking of this, he asked,
"Then what kind of place is the Valley of Angels?"
Hearing the question, Carodion stepped forward.
"My King, a great number of Holywing Angels reside within the Valley of Angels."
Holywing Angels?!
Daniel’s eyes lit up.
"Let’s go to the Valley of Angels!"
Above the Valley of Angels.
The pressure of the four supreme-grade experts erupted with a thunderous boom.
Their supreme-grade aura pressed down upon the more than one million Holywing Angels in the valley until all of them trembled uncontrollably.
Daniel swept his gaze over the densely packed mass of Holywing Angels before him as though he were looking over livestock from his own farm.
These Holywing Angels already knew that the supreme existence of Angel Plane—the Angel King’s avatar—had been annihilated by these humans.
At this very moment, all of them were shrouded in fear, fury, and confusion.
Daniel took in every expression on their faces.
So many Holywing Angels.
And every single one of them was legendary-grade!
If he could subjugate them all, the strength of his faction would surge once more.
Then even if he faced any great race of the star sea in the future, he would still have the power to fight.
This was the perfect time to bring them to heel.
If he missed this chance, there would not be another.
Daniel turned his head and glanced at Carodion.
"Carodion, go ask them whether they’re willing to sign a soul contract."
Carodion asked, "And if they refuse?"
Daniel raised a brow.
"Refuse?
Then send them to meet the Angel King."
Carodion nodded and flew with the other experts to the front of the Holywing Angels.
"You angels have two choices before you now—submission, or death?"
The Holywing Angels all fell silent.
Of course they did not want to submit.
As a top-tier race, arrogance was carved into their bones!
But in the face of life and death, that arrogance was worth less than a blade of grass.
This world was just that cruel.
If one wanted to sit firmly atop the myriad races, one had to possess the power to crush all opposition.
The Angel King was already dead.
Their millions of Holywing Angels simply did not have the confidence to challenge these four supreme-grade experts.
"Glory shall not be defiled!"
One Holywing Angel suddenly roared.
"By the name of the Angel King, my angel race will never bow its head to another race, nor serve as slaves or servants!"
"You think brute force alone can make us submit?
Dream on!"
Carodion’s brows furrowed as he stared coldly at him and spat out a single word:
"Kill."
Aliris swung her sword!
Slash!
A sword beam split open the void and cleaved that Holywing Angel in two with a single strike!
Golden blood poured down like torrential rain, staining the earth of Angel Plane a brilliant gold.
Carodion swept a cold gaze across the Holywing Angels before him, as though looking at lambs waiting for slaughter, and said icily,
"Who else?"
The Holywing Angels fell silent.
But at that very moment, a group of Holywing Angels suddenly erupted into motion and charged at the four supreme-grade experts.
They shouted in despair,
"You lowly humans want to enslave our angel race?
Dream on!"
"Glory shall not be defiled!"
"Fight to the end!"
Carodion narrowed his eyes and let out a cold snort.
"Hmph!"
"You dare try to self-destruct in front of us?
How ignorant."
"Divine Realm!"
With a wave of Carodion’s hand, an enormous phantom of Carodion, tens of thousands of feet tall, suddenly appeared in the void.
That phantom stretched out a giant palm, vast enough to blot out the sky, covering the entire Valley of Angels!
The gigantic hand seized that group of Holywing Angels in its grasp, then clenched fiercely—
Bang!
Bang!
Bang!
Carodion crushed the Holywing Angels alive, as easily as crushing a few insects!
Hiss—!!!
Seeing that scene, all the Holywing Angels present shuddered violently.
They buried the hatred in their eyes deep within their hearts, while their expressions gradually turned numb.
From high above, Carodion shouted once more:
"Submit... or die?"

chapters.title: Chapter 186 -186-Enslaving the Entire Angel Race
paragraphs: "Submit!"
"We are willing to submit!"
"For the survival of the angel race, we cannot die!"
The Holywing Angels spoke one after another.
They finally understood that they were nothing more than fish on the chopping block. If they did not want to die, their only choice was to lower their heads.
Carodion nodded.
"Sign the Soul Pact. Those who refuse—die!"
The Holywing Angels had no other choice. They could only sign the Soul Pact.
The moment the Soul Pact was signed, their lives were no longer in their own hands.
With a single thought, Daniel could make them drop dead on the spot.
But in order to survive, they had to sign!
Daniel watched the scene coldly.
His gaze passed through the firmament dyed in golden light, and his thoughts drifted back to the distant past.
He thought of that era—
The era when humanity had crawled beneath the feet of the Godkin!
Back then, the ancestors and leaders of the human race had knelt inside the Godkin’s cold, towering halls, signing that humiliating master-servant contract.
They had handed over the fate of themselves and their entire race like mere goods, all for the sake of allowing humanity to cling to a miserable existence.
That was a humiliation carved into the bones and blood of mankind, a hidden pain passed down from generation to generation.
But today, he stood atop the ruins of the Angel Plane, watching those once-arrogant angels lower their proud heads one by one and sign the Soul Pact.
"It’s different now."
He murmured softly.
His voice was low, yet it landed like a hammer striking an anvil.
"Players will rise in the end. Those lofty races who look down on all living beings as ants have no idea—
"The apocalypse is coming!"
"My King."
Carodion’s voice pulled him back to reality.
"All Holywing Angels have signed the Soul Pact. Their number exceeds one million."
Over one million Holywing Angels.
Over one million legendary-grade powerhouses!
Daniel nodded slightly, his gaze sharp.
"Bring them back."
With that, the journey to the Angel Plane came to an end.
The gains from this battle had far exceeded his initial expectations.
The treasures scattered after the Angel King’s avatar fell were already incredibly abundant.
On top of that, there were countless Sacred Springs and piles upon piles of Angel Chests.
This trip was no different from seizing the resources of an entire minor world out of thin air!
With a wave of his hand, he ordered four supreme-grade powerhouses to escort the million angels back to Aetheria.
When the endless Holywing Angels surged into the skies of the main world like a golden flood, the entire world erupted into chaos.
"Gods above! What is that? The sky is filled with angels!"
"Did the guild leader empty out the entire Angel Plane? This is way too outrageous!"
"Those are angels! The angel race, powerful beyond imagination! Have they... been subdued by Lord Faustus?!"
The players looked up at the sky, their eyes reflecting that vast expanse of golden light. One by one, they were so excited that they could barely speak coherently.
Those were angels—
A legendary-grade innate race, an existence that even the Godkin and shadowkin had to treat with a degree of respect.
Yet now, like migrating birds, they were flying neatly into Faustus’s territory.
Daniel settled the million Holywing Angels across several territorial cities in World Zone No. 616.
This move was like throwing a massive boulder into a calm lake, instantly stirring up a thousand waves.
The surrounding non-human race factions were scared out of their wits.

After the last great battle, they had already suffered heavy losses. And now, Faustus’s cities were planted right under their noses, with an army of over one million legendary-grade angels hidden inside.
That level of strength was simply suffocating.
Had it not been for the fact that, after the new version update, the various races also had supreme-grade powerhouses guarding them, they probably would not even have been able to sleep peacefully.
Daniel returned to the Polaris District.
He relocated the two sacred sites, the [Lake of Baptism] and the [Immortal Altar], into the Imperial City and opened them to all NPCs and players.
But there was no such thing as a free lunch in this world.
Want to enter the sacred sites and increase your strength?
Fine. Sign a contract and serve Daniel for several years.
Anyone who violated the contract would face a penalty so massive that it would bankrupt any deserter and ensure they could never rise again.
As for the Sacred Springs, the source from which angels were born, he also placed them on the exchange lists of both the legion and the guild.
Want an angel companion?
Then sign a leasing contract!
That was right.
A lease.
The ownership of the Sacred Springs would always remain in his hands. The cost of hatching and raising the angels would be borne by the players themselves.
Couldn’t pay the rent?
Then the angel companion they had raised would return to its rightful owner.
The rent itself was not expensive. It was practically being given away for free. As long as players steadily leveled up, killed monsters, and completed quests, they could basically afford it.
He had never intended to exploit anyone, because his gaze had always been fixed on something much farther away.
He wanted to cultivate an iron flood powerful enough to sweep across all races.
As for the little schemes being carried out behind the scenes by those player guilds?
He saw them clearly, but he remained calm and unhurried.
The Strength in his hands was enough to crush all who refused to submit.
That was his confidence.
The one hundred Holywing Angels required for his class change quest were nothing but a joke to him.
With a wave of his hand, he directly incorporated over one million Holywing Angels into the Doom Legion.

Then, from within the Doom Legion, he selected one million elite-grade players whose talents were at least A-rank and whose levels were far ahead of the others, granting them the rare class of Holywing Knight.
With that, a Holy Angel Legion was successfully formed.
The [Holy Angel Set] obtained from the Angel Chests was also directly equipped onto the legion players, free of charge.
The players donned radiant holy armor, with proud Holywing Angels as their companions. Every single one of them grinned so widely that they could not close their mouths.
Although the ownership of the angel companions still belonged to Daniel, so what?
Being able to transform into an angel and soar through the sky was already an incredibly cool thing in itself!
[Ding! Congratulations, you have completed the class change quest: [Form the Holy Angel Legion]!]
[Ding! You have obtained [forbidden-grade archer Class Awakening Scroll] ×1 and [Sacred Spring of Life] ×1.]
Daniel’s gaze landed on the bottle of spring water that emitted a faint glow.
[Sacred Spring of Life (???)]
Grade: Tier 1
Effect: Accelerates the growth of the [World Tree Seed].
Description: Mysterious Sacred Spring of Life water, said to have been produced in a certain secret realm. It contains life force capable of nurturing all things.
Daniel nodded slightly.
The World Tree Seed was in his possession, and this spring water was undoubtedly a matching divine item.
If the World Tree could grow and thrive, the small world he owned would expand along with it.
That was wealth of immeasurable value.
However, he still had many matters to deal with for the time being. Planting the tree would require choosing the right moment.
He stored the spring water together with the seed, then took out the [forbidden-grade archer Class Awakening Scroll] and used it immediately.
In the next instant, countless golden fragments danced like fireflies and poured into his body.
[Ding! Congratulations, your class change was successful!]
[Prompt: The seal on your experience bar has been lifted. Your level cap has been unlocked, and you may continue leveling up.]
[Ding! Your level has increased! Current level: 171! You have obtained twenty attribute points!]
[Ding! Your level has increased! Current level: 175! You have obtained twenty attribute points!]
[Ding! Your level has increased! Current level: 180! You have obtained twenty attribute points!]

[Prompt: You have not yet completed the next stage of your class change. Your experience bar has been sealed once again. Excess experience has been stored in the Exp Pool. Please complete your class change as soon as possible to unlock the level cap.]
Golden light flashed repeatedly as Daniel’s aura rose step by step.
He did not stop.
Instead, he took another [forbidden-grade archer Class Awakening Scroll] out of his backpack!

chapters.title: Chapter 187 -187-One Step Away from Becoming a God
paragraphs: This was the reward Daniel had received earlier for completing the Hidden World instance quest.
Without the slightest hesitation, he used it again.
[Ding! Congratulations, your class change was successful!]
[Prompt: The seal on your experience bar has been lifted. You may continue leveling up.]
[Ding! Your level has increased! Current level: 181. You have obtained twenty attribute points.]
[Ding! Your level has increased! Current level: 185. You have obtained twenty attribute points.]
[Ding! Your level has increased! Current level: 190. You have obtained twenty attribute points.]

[Prompt: You have not yet completed the next stage of your class change. Your experience bar has been sealed once again. Excess experience has been stored in the Exp Pool. Please complete your class change as soon as possible to unlock the level cap.]
Level 190!
As the golden light faded, Daniel slowly opened his eyes.
Right now, he was only one step away from level 200—the threshold for divine reincarnation and ascension to godhood.
However, at this point, fusing with a divine spark no longer held much temptation for him.
He carried the [Eternal Sacred Heart] on him. In truth, he had long since become a god-grade powerhouse. It was merely that the system had yet to officially acknowledge it.
But in order to seize the achievement reward for becoming the "first player to ascend to godhood," he did not mind walking the old path of fusing with a divine spark.
Besides, his divine spark had already been prepared long ago.
And it was even the highest-tier upper divine spark!
Just then, the system notification suddenly exploded in his ears.
[Ding! Your level has reached 190. The next stage of the [forbidden-grade archer class change quest] has been unlocked. Do you accept?]
Daniel was slightly stunned.
So after reaching level 190, he no longer needed to run back to Luminara and look for his Shadow Song mentor. The system would directly issue the quest instead.
That saved him quite a lot of time. Naturally, he had no reason to refuse.
"Accept!"
[Ding! You have accepted the class change quest: [forbidden-grade archer]! Your quest log has been updated. Please check the details.]
Daniel opened the quest log.
[forbidden-grade archer]
(Class Change Quest)
Quest Difficulty: Exalted-grade
Quest Objectives:
Obtain three origin-type [epic-grade forbidden spells].
Quest Introduction:

At the current stage, only an archer who has mastered epic-grade forbidden spells can be considered a true ceiling-level existence. However, epic-grade forbidden spells are even harder to obtain than ordinary forbidden spells. They are secret arts of the God Realm, never before seen in Aetheria.
Quest Duration: Long-term
Quest Rewards:
[epic-grade forbidden spell: Wind Puppet] ×1
[forbidden-grade archer Class Awakening Scroll] ×1
After Daniel finished reading the quest, his eyes shifted slightly.
This class change quest reward actually included an epic-grade forbidden spell book in addition to the Class Awakening Scroll.
And it was even a wind-type forbidden spell.
Moreover, the quest objective was to gather three epic-grade forbidden spells of different origins. He already had the light-type [Arrow of Judgment] in his possession.
In other words, he only needed to get two more types.
The difficulty was not too high!
He closed the quest panel, casually summoned his pet, the little stone dragon, and fed it all the way to level 190 in one go before stuffing it back again.
A pet’s combat power was only so-so. It was not much stronger than a player.
Keeping it as a mascot for fun was enough.
Polaris District.
Daniel summoned all the high-level members of his legion.
"What is the current situation on the non-human races’ side?"
He got straight to the point.
Hudson was in charge of intelligence and immediately replied,
"My King, the non-human races have all been very obedient. Even though they now have supreme-grade powerhouses presiding over them, they still do not dare to clash with us lightly."
Daniel nodded thoughtfully.
The non-human races being obedient was certainly convenient.
But in the end, they were still non-human races!
Unless he fully subdued every non-human race across both districts, he would not even be able to sleep peacefully.
After all, every non-human race had a supreme-grade powerhouse in their hands.
And this time, his target was precisely those supreme-grade powerhouses.
"All forces!"
He immediately gave the order.
"Begin sweeping away the non-human races!"
"On Aetheria, no non-human race faction that refuses to submit to the rule of humanity shall be allowed to exist!"
The eyes of the high-ranking officers of the two great legions instantly lit up.
They were finally going to war again!
"As you command, My King!"
A faint smile appeared at the corners of Daniel’s mouth.
Each non-human race possessed one supreme-grade powerhouse.
Once he gathered all those supreme-grade powerhouses into his palm, his faction would truly become invincible on this continent.
Even if the myriad races of the starry sky invaded in the future, he would have the confidence to wrestle with them head-on.
What he was thinking about now was no longer passively taking blows.
If they dared to come, then he dared to make sure none of them returned!
To achieve that, the first step was to incorporate all the supreme-grade powerhouses right under his nose.
Before resisting foreign enemies, one must first secure the interior!
Following Daniel’s command, the war machine under his rule began to roar into motion.
Scouts were sent out to gather intelligence from all sides, while tens of millions of soldiers from the two great legions began preparing for war.

For this expedition, the players not only witnessed the overwhelming momentum of the million-strong [Holy Angel Legion] with their own eyes, but also gained the most direct understanding of Daniel’s true foundation.
The legions under his command were now uniformly made up of top-tier special units.
Their levels were maxed out, their equipment had been pushed to the limit, and even their legion formations had been raised to the peak!
With this configuration, sweeping away all enemies would be more than enough!
The million Holy Angel Knights alone were enough to crush anyone who refused to submit.
Polaris District.
For the first time ever, all the supreme-grade powerhouses of the non-human races had gathered together.
Every single person present wore a grave expression.
The entire room was so silent that one could hear a needle drop.
Who was the most famous person in Aetheria right now?
Faustus!
Ever since he rose to fame, this man had been invincible. Starting from nothing, he had forcefully carved out such a massive foundation with his own hands.
Any war he took part in was a war he won!
Open Faustus’s battle record, and which page was not filled with mountains of corpses and seas of blood?
Every word seemed to declare one thing—
Faustus was invincible!
This was also why the non-human races had become even more low-key than before, despite having supreme-grade powerhouses presiding over them.
What else could they do except keep a low profile?
Who knew which race Faustus might suddenly find unpleasant one day and attack?
In the eyes of the supreme-grade powerhouses of the non-human races, Faustus was synonymous with calamity.
"We came here for a meeting, not to compare who’s more miserable. If anyone has a solution, hurry up and say it so we can consider it!"
The supreme-grade powerhouse of the dwarven race sighed.
The Beastfolk supreme-grade powerhouse glanced at him with a look of disdain.
"What is there to say? Are you planning to fight Faustus?"
The dwarf was choked speechless by that single sentence. His face flushed red, and though he opened his mouth, not a single word came out.
Fight?
With what?
The supreme-grade powerhouses of the human race were not decorations.
Not to mention, there was also Faustus standing there—a being even more terrifying than a supreme-grade powerhouse.
At this point, Faustus was practically playing with open cards.
I am coming.
Prepare yourselves.
But they truly had no way to prepare!
The elven supreme-grade powerhouse spoke.
"According to our intelligence, Faustus has deployed an army of more than ten million this time."
"Among them, over one million Holy Angel Knights are legendary-grade. That alone is not the real problem."
She took a deep breath, and her voice sank.
"The real fatal issue is this—four supreme-grade powerhouses are marching with the army!"
Four supreme-grade powerhouses!
The moment that number landed, it was almost enough to drive everyone into despair.
Right now, there were only six supreme-grade powerhouses sitting in this room in total.
And each of them had their own thoughts.
How many of them would truly be willing to fight to the death?
For example, if Faustus decided to make the elves his first target, would the Beastfolk and dwarven supreme-grade powerhouses really be willing to die fighting for the elves?
Even if they claimed they would, the elves themselves would not believe it.
Although the number of supreme-grade powerhouses on their side was not exactly small, they were nothing more than scattered sand.
"What should we do?"
The elven supreme-grade powerhouse swept her gaze across everyone present.
If they truly had a solution, they would not be sitting here staring at each other helplessly.
"What else can we do?"
"Either fight, or surrender."

Just then, the system notification suddenly exploded in his ears.

Your level has reached 190.
The next stage of the [forbidden-grade archer class change quest] has been unlocked.
Do you accept?]

So after reaching level 190, he no longer needed to run back to Luminara and look for his Shadow Song mentor.
The system would directly issue the quest instead.
That saved him quite a lot of time.

Quest Difficulty: Exalted-grade
Quest Objectives:

At the current stage, only an archer who has mastered epic-grade forbidden spells can be considered a true ceiling-level existence.
However, epic-grade forbidden spells are even harder to obtain than ordinary forbidden spells.

chapters.title: Chapter 188 -188-World War Fully Begins, Panic
paragraphs: Test Faustus’s bottom line?
They were not naive enough to believe that Faustus had a good temper!
The group of powerhouses discussed it back and forth, but no matter how many times they went over it, they still could not come up with a result.
Half a day later.
Daniel led his army to press down upon the dwarven territory. Just then, a scout came to report.
"My King, the supreme-grade powerhouse of the dwarven race requests an audience."
Requests an audience?
Daniel smiled and said to Alan,
"You go negotiate. My bottom line is simple—every non-human race supreme-grade powerhouse must sign a Soul Pact with me."
"Those who refuse, I will uproot their race from Aetheria. Those who obediently sign, I will guarantee their race’s safety."
Alan’s eyes lit up.
"As you command, My King."
Daniel nodded.
The non-human races on this continent all had one fatal weakness—
The survival of their race!
The land was only so large, yet so many non-human races were crammed into it. Which one of them was not struggling with everything they had just to survive?
That was why the continuation of their bloodline mattered more to them than anything else.
Daniel believed that the supreme-grade powerhouse of the dwarven race would definitely lower his head.
Otherwise, he did not mind killing the chicken to warn the monkeys and slaughtering them until not a single one remained.
Sure enough, not long after, Alan brought the dwarven powerhouse over.
"My King, he has agreed," Alan said.
The dwarven supreme-grade powerhouse looked at Daniel with complicated eyes, then bowed deeply.
"Salim of the dwarven race greets the noble King!"
Once the dwarven supreme-grade powerhouse lowered his head, the remaining hesitation in the hearts of the other non-human race powerhouses completely disappeared.
Some of them could not even wait for Daniel’s army to arrive and came running over to surrender on their own.
Faced with Daniel’s demand that they sign a Soul Pact, they at most struggled for a brief moment before helplessly signing it.
They truly did not have the confidence to challenge him.
In just one or two short days, the number of supreme-grade powerhouses under Daniel’s command surged to ten!
The non-human races of the Polaris District had all been brought to heel.
Next, it was the turn of the non-human races in World Zone No. 616!
Daniel could not be bothered to waste any more time. He directly led ten supreme-grade powerhouses over and made his stance clear.
All non-human races either submitted to humanity or died!
If they submitted, their races would survive.
If they resisted, their races could wait to be erased!
Faced with such a large group of supreme-grade powerhouses, how could the non-human races of World Zone No. 616 still dare to jump around?
One by one, they obediently signed the contract and acknowledged Daniel as their master.
From that moment on, their lives and deaths were held in his hands.
After this wave, the number of supreme-grade powerhouses under Daniel’s command rose to sixteen!
This world was simply that cruel.
Powerhouses with no family or ties had little to worry about.
But as long as there was a race standing behind them, they would ultimately have to lower their heads to a stronger force.
That was a truth that would never change, no matter where one went.
After Daniel subdued all the non-human races across the two great World Zones, a world announcement rang out.
[World Announcement: The number of players above level 100 in the current game has reached one billion! [Full-Scale World War] has officially begun! All World Barrier portals are now open!]
The announcement rang out three times in a row!
Boom—!
The impact of this news was no different from dropping an atomic bomb.
The players were all stunned.
Of course, what shocked them was not the announcement itself.
Instead, everyone thought of the same person at almost the exact same time—
Faustus!

Once Full-Scale World War began, it meant there would no longer be World Barrier Guardians blocking the way. Every World Zone could now use the portals to attack directly into someone else’s home territory.
But at this moment, players and NPCs around the world had no interest in thinking about whom they should attack.
There was only one thought in their minds.
What would Faustus think after hearing this news?
Who would he strike first?
What if it was their own World Zone’s turn?
Should they resist with everything they had, or should they submit?
The World Channel exploded like a pot of boiling oil.
"It’s over, it’s over! Our World Zone No. 250 is definitely going to be the first unlucky one!"
"WTF! World War has finally fully opened! Lord Faustus, hurry up and come to our side! I’ll tell you the location of our Imperial City’s treasury!"
"Hahahaha... the traitor upstairs is killing me!"
"If all the supreme-grade powerhouses in the world gathered together, maybe they could still wrestle with Faustus a little."
"Stop dreaming, upstairs. Listen to my advice: submit early and enjoy life early. Submit late and suffer for nothing!"
"Lord Faustus, I’m begging you! Come to World Zone No. 840 first and overthrow this rotten world!"
"Lord Faustus, can I reserve a spot in Doom Guild in advance? I am willing to lead everyone in our World Zone to submit to you!"
"Do you people have no shame? Weren’t you the same bunch who used to call him a cheating dog? Ahem... Lord Faustus, are you accepting underlings? I can do it too!"
When the world announcement fell, the emperor of World Zone No. 250 was drinking from a golden goblet.
In the next instant, the golden goblet fell to the floor with a clang, and the wine spilled across the carpet embroidered with an eagle.
His face turned as pale as paper. He collapsed back onto his throne, his lips trembling for a long time before he managed to squeeze out a few words.
"Faustus... he is coming!"
The powerhouses of the Temple of the Gods swarmed in. The supreme-grade powerhouse at the front had an ashen expression.
"Your Majesty, the World Barrier has opened. That war maniac Faustus may descend upon us at any moment."
The emperor suddenly gripped the armrests of his throne, his knuckles turning white.
"Can you stop him?"
The powerhouses looked at one another, falling into silence.
After a long while, someone said in a low voice,
"Your Majesty... why don’t we send an envoy to negotiate first?"
Similar scenes played out one after another in the imperial palaces of the various major zones.
The emperor of World Zone No. 47 flipped a table on the spot and roared that they would fight to the death, but not a single powerhouse from the Temple of the Gods responded.
The emperor of World Zone No. 700 was even more straightforward. He directly ordered someone to draft a surrender letter, waiting only for Faustus’s name to appear before sending it over.
As for the player guilds across the World Zones, they had fallen into complete chaos.
Messages flooded the channels of the major guilds at blinding speed, and panic spread like a plague.
"What is there even to fight? I heard Faustus has even built an angel legion now!"
"They’re all legendary-grade! Once a million Holy Angel Knights stand in the sky, we won’t even be enough to get stuck between their teeth!"
"I said long ago that we shouldn’t oppose Faustus. Great, now we can just wait to die!"
Someone gritted their teeth and quietly opened the guild withdrawal page. After hesitating for a long time, they finally clicked the button.
Meanwhile, those guild leaders who were still shouting, "Better death than surrender," turned around only to discover that more than half of their core members had already left.
The moment Daniel heard the world announcement, the corners of his mouth rose.
Full-Scale World War had opened?
Good.
Excellent!
Now he could attack whoever he wanted and deal with whoever he wished.
However, dealing with them was not the main point.
The main point was gathering supreme-grade powerhouses.
If each World Zone had eight supreme-grade powerhouses...
Daniel blinked.
Then he could add dozens more supreme-grade powerhouses under his command.
However, Daniel had still underestimated his weight in the hearts of the players.
At this moment, the eyes of the entire world were fixed on him.
Not only because he was the strongest player.
Even more importantly, it was because he held the strongest player force and the strongest NPC force in his hands.
On the current level ranking, among the one billion players above level 100, players from the Polaris District and World Zone No. 616 made up ninety-nine percent of them.
It was practically one hundred percent.
But without Daniel’s order, not a single player from the two great World Zones dared to make the first move.
Nor did any World Zone dare to take the initiative to declare war on them.
At this point, they no longer even had the thought of gathering together to resist.
Faustus was invincible!
This was not only the consensus of players across all World Zones.
Even the NPC factions in the outer zones thought the same.

chapters.title: Chapter 189 -189-Rather Die Than Submit? A Mob of Rabble!
paragraphs: Daniel thought it over for a moment and decided that, for this World War, he would only deploy high-level combat power.
He would not bring ordinary players or ordinary NPCs.
Taking the [Holy Angel Legion] alone would be enough.
The reason was simple—
He did not want to drag things out!
Clean and decisive action was the way a real man did things.
Mobilizing tens of millions of troops at every turn wasted resources and time. It would be far more practical to let the players steadily improve their own strength.
Besides, the level of high-end combat power had already changed. With supreme-grade powerhouses presiding over the battlefield, human wave tactics had long since become useless.
In addition, he also wanted a bit of ceremony.
In his previous lives, whenever the various World Zones began a World War, there had been an unwritten rule.
Before attacking, they would first issue a declaration of war, writing a crusade manifesto of several thousand words and making it seem extremely formal.
Only after the players declared war would the system announcement follow up.
Back then, the various World Zones could still take the opportunity to conduct diplomacy, giving rise to a batch of outstanding diplomatic talents.
But in this life, Daniel alone suppressed the entire world.
No matter how eloquently anyone spoke, they still had to tremble beneath his shadow.
Compared to his previous lives, this was indeed a little boring.
Thinking of this, he opened the game forum and directly threw out a post.
"Declaration of War: World Zone No. 117!"
The content of the post was only one sentence:
"First stop, World Zone No. 117!"
Before long, the number of views soared into the billions.
All the players in Stellar learned the news immediately.
Faustus’s first blade was going to fall on World Zone No. 117!
The players of World Zone No. 117 began leaving comments underneath one after another.
"Arrogant fool! You don’t know death when you see it!"
"@Faustus, we are not those spineless cowards from World Zone No. 1213! The warriors of our World Zone No. 117 are invincible in battle!"
"Although I’m a player from World Zone No. 117, I actually have a brain. Let me be blunt: if you want to make an enemy of a god, go ahead. I’m surrendering first!"
"You coward! You are simply a disgrace to our World Zone!"
"Exactly! With the protection of the gods, our World Zone will definitely defeat Faustus’s so-called undefeated legendary-grade army with ease!"

"That’s right. The reason that cheating dog Faustus can be so arrogant right now is entirely because he has yet to encounter our World Zone No. 117! Once he comes here and gets dealt with, he’ll wake up to reality!"
"Hahahaha... when the time comes, we’ll let all the players in Stellar see who the true number one player of Stellar really is!"
The confidence of the players in World Zone No. 117 was carved into their very bones.
It was almost absurd.
It was as though destiny itself was supposed to favor them.
If Faustus had not appeared out of nowhere, they probably would have truly regarded themselves as Stellar’s number one World Zone.
More than half of the players in World Zone No. 117 clamored that they would teach Faustus a bloody lesson and make him understand what "untouchable" meant.
The remaining tiny minority were clear-headed, but faced with such one-sided public opinion, all they could do was sigh helplessly.
Naturally, those arrogant remarks drew ridicule from all of Stellar.
"Where did you people get that courage?"
"Faustus alone is enough to flatten the entirety of World Zone No. 117."
"Everyone, how about we make a bet? How long will it take Faustus to break through World Zone No. 117?"
"I guess within one day!"
"That’s too vague. Be bolder. I guess around ten hours!"
"I’ll bet 100,000 gold coins on five hours!"

At Daniel’s command, the million-strong Holy Angel Legion formed ranks in the World Barrier teleportation area like a forest of steel. Their iron wings blotted out the sky, and sacred light surged like a tide!
Accompanying him were also sixteen supreme-grade powerhouses, the aura radiating from their bodies enough to make heaven and earth change color.
This trip was meant to show off his might!
If it truly came to fighting, sixteen supreme-grade powerhouses would already be more than enough.
But he insisted on announcing it to everyone in World Zone No. 117.
I have a million Holy Angel Knights.
To destroy a tiny World Zone like yours, I do not even need to lift a finger myself.
"Set out!"
The World Barrier portal lit up with a thunderous roar, its radiance shooting straight into the clouds.
In the next instant, a world announcement exploded.
[World Announcement: Polaris and World Zone No. 616 have joined forces and officially declared war on [World Zone No. 117]!]
World Zone No. 117, above the World Barrier portal.
Daniel hovered in the void, his robes fluttering wildly, like a deity descending into the mortal world.
Before him, millions of players from World Zone No. 117 had actually gathered, forming a so-called "interception army."
But at this moment, those millions of people raised their heads and stared blankly at the lone, peerless figure in midair.
Faustus...
Was he truly a god?
However, an even greater shock followed immediately after.
Buzz, buzz, buzz—!
Buzz, buzz, buzz—!
From within the portal, Holywing Angels emerged one after another.
Ten thousand.
One hundred thousand.
One million!
Over one million Holy Angel Knights formed a neat battle formation in the sky. Their wings connected into a golden canopy, and the shadow they cast covered the earth below.
This scene was like a hammer weighing ten thousand tons smashing brutally into the chests of the players from World Zone No. 117, crushing the confidence they had been so proud of into pieces.
Holy Angel Knights!
One million legendary-grade soldiers!
Was there even any need to fight?
Whoosh—!
Almost in an instant, the millions-strong crowd collapsed and scattered at terrifying speed, fleeing in panic with their heads in their hands.
The legion commander screamed himself hoarse, but he could not make even a single figure stop.
Very soon, beneath those mysteriously confident posts, one gloomy comment after another began appearing.
Those who had once shouted "rather die than submit" were now humbly discussing how to negotiate with Faustus and how to secure dignified terms of surrender.
A faint smile hung at the corner of Daniel’s mouth as he calmly watched the defeated soldiers fleeing across the mountains and plains.
With the experience of several lifetimes, he understood the nature of these people all too well.
This scene had long been within his expectations.
He shook his head.
At this stage, players were still too immature.
The ones who truly controlled the lifeline of a World Zone were still the NPC factions.
Players had yet to develop to the point where they could decide the rise and fall of an entire zone.
NPCs, on the other hand, were often far more aware of the times than players.
They understood better what it meant for something to be impossible to defy!
He raised his hand slightly.
His voice was not loud, yet it clearly entered everyone’s ears.
"March!"
"To the Imperial City!"
World Zone No. 117, Imperial City.
Inside the palace, candlelight flickered.
The emperor was surrounded by the powerhouses of the Temple of the Gods, caught in a dilemma with no way forward or back.
"Your Majesty, we should surrender."
"Faustus has more than ten supreme-grade powerhouses under his command. My Temple of the Gods only has two. What are we supposed to use to oppose him?"
The emperor’s face was ashen, and his fingers gripping the armrest of the throne had turned white at the knuckles.
"I understand... but... I am unwilling!"
The powerhouses of the Temple of the Gods all sighed.
"Your Majesty, unwilling or not, there is nothing we can do!"
"For the sake of all the citizens of the empire, we humbly request that Your Majesty make a decision as soon as possible."
The emperor opened his mouth, but no words came out.
What a fine excuse—
For the sake of all the citizens of the empire!

These powerhouses of the Temple of the Gods, who usually shouted about fighting and killing and claimed to be invincible under the heavens, now looked as though they wished they could tie him to a white flag and roll and crawl all the way to Faustus’s feet.
"I am unwilling—!"
The emperor looked up to the heavens and let out a long sigh, his voice filled with helplessness.
