chapters.title: Chapter 190 -190-Stubborn as Iron, the Emperor Offers Tribute
paragraphs: Daniel descended above the Imperial City and looked down from the sky.
Before he even made a move, he saw the powerhouses of the Temple of the Gods come out to greet him one after another with smiling faces.
Some of them even dragged the emperor forward and forcefully pushed him ahead. Their expressions clearly seemed to say:
Esteemed guest, you have come from afar. Please accept this meeting gift!
A playful smile tugged at the corner of Daniel’s mouth.
He understood that these NPCs cherished their lives.
But if they thought he would let them off lightly, they were dreaming.
He stated his conditions on the spot.
First, the emperor must abdicate, and Daniel would take control of the royal authority.
Second, every powerhouse of the Temple of the Gods must sign a Soul Pact and become his servants forever.
If they agreed, everything could be discussed.
If they refused?
He possessed Seraphic Revival. Killing these supreme-grade powerhouses and reviving them afterward would only cost him a little more gold coin.
What he wanted was the supreme authority of World Zone No. 117.
If they could negotiate, then they would negotiate.
If not, then they would meet on the battlefield!
The human NPCs of World Zone No. 117 were still hesitating, but the non-human race powerhouses had already come forward to submit first.
Right in front of the Temple of the Gods and the emperor, Daniel signed contracts with the non-human race supreme-grade powerhouses.
For a moment, more than twenty supreme-grade powerhouses turned their gazes at the same time, staring hungrily at the human Temple of the Gods.
Those newly submitted non-human race powerhouses wished these human powerhouses would show a bit of backbone, just so they could establish merit in front of their new master.
"Submit, or die."
The human supreme-grade powerhouses no longer had any choice.
The emperor abdicated in despair, and every member of the Temple of the Gods signed the Soul Pact.
Then, a world announcement thundered across the skies!
[World Announcement: Player "Faustus" has occupied [World Zone No. 117]!]
The news spread throughout Stellar, shaking the entire world.
How long had it been?
Not even half a day!
That World Zone No. 117, which had been so stubborn and defiant, had actually fallen into Faustus’s hands just like that?
It could only be said that they were not too weak.
Faustus was simply too strong.
So strong that he made people despair.
So strong that he was like an insurmountable divine mountain, pressing down on everyone’s heart.
Daniel obtained the highest royal authority of World Zone No. 117 almost without obstruction.
But this was not the end.
Next came the plan for dealing with the players of World Zone No. 117.
Compared with those rigid NPCs, players were the more troublesome opponents.
But Daniel himself had started as a player, so no one understood these players better than him.
He personally drafted a set of rules aimed at the players of World Zone No. 117.
In the future, this set of rules would be implemented like iron law across every inch of foreign land he conquered.
He dictated the decree, while the administrative officer beside him wrote furiously.
"First, only players of World Zone No. 117 who have registered and joined the [Otherworld Mercenaries] will be qualified to continue walking the path of a combat class."
These so-called [Otherworld Mercenaries] were shackles he had specially created for combat-type players from foreign worlds.
He had no intention of forcing everyone to become farmers and blacksmiths. That would be far too oppressive.
The desire to become stronger was the nature of players.
So he hung chains on the gates of the legion.
Want to fight?
Fine!
But only those who loyally risked their lives for him would have the right to enjoy becoming stronger.
As for those who harbored ulterior motives, they could be imprisoned in Starter Village for the rest of their lives, while carrying a debt they could never repay.
"Second, those unwilling to take up weapons shall grip hoes and hammers instead. The doors of lifestyle classes will always remain open."
The administrative officer’s brush flew like a dragon and snake, engraving these two iron laws onto the scroll.
Then, under Daniel’s instruction, they were made public.
As soon as the decree was released, the players of World Zone No. 117 collectively exploded.
Some angrily cursed that this was a humiliating betrayal of sovereignty. Others roared that Faustus was severing their lifeline and took all their resentment to the forum.
But so what?
The wails of World Zone No. 117 could not win a single tear from players of other zones.
There were even players from World Zone No. 1213 who stepped forward to speak from personal experience.
They had once shouted too.
They had once struggled too.
And in the end, had they not obediently become farmers?
Fight?
Dream on.
Being able to continue playing was already good enough.
As for whether this game was truly necessary to play?
For quite a number of worlds, the miraculous traits of Stellar had gradually been exposed.
Even in World Zone No. 1213, there had once been a wave of players quitting the game.
But very quickly, they discovered that the physical condition of high-level players had greatly improved. Some people could even use their talents in the real world!
Only at that moment did countless players of World Zone No. 1213 finally understand what they had lost.
Facing a game with endless possibilities, they had to keep playing no matter how unwilling they were!
The current players of World Zone No. 117 were in roughly the same situation.
Trash talk was only trash talk in the end.
Anyone who dared to personally test the law would be greeted by the sealed gates of every city.
Not even a straw hut in Starter Village would leave a place for him!
They could roll off into the wilderness and play by themselves!
With World Zone No. 117 settled, Daniel’s finger once again tapped on the forum, and another declaration of war post was issued.
Next stop—
World Zone No. 82!
The players of World Zone No. 82 were unusually united against a common enemy.
Beneath the post, their shouting shook the heavens.
"No need for nonsense! Let’s fight him to the death!"
"Exactly! Faustus wants us to lower our heads? Dream on! We would rather drag the entire world into the grave with us!"
"We would rather shatter this land into pieces than leave him a single brick or tile!"
They jumped up and down, lobbying everywhere, and actually persuaded a number of NPC factions to swear that they would fight Daniel to the bitter end!
But when Daniel set foot in World Zone No. 82, there was not a single person blocking the World Barrier.
Only the supreme-grade powerhouses of the non-human races stood in formation, respectfully waiting for him.
"My elven race is willing to serve you as our master!"
"Lord Faustus’s divine might is enough to crush the stars. How would we dare compete with the radiance of the sun and moon?"
"My race is willing to serve you as our master! That human emperor trembling on his throne is not even worthy of carrying your shoes!"
"We are willing to submit from the bottom of our hearts! From this day forward, your will shall be the air we breathe, and your wrath shall be the thunder above our heads!"
Daniel blinked.
He accepted everyone who came, incorporating all the non-human race powerhouses under his command.
Then he flew straight toward the Imperial City.
Beneath the Imperial City, blades and spears stood like a forest, and the defenses were extremely strict.
A cold smile appeared at the corner of Daniel’s mouth.
World Zone No. 82 was indeed just as foul and stubborn as he remembered.
Good.
They would be perfect for making an example of.
Just as he raised Stellar Wrath, chaos suddenly erupted inside the Imperial City.
The powerhouses of the Temple of the Gods and a group of players had actually turned against their own side. They slaughtered their compatriots, tied up the emperor, and shoved him before Daniel.
"My King Faustus! We were only pretending to obey those rioters earlier! We only pretended to resist your heavenly might..."
"All of this was for the sake of clearing out your true enemies! We sincerely submit to you and have absolutely no second thoughts!"
Daniel rolled his eyes, momentarily speechless.
World Zone No. 82 had surrendered just like that, in such a muddled and ridiculous way?
Their treatment?
Exactly the same as World Zone No. 117.
At the same time, the cold system notifications resounded throughout Stellar.
[World Announcement: Player "Faustus" has occupied [World Zone No. 82]!]
The system notifications poured down like a torrential rain, without the slightest pause.
[World Announcement: Player "Faustus" has occupied [World Zone No. 250]!]
[World Announcement: Player "Faustus" has occupied [World Zone No. 47]!]
[World Announcement: Player "Faustus" has occupied [World Zone No. 700]!]
[World Announcement: Player "Faustus" has occupied [World Zone No. 840]!]
[World Announcement: Player "Faustus" has occupied [World Zone No. 38]!]

He accepted everyone who came, incorporating all the non-human race powerhouses under his command.
Then he flew straight toward the Imperial City.
Beneath the Imperial City, blades and spears stood like a forest, and the defenses were extremely strict.
A cold smile appeared at the corner of Daniel’s mouth.
World Zone No.
82 was indeed just as foul and stubborn as he remembered.
Good.
They would be perfect for making an example of.
Just as he raised Stellar Wrath, chaos suddenly erupted inside the Imperial City.
The powerhouses of the Temple of the Gods and a group of players had actually turned against their own side.
They slaughtered their compatriots, tied up the emperor, and shoved him before Daniel.
"My King Faustus!
We were only pretending to obey those rioters earlier!
We only pretended to resist your heavenly might..."
"All of this was for the sake of clearing out your true enemies!
We sincerely submit to you and have absolutely no second thoughts!"
Daniel rolled his eyes, momentarily speechless.
World Zone No.
82 had surrendered just like that, in such a muddled and ridiculous way?
Their treatment?
Exactly the same as World Zone No.

chapters.title: Chapter 191 -191-Lord of Worlds, Ragnarok
paragraphs: Twelve major World Zones had fallen within a single day.
It was like a row of dominoes. Once those top-tier regions submitted, countless smaller World Zones also proved very sensible and took the initiative to deliver their letters of surrender to Daniel.
The process unfolded in all kinds of bizarre ways.

World Zone No. 250 had originally planned to join forces with World Zone No. 47 and clash head-on with Faustus. Yet before they could act, the players from both regions were the first to rise in rebellion.
They marched into the streets, joined forces with supreme-grade powerhouses from the non-human races, and even surrounded the Imperial City, forcing the NPC factions into submission.
"You want to die? Fine, but don’t drag us down with you!"
Daniel had not even arrived, yet the storm was already sweeping through the land.
The players would rather wage bloody war against their native NPC forces than make an enemy of Faustus.
The battle in the Mystic Realm World War had already beaten the fear deep into their bones.
As one World Zone after another fell, the legends surrounding Faustus grew increasingly exaggerated, increasingly sinister, and increasingly absurd.
By the end, they had lost even the courage to look up at him.
They did not fear Faustus’s blade.
They feared the idiots among their own NPC factions angering this living god.
If his wrath descended upon them, and even their last scraps of lenient treatment were taken away, would they not end up like the players of World Zone No. 1213, all forced into life professions?
Faced with such surging public fury, the NPC factions were helpless. In the end, they could only raise the flag of surrender.
Thus, on the very day the World War began, Daniel swept through Stellar with thunderous momentum and brought every World Zone under his control.
The gains from this campaign were impossible to measure.
What moved him the most was the explosive increase in the number of supreme-grade powerhouses under his command.
Ninety-six!
In particular, the resources of the twelve major World Zones had all fallen into his palm.
And the fate of countless players was now clenched in his hand.
Daniel returned to the Polaris Zone.
The moment he stepped into the Imperial City, he received an abdication decree from the emperor of World Zone No. 616.
That old emperor was handing over the throne of his own accord!
Daniel did not know whether to laugh or cry.
For such a major affair, the emperor had not even shown his face. He had simply sent an envoy to read out the decree in a perfunctory manner.
Was that not far too lacking in dignity?
But after thinking about it, Daniel could understand.
The emperor had probably been scared out of his wits.
Daniel had practically swallowed the entire world of Stellar. Only World Zone No. 616 had yet to fall into his pocket.

The old emperor was likely spending every day and night in terror, afraid that he might one day be bound and dragged away as well. Rather than wait for that fate, it was better to abdicate early and preserve a final trace of dignity.
From this moment onward, the authority over the twelve major World Zones and more than a hundred smaller World Zones belonged entirely to Daniel.
He was crowned Lord of Worlds.
All realms bowed their heads.
At the same time, reward notifications began ringing one after another.

[World Announcement: Congratulations to player "Faustus" for occupying all player World Zones and becoming the first conqueror to unify Stellar! Special reward: Current-version top-tier class-exclusive [Skill Book Selection Chest (???)] ×1!]
[World Announcement: The second phase of the new version is about to begin — [Ragnarok]!]
[World Announcement: [Ragnarok] countdown: 10:46:46!]
One announcement after another exploded beside the ears of every player.
The contents were explosive enough.
Not only had they announced that Daniel had obtained one heaven-defying reward, but they had also revealed the second phase of the new version.
One had to know that the players had not even fully figured out the contents of the first phase yet, and the second phase was already on its way!
Now, under the backdrop of a fully united Stellar world, the players’ mentality had become unbelievably optimistic.
There was no longer any risk of internal war. They could pour all their time and energy into advancing the game’s progress.
Conquering the new version.
Clearing every instance.
Researching class combinations.
And this sudden "Ragnarok" had also stirred up immense curiosity among them. Posts on the forums poured out like snowflakes, with wild guesses flying everywhere.
System notifications continued ringing beside Daniel’s ears.
[Ding! You have obtained the achievement [Stellar Conqueror]!]
[Ding! [Stellar Conqueror] achievement reward: [Class Random Skill Chest (???)] ×1, [God-grade Random Item Chest (???)] ×1, [Random Talent Chest (???)] ×1!]
[Ding! You have obtained the world-class reward [Skill Book Selection Chest (???)] ×1!]
Skill rewards!
Daniel’s eyes lit up. He immediately took out the rewards.
The one that made him the most eager was undoubtedly the talent chest.
Just how powerful talents were could be seen from the SSS-grade talents he already possessed.
Any one of them, if given to an ordinary player, would allow that person to soar into the sky instantly.
Although an achievement reward might not necessarily reach Daniel’s heaven-defying level, it definitely would not be weak.
His luck had always been good.
This time, he hoped he could open an absurdly powerful talent ability.
He lowered his head and looked at the chest.
[Random Talent Chest (???)]
Level: ???
Grade: ???
Effect: After use, randomly obtain one top-tier talent.

Description: Every SSS-grade talent is a unique mark of destiny among the myriad worlds. Once carried by one person, it shall never descend upon a second. Only those blessed by both time and fortune, those who rise above countless billions of living beings, are qualified to be chosen by this supreme and boundless power.
After reading it, Daniel took a deep breath.
[Ding! Use [Random Talent Chest (???)]?]
"Confirm!"
He did not hesitate at all.
[Ding! You have obtained the SSS-grade talent [Crusader’s Physique]!]
This was...
A combat-type talent?
Daniel’s eyes shifted.
Judging from the name, it sounded like something exclusive to warriors.
He impatiently opened his talent panel. Lines of golden text appeared before his eyes.
[Crusader’s Physique (SSS-grade)] (Unique)
Effects:
Allows the fusion of weapon attributes. Removes forced casting intervals. Weapon and body become one, allowing skills to be cast instantly.
Immortal Singularity acquisition speed increased by one hundred times! Immortal Singularity capacity increased by ten times!
The four core attributes may be freely converted and stacked onto any single attribute without limits on frequency or duration.
HP and MP may be freely converted and stacked without limits on frequency or duration.
All skills currently being released by the user may be freely dismantled and reconstructed.
Daniel read through it word by word.
His hands trembled.
A heaven-defying top-tier talent!
What kind of luck was this?
Was this not invincible?
He took a deep breath and forced himself to calm down.
Then he shook his head and raised his hand.
Stellar Wrath in his hand began to glow. Gradually, it merged into his body, like ice melting into water, like light sinking into the void.
And yet, he could still clearly feel that he was able to use his skills.
He no longer needed Stellar Wrath!
This was the first effect of Crusader’s Physique: weapon fusion.
But that was far from everything.
The truly heaven-defying part of the first effect was the removal of forced casting intervals.
This game originally had mandatory casting intervals.
A one-second cooldown.
In other words, no matter how fast one’s hands were, casting eight skills would still honestly take eight seconds.
But now, everything was different.
Within a single second, he could release eight million skills.
In theory, as long as he had enough mana, he could cast as many skills as he wanted.
As fast as his hands could move, as fast as his mind could command, that was how quickly his skills could be unleashed!
It was just that tyrannical.
That unreasonable.
Even a Gatling gun had a cooldown.
Daniel no longer had even that.
With a single thought, he truly could destroy everything!

chapters.title: Chapter 192 -192-Infinite Rebirth, Soulfire
paragraphs: Daniel looked toward the second effect.
Immortal Singularity acquisition speed increased by one hundred times!
Previously, it had been one point every six minutes.
Now, it was one hundred points every six minutes!
That speed would make even supreme-grade powerhouses stare with their jaws on the floor.
Not to mention, the capacity had also increased tenfold. His current Immortal Singularity storage had reached fifty thousand points!
And this was not something created through Replica Crystal. This was the genuine reserve he had accumulated himself. The value behind it was completely different.
With this effect alone, his strength had surged by more than ten times!
The third effect was even more inhuman. His four core attributes could now be converted at will and stacked entirely onto a single attribute.

He had hundreds of thousands of attribute points in his hands. If he poured them all into Defense, then combined that with the enhancement of Immortal Singularity, he could stand still and let supreme-grade powerhouses attack him until they started doubting their very lives.
The fourth effect was equally explosive.
HP and MP could be converted and stacked with each other.
His MP had already broken past the trillion mark. If he converted all of his mana into HP, then stacked it together with the third effect...
Hah.
A whole group of supreme-grade powerhouses could beat him from morning to night, from Monday to Sunday, and not even a single hair on his body would fall off!
The fifth effect looked even stronger, and it clearly required far more technical skill.
Daniel vaguely felt that this effect might be the true core of Crusader’s Physique.
But as for how exactly it was meant to be used, he would have to explore it himself.
With that thought, he reached out and snapped his fingers.
Snap—!
One blue ring of light after another suddenly appeared in the sky.
Ice elements condensed into sharp icicles, each one hovering in midair, ready to fire.
After fusing with his weapon, he no longer needed Stellar Wrath. With a single thought, he could release his skills.
He quietly sensed the difference between this skill and how it had felt in the past.
Soon, he faintly grasped the trick to it.
Those icicles hung in the sky. Ice elements gathered madly, yet they did not fall.
In the past, once a skill was released, it could no longer be controlled.
The icicles of Permafrost Prison would only smash down uncontrollably like rain.
But now, it was different.
With a single thought, he controlled the flow of those ice elements.
Almost in the blink of an eye, a hundred-meter-tall ice elemental giant suddenly took form!
The giant stood in the air behind him, obedient and unmoving, like a silent guardian.
Then Daniel had another thought.

The ice elemental giant abruptly scattered, transforming into a crystalline suit of ice armor that wrapped around his entire body. At his fists, two enormous ice-crystal gauntlets condensed into shape.
He lowered his head and looked at himself, sensing the wondrous Strength of a skill shifting according to his will.
The corners of his mouth slowly curled upward.
"Anything I want, huh?"
Battle intent burned in his eyes.
"I like it."
With another thought from Daniel, the ice armor on his body dissolved like smoke.
So this was how powerful the fifth effect of Crusader’s Physique was.
It could dismantle and reconstruct every skill currently being released.
The stronger the skill itself, the more terrifying the reconstructed power would become.
If he dismantled an epic-grade forbidden spell...
Just imagining that scene was enough to make one’s scalp go numb.
Moreover, all effects could be stacked as he wished, and special effects could also be preserved.
Crusader’s Physique was terrifying to such an extent!
Between the achievement rewards and the world reward, there were four chests in total.
He had only opened the first one.
There were still three waiting for him.
He took out the second one, the [Special Random Item Chest].
[Special Random Item Chest (SSS-grade)]
Level: !
Grade: supreme-grade
Effect: After opening, randomly obtain one special item.
Description: The reason special items are special is that they often possess heaven-defying effects capable of breaking the balance.
Daniel took a deep breath and decisively opened the chest.
[Ding! You have obtained the special item [Growth Elixir (supreme-grade low-grade)]!]
His eyes shifted.
A potion!
And it was even a heaven-defying regeneration potion!
But this was not the end.
He immediately sold the item to the guild.
[Ding! You have sold [Growth Elixir (supreme-grade low-grade)] to Doom Guild for 1 copper coin, triggering Millionfold Boost!]
[The sold item is a potion-type item. Please choose quality boost / quantity boost!]
"Quality boost!"
[Ding! Congratulations, you have obtained 1 gold coin! You have obtained [Immortal Revival Elixir (Divine-grade)] ×1!]
[As the shackles of the world level are broken, item grades can also ascend to even higher levels.]
Daniel’s mind buzzed.
A Divine-grade Immortal Revival Elixir.
Just looking at the name alone gave off an invincible aura!
He quickly held the potion in his hands.
To him, potions were more practical than anything else.
Because potions granted buff effects, and the [Eternal Ring] on his body specialized in turning buff effects permanent!
Any buff that landed on him would automatically become permanent. Furthermore, it could not be purified or dispelled.
This Immortal Revival Elixir had come at the perfect time.
He lowered his head and looked at the potion bottle in his hand. The liquid inside glowed with a faint golden light, like solidified sunlight.
[Immortal Revival Elixir (supreme-grade peak)]
Grade: Divine-grade
Effect: After use, obtain the buff [Infinite Rebirth] for 60 minutes. Full-state resurrection.
Infinite Rebirth — As long as you leave behind a single strand of hair or a single drop of blood in this world, you can resurrect in full condition.
Daniel’s hand trembled slightly as he gripped the potion bottle.
To him, this potion had no flaws.
Perfect!
He impatiently pulled out the stopper, raised his head, and drank it down.
Gulp—
Gulp—
[Ding! You have used the potion [Undying and Indestructible]. Status bar updated. Please check.]
He opened his status bar.
Sure enough, the buff effect was clearly displayed.
[Eternal Ring enhancement: Duration — Permanent!]
He clenched his fist fiercely.
Permanent!
In other words, from this moment onward, he could use Infinite Rebirth endlessly, becoming a truly undying and indestructible existence.
Of course, the premise was that he was not directly erased by a top-tier powerhouse until not even a single hair remained.
Next, there were still two chests left unopened.
Both of them were skill chests.
Daniel had a feeling.
This wave of gains would be absurdly massive!
He took out the third chest.
[Random Skill Chest (SSS-grade)] (Archer)
Level: !
Grade: supreme-grade
Effect: Randomly obtain one class-exclusive skill book.
He opened the chest.
[Ding! You have opened the skill chest and obtained the skill book [Cityscorch Inferno (SSS-grade forbidden spell)]!]
A forbidden spell!
The level of this reward had instantly risen!
"However, it can still go one step further!"
[Ding! You have sold the skill book [Cityscorch Inferno (SSS-grade forbidden spell)] to Doom Guild for 1 copper coin, triggering Millionfold Boost!]
[The sold item is a skill book-type item. Please choose quality boost / quantity boost!]
"Quality boost!"
[Ding! Congratulations, you have obtained 1 gold coin! You have obtained the skill book [Annihilation Flame (epic-grade forbidden spell)] ×1!]
An epic-grade forbidden spell!
Daniel could not help but suck in a breath of cold air.
Powerful!
His class change mission required him to gather three epic-grade forbidden spells of three different elements.
With this one added in, he was only missing one more.
And he still had one skill chest in his hands.
In other words, there was now a real chance that he could complete his class change mission directly!
He hurriedly opened the skill book.
[Annihilation Flame (epic-grade forbidden spell)]
Restriction: Forbidden Archer
Grade: epic-grade

Effect: Summons [Annihilation Flame Flowers] — this fire is a ghostly blue color. Anything it touches will freeze. Anything it freezes will burn. It specializes in attacking the soul and ignores soul defense. Damage is equal to the caster’s base attack power.
Cost: 10% MP
Duration: 10 minutes

[As the shackles of the world level are broken, item grades can also ascend to even higher levels.]
Daniel’s mind buzzed.
A Divine-grade Immortal Revival Elixir.
Just looking at the name alone gave off an invincible aura!
He quickly held the potion in his hands.
To him, potions were more practical than anything else.
Because potions granted buff effects, and the [Eternal Ring] on his body specialized in turning buff effects permanent!
Any buff that landed on him would automatically become permanent.
Furthermore, it could not be purified or dispelled.
This Immortal Revival Elixir had come at the perfect time.
He lowered his head and looked at the potion bottle in his hand.
The liquid inside glowed with a faint golden light, like solidified sunlight.
[Immortal Revival Elixir (supreme-grade peak)]
Grade: Divine-grade
Effect: After use, obtain the buff [Infinite Rebirth] for 60 minutes.
Full-state resurrection.
Infinite Rebirth — As long as you leave behind a single strand of hair or a single drop of blood in this world, you can resurrect in full condition.
Daniel’s hand trembled slightly as he gripped the potion bottle.
To him, this potion had no flaws.
Perfect!
He impatiently pulled out the stopper, raised his head, and drank it down.
Gulp—
Gulp—
[Ding!
You have used the potion [Undying and Indestructible].
Status bar updated.
Please check.]
He opened his status bar.
Sure enough, the buff effect was clearly displayed.
[Eternal Ring enhancement: Duration — Permanent!]
He clenched his fist fiercely.
Permanent!
In other words, from this moment onward, he could use Infinite Rebirth endlessly, becoming a truly undying and indestructible existence.
Of course, the premise was that he was not directly erased by a top-tier powerhouse until not even a single hair remained.
Next, there were still two chests left unopened.
Both of them were skill chests.
Daniel had a feeling.
This wave of gains would be absurdly massive!
He took out the third chest.
[Random Skill Chest (SSS-grade)] (Archer)
Level: !
Grade: supreme-grade
Effect: Randomly obtain one class-exclusive skill book.
He opened the chest.
[Ding!
You have opened the skill chest and obtained the skill book [Cityscorch Inferno (SSS-grade forbidden spell)]!]
A forbidden spell!
The level of this reward had instantly risen!
"However, it can still go one step further!"
[Ding!
You have sold the skill book [Cityscorch Inferno (SSS-grade forbidden spell)] to Doom Guild for 1 copper coin, triggering Millionfold Boost!]
[The sold item is a skill book-type item.
Please choose quality boost / quantity boost!]
"Quality boost!"
[Ding!
Congratulations, you have obtained 1 gold coin!
You have obtained the skill book [Annihilation Flame (epic-grade forbidden spell)] ×1!]
An epic-grade forbidden spell!
Daniel could not help but suck in a breath of cold air.
Powerful!
His class change mission required him to gather three epic-grade forbidden spells of three different elements.
With this one added in, he was only missing one more.
And he still had one skill chest in his hands.
In other words, there was now a real chance that he could complete his class change mission directly!
He hurriedly opened the skill book.
[Annihilation Flame (epic-grade forbidden spell)]
Restriction: Forbidden Archer
Grade: epic-grade
Effect: Summons [Annihilation Flame Flowers] — this fire is a ghostly blue color.
Anything it touches will freeze.
Anything it freezes will burn.
It specializes in attacking the soul and ignores soul defense.
Damage is equal to the caster’s base attack power.
Cost: 10% MP
Duration: 10 minutes

chapters.title: Chapter 193 -193-Veil of Eternal Night, Oracle!
paragraphs: Soul attack!
An absolute top-tier effect!
And it was even an epic-grade forbidden spell!
What else was there to say?
Learn it!
[Ding! You have learned the epic-grade forbidden spell [Annihilation Flame]!]
[Prompt: Skill bar updated. Please check the details.]
He skipped over it directly, his gaze landing on the final chest.
This one was not a random chest.
It was a selection chest.
[Skill Selection Chest (SSS-grade)]
[Ding! You have used [Skill Selection Chest (SSS-grade)]. Please select a skill book.]
Whoosh—!
A selection interface popped up in Daniel’s vision. Options for all kinds of classes were arranged neatly before him.
He selected Archer.
The interface changed, and a densely packed skill list entered his eyes.
He swept a glance across it and decisively chose a dark-element skill book.
Dark-element skills were extremely difficult to obtain, and their negative status effects were exceptionally fierce.
What he lacked right now was precisely a forbidden spell-level debuff skill.
[Ding! You have selected the Archer skill book [Endless Nightfall (SSS-grade forbidden spell)]! Please confirm.]
"Confirm!"
[Ding! You have obtained the forbidden spell skill book [Endless Nightfall (supreme-grade low-grade)]!]
[Ding! You have sold the skill book [Endless Nightfall (supreme-grade low-grade)] to Doom Guild for 1 copper coin, triggering Millionfold Boost!]
[The sold item is a skill book-type item. Please choose quality boost / quantity boost!]
[Ding! Congratulations, you have obtained 1 gold coin! You have obtained the skill book [Veil of Eternal Night (epic-grade forbidden spell)] ×1!]
[As the world level cap is unlocked, this skill’s grade will continue to rise.]
Millionfold Boost was truly heaven-defying!
He opened the skill book radiating a dim, shadowy glow.
[Veil of Eternal Night (epic-grade forbidden spell)]
Restriction: Forbidden Archer
Grade: epic-grade

Effect: After use, summons [Veil of Eternal Night] within a range of 100,000 by 100,000. Under the shroud of night, all living beings will be forcibly inflicted with statuses such as [Slumber], [Mental Corruption], and [Five-Sense Seal].
[Slumber]: Causes the target to fall into sleep. Cannot be awakened.
[Mental Corruption]: Inflicts permanent damage on the target’s mind.
[Five-Sense Seal]: Blindness, sealed speech, deafness, blocked smell, bodily stagnation—the five senses are fully sealed, as if falling into the void.
Cost: 10% MP
Duration: 10 minutes
Invincible!
Daniel learned it without the slightest hesitation.
[Ding! You have learned the epic-grade forbidden spell [Veil of Eternal Night]!]
[Prompt: Skill bar updated. Please check the details.]
At the same time—
[Ding! Your class change mission has been completed!]
[Ding! Congratulations, class change successful!]
[Prompt: The seal on your experience bar has been lifted. You may continue leveling.]
Daniel’s eyes lit up!
The endless star sea.
Canaan Starfield.
Nebulae drifted like gauze, and stars scattered like dust.
A ray of holy light wound its way over from the distant end of a galaxy, descending upon a colossal city suspended in the void.
The Angel King folded away his holy wings and stepped onto this land where powerhouses gathered like clouds.
"Angel King, I didn’t expect you to come too."
"Old fellow, long time no see. You don’t look too well."
"Come over to my place later. I recently obtained a top-tier holy medicine."
The Angel King forced a smile onto his face and returned the greetings one by one.
Yet in his heart, it felt as if a mountain were pressing down on him, so heavy he could hardly breathe.
The source of his worry sounded laughable when spoken aloud.
It was nothing more than a damned human appearing in his small world.
Not only had that human become enemies with the angel race, he had even barged into the Angel Plane and slain the Angel King’s avatar.
That alone would have been tolerable.
But that damned thing had actually dared to enslave the entire angel race!
Whenever he thought of his people being wantonly driven around by a human, the Angel King hated him so much that his teeth itched.
But Divine-grade powerhouses could not descend into small worlds.
Even if he wanted revenge, he first had to create another avatar.
Unfortunately, how could creating an avatar be so easy?
"Angel King, you don’t seem very happy."
An old friend beside him leaned over and lowered his voice.
"Is it because Jesse stepped into the Oracle-grade realm before us, so you feel uncomfortable?"
The Angel King was startled and hurriedly waved his hand.
"Don’t speak nonsense. I have no such thought."
He glanced at the long-robed young man surrounded by the crowd—
Jesse!
Then he shook his head with a bitter smile.
"It is merely that something happened in my small world. Today is Lord Jesse’s celebration. Let us properly witness the glory of Oracle-grade!"
The celebration was held in the center of the city.
Thousands of tables were lined up beneath the starlight, and fine wine and delicacies were brought forth like flowing water.
Although the Angel King was a Divine-grade powerhouse, within the Endless Starfield, Divine-grade beings were nothing more than slightly larger ants.
He obediently chose a seat at the very end, sat down with his neck tucked in, and peered through the layers upon layers of heads, his gaze falling on today’s main character.
Jesse had originally been Divine-grade as well. Only recently had he broken through to Oracle-grade.
His status and Contribution Points had risen along with the tide.
Even the Angel King no longer dared to call him by name. When they met, he had to respectfully address him as "Lord."
The celebration began.
The Angel King stared without blinking.
Jesse walked over step by step from the void, his long robe dragging behind him.
He hovered in midair, his gaze sweeping across the full hall of guests. The corners of his mouth rose slightly.
"I wish for this world to bloom with flowers."
His voice was not loud, yet it entered the ears of every living being present with perfect clarity.
Boom—!
The earth trembled.
All things revived.
Flowers that should not have bloomed in this season began competing to open their petals.
In a single instant, from the courtyards within the city to the distant mountains and wilderness, from the deep ravines of secluded valleys to the cliffs of snow-covered peaks...
All flowers, regardless of species or season, bloomed at once!
Purples and reds competed in splendor. The flowers spread like clouds and brocade, drowning the entire city in a sea of blossoms.
"Wow... unbelievable!"
"So beautiful! As expected of Oracle-grade!"
The guests cheered one after another, and thunderous applause erupted.
Jesse’s expression remained calm, as if he had merely brushed a speck of dust from his shoulder.
He raised his hand.
"I wish for this world to fall with snow."
The scorching weather abruptly turned cool.

No one knew where the snowflakes came from. Heavy snow like goose feathers drifted down in flurries, landing upon the blooming flowers. Red and white reflected each other, beautiful enough to steal one’s breath.
The entire gathering burst into an uproar.
Jesse remained indifferent, as if all of this were merely a game born from a single thought.
He spoke for the third time, his voice descending like a divine oracle.
"I wish for this world to rise with a gentle wind."
The moment his words fell, heaven and earth changed.
Strands of soft wind surged out from the void, brushing across mountains and rivers, sweeping through streets and alleys, and passing through every open window.
The entire world seemed to hold its breath in that instant, allowing the clear wind to wash over every corner.
Leaves rustled.
Ripples spread across lake surfaces.
The hem of a young girl’s skirt lifted slightly.
An old man’s white hair drifted gently.
The Divine-grade powerhouses present were horrified to discover that this wind had not formed naturally.
It had been driven by an irresistible mighty force.
They could sense every trace and vein of the wind, yet they could not stop it from freely passing through their domains.
The Angel King also froze.
He could feel the coolness of the clear wind brushing across his cheeks, yet he was unable to disperse it. He could only allow it to coil around his body.

From the corner of his eye, he swept his gaze over the remaining portion of the guests. Among them, some were also Oracle-grade. Their expressions were calm, as if everything happening was merely a speck of dust brushing past their ears.
A faint smile appeared on Jesse’s lips.
This was Oracle-grade!
The feeling of becoming a true powerhouse was wonderful.
He suddenly waved his hand.
The wind stopped.
Everything returned to normal, as if that clear wind that had swept across the entire world moments ago had been nothing more than an afternoon dream.
The Angel King sat at the very last seat, gazing at that figure surrounded by countless stars, and his eyes burned so fiercely it was as if fire might burst from them.
His thirst for Strength had never been so intense!
If he could also become Oracle-grade...
At that time, he could follow the threads of fate, find that human named Faustus, and erase him from the world with ease.
But becoming Oracle-grade...
Clearly, it was not that simple!

chapters.title: Chapter 194 -194-Killing Intent from the River of Fate
paragraphs: Angel King’s expression was complicated as his gaze fell upon a figure seated in the very front row.
That figure’s aura was as deep and unfathomable as an abyss.
He recognized that being. It was an Oracle-grade existence even older and stronger than Jesse—Justin!
If he could convince him to make a move...
Then dealing with a lowly human would be effortless!
After the celebration ended, Angel King immediately went to find Justin.
Justin was seated on a chair, idly playing with a star core in his hand. He did not even raise his eyelids.
"The World of Life is protected by the Origin Laws."
Justin’s voice was utterly indifferent.
"You want me to help you erase that man called Faustus? I cannot guarantee success. And I will also suffer the backlash of the laws."
His meaning was perfectly clear.
He wanted compensation!
Oracle-grade beings had their own circles.
To them, anyone below Oracle-grade was nothing more than an ant.
Although Angel King was immensely wealthy, if not for that mountain-like fortune, Justin would not even bother to give him a proper glance.
Angel King knew very well that with his strength and status, he had no right to speak of friendship with Justin.
If he wanted an existence of this level to act, he had to be prepared to pay a painful price.

Originally, he had planned to create an avatar himself and seek revenge, but that would be far too slow and far too impractical. After all, his previous avatar had already been a peak supreme-grade existence, yet had it not still been blasted to death?
Inviting this being to act was the fastest and most reliable method.
No matter the price, he was willing to pay it!

One had to know that in the boundless starry sky, only those transcendent Oracle-grade existences could pierce through the threads of fate, following those invisible and intangible strands to find a living being they had never met, or even never heard of.
With a single thought, they could reduce that being to nothingness.
And that was merely the surface of an Oracle-grade’s power.
A truly supreme Oracle-grade existence could not have their name spoken, their portrait viewed, or their old belongings touched.
That was the true terror of Oracle-grade.
To them, erasing a single existence was as effortless as brushing away dust.

As for those Oracle-grade beings who stood at the very peak of supreme-grade, they could not only completely erase a lifeform from the current space-time, but also uproot that being from any time and space in which they had ever appeared, removing them from the long river of history as though they had never existed at all.
Angel King gritted his teeth.
"Lord Justin, would one million trillion Light Crystals be enough?"
Justin glanced at him, his tone casual.
"What do you think?"
Angel King took a deep breath, feeling as though his heart was bleeding.
"What about five million trillion?"
At last, a faint smile appeared on Justin’s face.
"That is enough for me to give it a try."
Angel King immediately took out a card forged from star crystal and offered it with both hands.
"My lord, this contains five million trillion Light Crystals."
What the angel race lacked the least was Light Crystals. But even so, this was wealth accumulated over countless ages.
Five million trillion was enough to make his heart ache for a thousand years!
Justin accepted the card and gave a slight nod.
The next instant, piercing white light shone from his eyes.
"I have found him—Faustus, is it?"
The white light was like a blade, slicing open the River of Fate.
Justin extended his hand and clenched his five fingers in the air, intending to follow that unseen thread and erase the living being in that distant small world.
But in the next moment—
Pfft!
Justin spat out a mouthful of blood. Golden liquid gushed from his eye sockets, flowing down like two streams of molten gold.
He let out a miserable scream.
"Angel King! Just what kind of existence have you provoked?!"
Angel King’s mind buzzed, instantly going blank.
Justin clutched his eyes, his voice filled with shock and fury.

"That Faustus is protected by endless Fortune Points, and on top of that, he also has the protection of the World of Life’s laws. Instead, I was hit by the dual backlash of both Fortune Points and the laws!"
How was that possible?!
Angel King was completely dumbfounded.
Faustus...
Was actually this terrifying?
Protected by endless Fortune Points?
Even an Oracle-grade existence could not kill him?
He knew that his five million trillion Light Crystals had been completely wasted.
Faustus was far more difficult to deal with than he had imagined.
Unless he could find an Oracle-grade existence even stronger than Justin.
But how could someone at that level be within his reach?
Angel King looked out at the endless river of stars, the worry on his face deeper than the night itself.
[Ding! Your class change quest has been completed!]
[Ding! You have obtained epic-grade forbidden spell [Puppet of the Wind] ×1! You have obtained [forbidden-grade archer Class Awakening Scroll] ×1!]
Listening to the system notifications echoing beside his ears, Daniel’s lips curled into a smile.
The ultimate reward for the class change quest was not only a Class Awakening Scroll, but also an epic-grade forbidden spell.
A wind-type puppet forbidden spell.
It could kill enemies without a trace.
But just as he was immersed in the joy of his gains, an inexplicable sense of dread surged into his heart like a tide.
It was as though an invisible pair of giant hands had seized his heart tightly.
It was also as though countless eyes were watching his every move from some unknowable void.
This feeling...
Was not pleasant at all!
However, that sense of dread came abruptly and vanished just as strangely. In an instant, it disappeared without a trace.
Cold sweat seeped from Daniel’s forehead.
He had clearly sensed some indescribable form of surveillance, yet he had no idea what it was.
This caused a lingering vigilance to rise in the depths of his heart. At the same time, it jolted him fully awake.
He was still far too weak!
The existences above the starry sky, the omnipresent dark god...
These were all things far beyond what he could currently touch. He did not even have the qualifications to look up at them!
Daniel took out the Class Awakening Scroll and used it immediately.
The next moment, fragments of golden light sank into his body like drifting fireflies.
[Ding! Congratulations, your class change has succeeded!]
[Prompt: Your level cap has been unlocked. You may continue leveling up!]
A vast amount of experience was still stored in his Exp pool, and he chose to level up without the slightest hesitation.
[Ding! Your level has increased! Current level: 191. You have obtained 20 attribute points.]
[Ding! Your level has increased! Current level: 195. You have obtained 20 attribute points.]
[Ding! Your level has increased! Current level: 200. You have obtained 20 attribute points.]

[Prompt: You have not yet completed the next stage class change quest. Your level cap has been sealed once again. Excess experience has been temporarily stored in the Exp pool. Please complete your class change as soon as possible to unlock the cap.]
Level 200!
As long as he underwent rebirth and fused with a Divinity, he could become a legendary-grade existence recognized by the system and claim the generous reward for being the first to become a god.
At that moment, the system notification sounded once again.
[Ding! You have obtained the forbidden-grade archer class change quest. Do you wish to accept it?]
"Accept!"
[Ding! You have accepted the forbidden-grade archer class change quest [legendary-grade]! Your quest log has been updated. Please check the details.]
Daniel opened the quest log.
[legendary-grade]
[forbidden-grade archer class change quest]
Restriction: Archer
Quest Difficulty: Exalted-grade
Quest Objective: Become a legendary-grade expert.
Quest Description: To become legendary-grade, one must undergo rebirth at the [Temple] and fuse with a Divinity before officially stepping into legendary-grade.
Quest Hint: The Temple is located in Aetheria at coordinates (6799, 9496).
Quest Duration: Long-term
Quest Reward: [Fountain of Rebirth Construction Blueprint] ×1, [forbidden-grade archer Class Awakening Scroll] ×1
After Daniel finished reading, a sharp gleam flashed in his eyes.
The other conditions for this quest were not difficult. The truly difficult part lay in obtaining a Divinity.
One had to gather 100 Divinity Fragments in order to synthesize a complete Divinity.
Divinities were divided into three grades: Lesser, Middle, and Greater. Greater Divinity was the best, while Lesser Divinity was the lowest.
If he wanted to obtain the highest potential, then he naturally had to choose Greater Divinity.
However, Daniel also noticed something.
This quest was extraordinary!
The reward was incomparably precious—a Fountain of Rebirth blueprint!

With this item in his hands, he would be able to mass-produce legendary-grade experts. Whether they were NPCs under his command or players who yearned to reach the peak, as long as they had touched that threshold, they would be unable to bypass this thing.
This was absolutely a heaven-defying treasure!
And yet...
Was this quest not a little too simple?!
The corners of his lips lifted slightly.
A complete Greater Divinity had already been prepared in his backpack.
In other words, he only needed to go to the Temple, undergo rebirth, and fuse with the Divinity, and this quest would be completed.
However, he vaguely felt that there was a trap hidden behind all of this.
An ominous premonition lingered in his heart.

sentences.text: Angel King’s expression was complicated as his gaze fell upon a figure seated in the very front row.
That figure’s aura was as deep and unfathomable as an abyss.
He recognized that being.
It was an Oracle-grade existence even older and stronger than Jesse—Justin!
If he could convince him to make a move...
Then dealing with a lowly human would be effortless!
After the celebration ended, Angel King immediately went to find Justin.
Justin was seated on a chair, idly playing with a star core in his hand.
He did not even raise his eyelids.
"The World of Life is protected by the Origin Laws."
Justin’s voice was utterly indifferent.
"You want me to help you erase that man called Faustus?
I cannot guarantee success.
And I will also suffer the backlash of the laws."
His meaning was perfectly clear.
He wanted compensation!
Oracle-grade beings had their own circles.
To them, anyone below Oracle-grade was nothing more than an ant.
Although Angel King was immensely wealthy, if not for that mountain-like fortune, Justin would not even bother to give him a proper glance.
Angel King knew very well that with his strength and status, he had no right to speak of friendship with Justin.
If he wanted an existence of this level to act, he had to be prepared to pay a painful price.
Originally, he had planned to create an avatar himself and seek revenge, but that would be far too slow and far too impractical.
After all, his previous avatar had already been a peak supreme-grade existence, yet had it not still been blasted to death?
Inviting this being to act was the fastest and most reliable method.
No matter the price, he was willing to pay it!

One had to know that in the boundless starry sky, only those transcendent Oracle-grade existences could pierce through the threads of fate, following those invisible and intangible strands to find a living being they had never met, or even never heard of.
With a single thought, they could reduce that being to nothingness.
And that was merely the surface of an Oracle-grade’s power.
A truly supreme Oracle-grade existence could not have their name spoken, their portrait viewed, or their old belongings touched.
That was the true terror of Oracle-grade.
To them, erasing a single existence was as effortless as brushing away dust.

As for those Oracle-grade beings who stood at the very peak of supreme-grade, they could not only completely erase a lifeform from the current space-time, but also uproot that being from any time and space in which they had ever appeared, removing them from the long river of history as though they had never existed at all.
Angel King gritted his teeth.
"Lord Justin, would one million trillion Light Crystals be enough?"
Justin glanced at him, his tone casual.
"What do you think?"
Angel King took a deep breath, feeling as though his heart was bleeding.
"What about five million trillion?"
At last, a faint smile appeared on Justin’s face.
"That is enough for me to give it a try."
Angel King immediately took out a card forged from star crystal and offered it with both hands.
"My lord, this contains five million trillion Light Crystals."
What the angel race lacked the least was Light Crystals.
But even so, this was wealth accumulated over countless ages.
Five million trillion was enough to make his heart ache for a thousand years!
Justin accepted the card and gave a slight nod.
The next instant, piercing white light shone from his eyes.
"I have found him—Faustus, is it?"
The white light was like a blade, slicing open the River of Fate.
Justin extended his hand and clenched his five fingers in the air, intending to follow that unseen thread and erase the living being in that distant small world.
But in the next moment—
Pfft!
Justin spat out a mouthful of blood.
Golden liquid gushed from his eye sockets, flowing down like two streams of molten gold.
He let out a miserable scream.
"Angel King!
Just what kind of existence have you provoked?!"
Angel King’s mind buzzed, instantly going blank.
Justin clutched his eyes, his voice filled with shock and fury.
"That Faustus is protected by endless Fortune Points, and on top of that, he also has the protection of the World of Life’s laws.
Instead, I was hit by the dual backlash of both Fortune Points and the laws!"
How was that possible?!
Angel King was completely dumbfounded.
Faustus...
Was actually this terrifying?
Protected by endless Fortune Points?
Even an Oracle-grade existence could not kill him?
He knew that his five million trillion Light Crystals had been completely wasted.
Faustus was far more difficult to deal with than he had imagined.
Unless he could find an Oracle-grade existence even stronger than Justin.
But how could someone at that level be within his reach?
Angel King looked out at the endless river of stars, the worry on his face deeper than the night itself.
[Ding!
Your class change quest has been completed!]
[Ding!
You have obtained epic-grade forbidden spell [Puppet of the Wind] ×1!
You have obtained [forbidden-grade archer Class Awakening Scroll] ×1!]
Listening to the system notifications echoing beside his ears, Daniel’s lips curled into a smile.
The ultimate reward for the class change quest was not only a Class Awakening Scroll, but also an epic-grade forbidden spell.
A wind-type puppet forbidden spell.
It could kill enemies without a trace.
But just as he was immersed in the joy of his gains, an inexplicable sense of dread surged into his heart like a tide.
It was as though an invisible pair of giant hands had seized his heart tightly.
It was also as though countless eyes were watching his every move from some unknowable void.
This feeling...
Was not pleasant at all!
However, that sense of dread came abruptly and vanished just as strangely.
In an instant, it disappeared without a trace.
Cold sweat seeped from Daniel’s forehead.
He had clearly sensed some indescribable form of surveillance, yet he had no idea what it was.
This caused a lingering vigilance to rise in the depths of his heart.
At the same time, it jolted him fully awake.
He was still far too weak!
The existences above the starry sky, the omnipresent dark god...
These were all things far beyond what he could currently touch.
He did not even have the qualifications to look up at them!
Daniel took out the Class Awakening Scroll and used it immediately.
The next moment, fragments of golden light sank into his body like drifting fireflies.
[Ding!
Congratulations, your class change has succeeded!]
[Prompt: Your level cap has been unlocked.
You may continue leveling up!]
A vast amount of experience was still stored in his Exp pool, and he chose to level up without the slightest hesitation.
[Ding!
Your level has increased!
Current level: 191.
You have obtained 20 attribute points.]
[Ding!
Your level has increased!
Current level: 195.
You have obtained 20 attribute points.]
[Ding!
Your level has increased!
Current level: 200.
You have obtained 20 attribute points.]
[Prompt: You have not yet completed the next stage class change quest.
Your level cap has been sealed once again.
Excess experience has been temporarily stored in the Exp pool.
Please complete your class change as soon as possible to unlock the cap.]
Level 200!
As long as he underwent rebirth and fused with a Divinity, he could become a legendary-grade existence recognized by the system and claim the generous reward for being the first to become a god.
At that moment, the system notification sounded once again.
[Ding!
You have obtained the forbidden-grade archer class change quest.
Do you wish to accept it?]
"Accept!"
[Ding!
You have accepted the forbidden-grade archer class change quest [legendary-grade]!
Your quest log has been updated.
Please check the details.]
Daniel opened the quest log.
[legendary-grade]
[forbidden-grade archer class change quest]
Restriction: Archer
Quest Difficulty: Exalted-grade
Quest Objective: Become a legendary-grade expert.
Quest Description: To become legendary-grade, one must undergo rebirth at the [Temple] and fuse with a Divinity before officially stepping into legendary-grade.
Quest Hint: The Temple is located in Aetheria at coordinates (6799, 9496).
Quest Duration: Long-term
Quest Reward: [Fountain of Rebirth Construction Blueprint] ×1, [forbidden-grade archer Class Awakening Scroll] ×1
After Daniel finished reading, a sharp gleam flashed in his eyes.
The other conditions for this quest were not difficult.
The truly difficult part lay in obtaining a Divinity.
One had to gather 100 Divinity Fragments in order to synthesize a complete Divinity.
Divinities were divided into three grades: Lesser, Middle, and Greater.
Greater Divinity was the best, while Lesser Divinity was the lowest.
If he wanted to obtain the highest potential, then he naturally had to choose Greater Divinity.
However, Daniel also noticed something.
This quest was extraordinary!
The reward was incomparably precious—a Fountain of Rebirth blueprint!
With this item in his hands, he would be able to mass-produce legendary-grade experts.
Whether they were NPCs under his command or players who yearned to reach the peak, as long as they had touched that threshold, they would be unable to bypass this thing.
This was absolutely a heaven-defying treasure!
And yet...
Was this quest not a little too simple?!
The corners of his lips lifted slightly.
A complete Greater Divinity had already been prepared in his backpack.
In other words, he only needed to go to the Temple, undergo rebirth, and fuse with the Divinity, and this quest would be completed.
However, he vaguely felt that there was a trap hidden behind all of this.
An ominous premonition lingered in his heart.

chapters.title: Chapter 195 -195-Divine Servant Contract, Swearing Allegiance!
paragraphs: Daniel shook his head and did not dwell on it.
He first took out the epic-grade forbidden spell and examined it carefully.
[Puppet of the Wind]
[epic-grade forbidden spell]
Restriction: forbidden-grade archer
Grade: epic-grade
Effect: Summons [Spirits of the Wind]. Their number depends on your MP value. They can possess targets and turn them into your puppets.
Cost: 10% MP
Duration: 60 minutes
Description: A wind-type epic-grade forbidden spell. Strange and unpredictable. Those under its control will be reduced to marionettes, their life and death no longer in their own hands.
Daniel nodded slightly.
This forbidden spell was extremely practical.
In terms of combat power, he no longer had any shortcomings.
What he urgently needed now was precisely this kind of negative-status-type skill.
[Ding! You have learned epic-grade forbidden spell [Puppet of the Wind]! Your skill panel has been updated.]
He did not linger any longer. His gaze turned toward the final step leading to the divine throne—
Rebirth and fusing with a Divinity!
The entrance ticket for his exclusive instance [Flame of Heritage] required him to be legendary-grade.
As long as he fused with a Divinity, that gate would open for him.
However, before that, he still had one more thing to do.
He opened the World War point interface and spent all the massive points he had accumulated, exchanging them for a large batch of skill books and equipment.
The equipment was used to feed Stellar Wrath, while the skill books were used to feed Conqueror’s Emblem.
Both of these were growth-type supreme treasures. They absolutely could not be wasted.
[Ding! You have successfully consumed items. Stellar Wrath’s current level: 50!]
[Ding! You have successfully consumed items. Stellar Wrath’s current level: 80!]
[Ding! You have successfully consumed items. Stellar Wrath’s current level: 100!]
Level 100 Stellar Wrath!
After fusing with his weapon, its effects had already merged into his body.
At this moment, the power of all his skills surged once again.
Next was Conqueror’s Emblem.
[Ding! You have successfully consumed items. Conqueror’s Emblem’s current level: 21!]
[Ding! You have successfully consumed items. Conqueror’s Emblem’s current level: 25!]
[Ding! You have successfully consumed items. Conqueror’s Emblem’s current level: 30!]
After leveling up, Conqueror’s Emblem pushed his base damage to 3 billion points!
And this was only the base value.
If it was combined with a forbidden spell that dealt continuous damage, that number would soar to a suffocating level.
Not to mention, he also possessed [Crusader’s Physique]. With his skills dismantled and reconstructed, who could possibly withstand him?
"Improving my strength is way too unchallenging."
Daniel did not lose himself in the pleasure brought by Strength.
He understood better than anyone that Aetheria was merely a World Fragment, as tiny as a speck of dust in the vast greater world.
And the greater world itself, when compared to the Endless Starfield, was nothing more than a drop in the ocean.
His current achievements were certainly gratifying, but they were still far from being something he could be proud of.
A frog at the bottom of a well would only become a laughingstock in the end.
"It’s time to undergo rebirth and fuse with a Divinity."
He took a deep breath, opened the map, entered the coordinates, and locked onto the Temple’s location.
But for some reason, he kept feeling that this class change quest would not be that simple.
Perhaps it was precisely because it seemed too simple that he felt unaccustomed to it?
He shook his head and flew toward the Temple.
When he arrived at the destination, he indeed saw a majestic Temple standing at the edge of the continent!
Above the sky, a thick golden pillar of light enveloped the entire Temple. Golden radiance shimmered around it, making it seem sacred and inviolable.
[Prompt: You have discovered [World’s End]. Contribution Points +1,000,000!]
He took a deep breath, then flew straight toward the Temple.
The Temple’s guards were not real living beings. Instead, they were two stone statues standing on either side of the main gate.
They seemed to serve only as a symbol and deterrent.
Daniel swept his eyes over them and strode into the Temple.
The moment he stepped inside, a gentle voice rang beside his ears.
"Lost traveler, the guidance of god lies before you—"
Before the voice could finish speaking, the space in front of him suddenly twisted.
A kindly-looking old man slowly stepped out from the distorted void.
His gaze landed on Daniel like a flash of lightning, and a sharp gleam flickered through his eyes.
Daniel casually threw out a Scout.
[Temple Priest]
[supreme-grade]
[Godkin]
"A priest?"
Daniel remained calm and composed.
"I am here for my class rebirth."
His tone was indifferent.
In his previous lives, he had never come to any Temple.
Back then, the game and reality had long since merged. Rebirth was nothing more than a simple process.
As long as a player obtained Divinity Fragments, they could smoothly complete rebirth and become legendary-grade.
This was his first time entering a Temple for rebirth.
When the priest heard his words, he nodded with a smile.
"God is pleased to see His followers grow stronger."
Then his tone shifted.
"However, before that, you must express your faith to god. God shall also bestow upon you His supreme blessing."
"Oh?"
Daniel raised an eyebrow.
"What do I need to do?"
The priest smiled and said,
"Become god’s most loyal servant."
"No matter what circumstances you face, swear eternal loyalty to god!"
His voice was filled with temptation.
"After you make your oath, god shall grant you unmatched Strength!"
Daniel’s eyelid twitched violently.
At the same time, a cold system notification rang out.
[Ding! Do you wish to sign a [Divine Servant Contract] with god?]
[Prompt: Signing the contract will grant you [God-Bestowed Blessing]!]
Kneel and sign a Divine Servant Contract?
God-Bestowed Blessing?
Heh!
Daniel sneered.
He immediately rejected the system’s proposal.
They wanted him to kneel?
What kind of dream were they having?!
Right now, he carried the human race’s supreme Fortune Points. He was the uncrowned king of this world!
If he knelt, it would be equivalent to the entire human race and the entire world lowering their heads to god.
If he signed the Divine Servant Contract, it would mean that millions upon millions of players would become slaves of the Godkin from this day forth!
Forget god. Even if a supreme-grade existence that controlled space-time and fate wanted him to kneel and submit—
It would be absolutely impossible!
The human race would never be enslaved!
"I refuse!"
[Ding! You have refused to sign the [Divine Servant Contract] with the Godkin!]
Daniel looked at the priest and asked indifferently,
"And what if I don’t?"
The priest was filled with shock when he heard this. He blurted out,
"If you do not become a servant of the Godkin, you cannot undergo rebirth and become a god!"
Hm?!
Killing intent gathered around Daniel like a surging tide.
The priest’s expression turned solemn as he said in a deep voice,
"O soul lost upon the wrong path, I have already seen you being corroded by the darkness of the abyss. God shall eternally close the gates of His kingdom and reject you from entering."
A chilling sneer appeared at the corner of Daniel’s mouth, and blazing battle intent ignited in his eyes.
"Reject me? Then the price—may be more than you can afford."
Boom!
A world-destroying killing intent erupted from his body and swept through the entire Temple.
The candle flames inside the hall flickered on the verge of extinction. The air itself seemed to solidify into an invisible anvil, pressing down on every corner.
"What is true light?!"
Aetherlance!
Bzzzzzz!
The entire Temple was drowned in blinding white light, as though a blazing sun had fallen into the mortal world.
Daniel’s body radiated a transparent and holy glow, so dazzling that no one could look directly at him.
Above the priest’s head, blood-red damage numbers began to jump wildly.
-3 billion!
-3 billion!
-3 billion!

chapters.title: Chapter 196 -196-Fight to the Death with the Godkin
paragraphs: "Divine Domain!"
The priest’s expression changed drastically. Without hesitation, he unleashed the Divine Domain of a supreme-grade expert.
A rift suddenly tore open in the void, and an Eight-Winged Angel wielding a spear appeared out of thin air, shielding the priest and blocking all of the fatal damage.
An Eight-Winged Angel was already considered a high-grade angel.
Unlike the angel race of the Angel Plane, this type of angel was symbiotic with the Godkin.
Or rather, they were angels who had attached themselves to the Godkin.
Although they shared the same origin as the angels of the Angel Plane, they had chosen to submit to the Godkin!
"Eight-Winged Angel?"
Daniel blinked.
As expected of a supreme-grade expert of the Godkin.
This was his first time fighting a supreme-grade expert alone, and his opponent was even a Godkin.
Yet his expression remained calm, even carrying a nearly arrogant confidence.
That confidence came from his absolute strength, enough to crush everything.
Epic-grade forbidden spell—Veil of Eternal Night!
"Sleep..."
The Godkin priest and the Eight-Winged Angel instantly fell into a deep slumber, like puppets whose souls had been drawn out.
At the same time, a cluster of blue fire appeared in Daniel’s left hand.
The aura of the flame surged at an astonishing speed. As the fire flickered, even space itself was scorched until it warped and twisted.
Annihilation Flame!
Burn all things to ashes!
This flame contained the destructive power of millions of stacked skills. Its might was simply unimaginable.
He then invested another 1,000 points of Immortal Singularity, injecting an even greater boost into it.
Hiss, hiss, hiss!
The space around the flame began to collapse, twisting into a pitch-black vortex.
What he held in his hand no longer seemed to be a flame, but a compressed black hole.
Devouring everything.
Destroying everything.
"Even if you are gods, you still have to die!"
He spread his five fingers, and that world-ending flame fell upon the sleeping priest and angel like a meteor.
Boom!
The figures of the priest and the Eight-Winged Angel instantly evaporated.
Instant kill!
A supreme-grade expert of the Godkin had failed to last even a single breath in his hands.
[Ding! You have killed [Temple Priest]!]
[Prompt: Your relationship with the Godkin has reached [Blood Feud]!]
[Ding! You have obtained [Primordial Core] ×1!]
System notifications exploded one after another. Daniel automatically filtered out the gold coins and equipment, focusing only on the core item—
Primordial Core!
The Godkin were also a primordial race, so naturally they dropped this item as well. It was exactly the key resource he urgently needed right now.
[Ding! You have sold [Primordial Core] ×1 to Doom Guild for 1 copper coin, triggering Millionfold Boost!]
[The sold item is a special material. Please choose quality boost / quantity boost!]
"Quantity boost!"
[Ding! Congratulations, you have obtained 1 gold coin! You have obtained [Primordial Core] ×1,000,000!]
Looking at the one million Primordial Cores that had appeared out of thin air in his backpack, Daniel felt a burst of joy.
As for his relationship with the Godkin worsening?
Heh!
He sneered.
So what if it was a Blood Feud?
Even if it became irreconcilable hatred, why would he fear them?!
Boom! Boom!
At that moment, two golden pillars of light descended from the sky, landing precisely on the two stone statue guards at the entrance of the Temple.
The next moment, the stone statues transformed into flesh-and-blood bodies.
Their auras surged wildly, charging straight to mid supreme-grade!
"Human heretic, how dare you blaspheme against god!"
Daniel felt two vast waves of pressure descend out of nowhere.
In his vision, two supreme-grade Godkin experts stood side by side, their killing intent surging.
"Accept god’s baptism!"
"Divine Domain!"
The instant the two supreme-grade Godkin saw Daniel, they moved to kill him without hesitation, unleashing their Divine Domains at the same time.
Strangely enough, their Divine Domains could actually merge into one, transforming into an ancient scroll.
Endless Strength surged out from the painting and poured into their bodies. Their auras even showed faint signs of breaking through beyond mid supreme-grade.
Daniel was completely fearless, his battle intent soaring to the heavens.
His strength had just increased dramatically. He now possessed four epic-grade forbidden spells, and he also had the heaven-defying [Crusader’s Physique] supporting him.
Right now, there was only one belief in his heart—
He would tear a hole through this so-called God Realm!
The blood throughout his body seemed to burn like surging magma.
"Flash!"
His figure suddenly vanished.
When he reappeared, he was already right in front of the two God Realm guards.
He had countless skill combinations he could use, yet he deliberately chose the most direct and brutal method—
A head-on clash!
One man fighting two gods!
A human legendary-grade expert challenging two supreme-grade Godkin alone!
"Die!"
His fist was instantly wrapped in a layer of violent lightning.
That punch tore through the void like a meteor crashing into the earth, smashing out shattered spatial cracks.
Boom!
One punch landed squarely on a Godkin guard.
Explosion!
Rumble!
That Godkin guard was actually smashed apart by brute force, flesh and blood flying everywhere!
[Ding! You have killed [Godkin Guard]!]
[Prompt: Your relationship with the Godkin has reached [Irreconcilable Hatred]!]
[Ding! You have obtained [Primordial Core]...]
Daniel’s figure paused as he coldly watched the attack of the remaining Godkin guard.
A spear condensed with world-destroying Strength stabbed straight toward him. The spear tip was already only inches away.
At that exact instant, a wall of ice appeared out of thin air.
Crash!
The spear pierced through the ice wall.
But immediately after, countless layers of ice walls emerged one after another, stacking endlessly.
The distance was only a few centimeters, yet it had become an uncrossable heavenly chasm.
The Godkin guard’s expression shifted from rage to wild joy, then from hesitation to confusion—
And finally, only despair remained.
Too strong!
The human before him was simply an immovable divine mountain.
The Strength he was so proud of was as humble as dust before Daniel.
Daniel stared indifferently at the last enemy and suddenly shouted,
"Wind!"
The Godkin guard felt his body freeze. An invisible Strength bound him tightly in place, leaving him unable to move at all.
This was what made Daniel so terrifying.
With negative-status skills in his hands, he could easily control every rhythm of the battlefield.
His methods were ever-changing. His skill combinations were endless, and he could stack thousands upon thousands of attacks in the same instant.
At that moment, he dispersed the layers of ice walls before him. As his right hand clenched into a fist, a long sword burning with dark-blue flames had already taken shape in his palm.
Annihilation Flame!
The flames carried a deep, blue glow. Any living being that touched them would be instantly devoured by darkness!
The long sword slowly and firmly pierced into the Godkin guard’s chest.
The Godkin guard’s expression was filled with incomparable fury.
"Heretic, your actions will anger god! The human race of this world will face overwhelming divine wrath!"
"This price is not something you can afford!"
"Price?"
Daniel’s expression was full of contempt.
"Before long," Daniel said, his voice cold as frost, "I will trample the God Realm beneath my feet and crush the pride of the Godkin."
"Enslaving the human race is your greatest sin."
Pfft!
The long sword pierced through him. Blue flames erupted, burning the Godkin guard into ashes.
[Ding! You have killed [Godkin Guard]!]
[Prompt: Your relationship with the Godkin has reached [Fight to the Death]!]
[Ding! You have obtained [Primordial Core] ×1!]

An Eight-Winged Angel was already considered a high-grade angel.
Unlike the angel race of the Angel Plane, this type of angel was symbiotic with the Godkin.
Or rather, they were angels who had attached themselves to the Godkin.
Although they shared the same origin as the angels of the Angel Plane, they had chosen to submit to the Godkin!
"Eight-Winged Angel?"

As expected of a supreme-grade expert of the Godkin.
