chapters.title: Chapter 197 -197-Achieving Legendary-grade, a Milestone!
paragraphs: The world announcement exploded like thunder.
[World Announcement: The heretic "Faustus" has slain the Temple Priest and Godkin Guards at World’s End. His crimes are monstrous, and his hatred with the Godkin has reached [Fight to the Death]!]
[The Godkin are enraged! From this day forth, they command all believers of god across Aetheria to jointly execute the heretic, cleanse the filth, and return holy light to the world!]
The message swept across the sky like heavenly thunder, shocking every living being on the entire continent.
Faustus had actually dared to oppose the Godkin head-on. He had even personally slain the Godkin’s mortal representative—
The Temple Priest!
This was no different from punching a hole through the heavens!
However, the group of players known as the "Fourth Calamity" were not afraid at all. Instead, every single one of them felt their blood boil, their battle intent surging.
"By the gods! Guild Master is going to slaughter gods to prove his Dao!"
"What gods? As long as it has an HP bar, even a giant dragon has to coil up before us!"
"Well said! So what if it’s the God Realm? It’s just a new map we haven’t explored yet."
"Those lofty gods are nothing more than prey with richer EXP in our eyes."
"What’s there to be afraid of? We players were born to break shackles and trample divine thrones! Boss Faustus has already opened the path. We can’t fall behind either!"
"Great God Faustus is mighty! From now on, you are the war god in our hearts, the one and only true god!"
These players had never possessed any reverence toward gods.
To them, the God Realm was merely a higher-level battlefield, and gods were nothing more than stronger gatekeepers.
Killing gods?
Was that not part of the game?
After listening to the world announcement, Daniel’s expression remained unchanged.
Calling upon believers to kill him?
The corner of his mouth curled into a cold sneer, full of disdain.

He actually hoped the Godkin would personally make a move. It would be best if they sent over a million supreme-grade experts, allowing him to gather ten billion Primordial Cores and deduce a forbidden skill!
"Looks like I still haven’t pulled enough aggro."
A dangerous light flickered in his eyes.
The God Realm would not come?
Then he would fight his way up there!
He would take the initiative and go looking for trouble!
The God Realm actually dared to lock everyone by the throat, refusing to let them undergo rebirth unless they knelt and signed a servant contract.
If that was not courting death, then what was?
He took a deep breath, suppressed the surging killing intent within him, and turned toward the depths of the Temple.
The Temple Priest was dead, but the Fountain of Rebirth was not going anywhere.
The reason this Temple existed was precisely because of that fountain.
He soon found the Fountain of Rebirth.
The spring water was shrouded by a layer of restriction, one difficult to break through using ordinary means.
But that was only for ordinary people.
"Break!"
Rumble!
The restriction shattered at once, like a lock smashed open by brute force.
[Ding! You have shattered the restriction on the Fountain of Rebirth.]
[Prompt: The Fountain of Rebirth’s restriction has been damaged. The self-destruction program will activate in five minutes.]
Daniel did not care in the slightest. He calmly stepped into the spring water.
As expected, the Godkin had kept a backup plan. The Fountain of Rebirth actually had a hidden self-destruction mechanism.
No wonder he had always felt there was a trap hidden within this quest.
The system had predicted his prediction.
Or rather, it had given him a hidden choice!
If he chose to submit to the God Realm, then he would not need the Fountain of Rebirth blueprint.
That blueprint could be used to nurture his own Strength.
But if he chose to reject the God Realm, then this Fountain of Rebirth would become the players’ only path to godhood.
And now, he already held the key to that path.
Because the price of rejecting the God Realm was that the Fountain of Rebirth here would definitely be destroyed.
From this day forth, every player who wanted to become a god would first need his approval.
As Daniel thought of this, the system notification arrived right on time.
[Ding! Congratulations, your rebirth has succeeded!]
[Prompt: You may now fuse with a Divinity. After fusing, you may become a legendary-grade expert!]
He stepped out of the spring water and took out the Greater Divinity he had prepared long ago from his backpack, his gaze burning.
The next step was to achieve legendary-grade!
Daniel held the Greater Divinity in his palm. Pale golden light flowed between his fingers, as though a river of stars was slowly rotating within it.
This was the highest-level foundation of godhood in the myriad worlds beneath the starry sky, a supreme treasure countless experts could never reach even after exhausting their entire lives.
[Ding! Confirm fusion with [Greater Divinity]? Once confirmed, the Divinity will become one with you and can never be separated again.]
Daniel’s expression was calm, without the slightest hesitation.
"Confirm."
[Ding! Fusion with [Greater Divinity] successful!]
Boom!
The clear sky suddenly erupted with a clap of thunder, as though the heavens themselves were trembling for this moment.
A vast, abyss-like legendary-grade aura surged out from Daniel’s body, like an ancient dragon that had been dormant for countless ages finally opening its eyes.
His robes moved without wind, and his hair fluttered like strands of gold. Rings of pale golden ripples spread from his body in all directions.
Legendary-grade!
Daniel had officially ascended!

[World Announcement: Player "Faustus" has successfully fused with a Greater Divinity and become the first player to achieve legendary-grade! Special reward: Contribution Points +1,000,000, gold coins +2,000,000!]
[Special reward: [Special Random Item Chest] ×1!]
The announcement rang out three times in a row, smashing the entire world into silence. Then, an earth-shaking uproar erupted.
"Legendary-grade! Holy shit!"
The first player to become a god!
Faustus!
This was an epoch-making milestone.
The players, a group once regarded as ants by the gods, finally had someone climb to the peak of legendary-grade.
"I hereby declare Faustus the War God!"
"We have to work harder too. We can’t let the big boss leave us too far behind, or we won’t even be qualified to enter instances with him in the future!"
"No way. He became a god just like that? Are we even playing the same game?"
"Exactly. I still can’t even beat an epic-grade BOSS, and the great god over there has already achieved legendary-grade and is slaughtering supreme-grade enemies!"
"As expected, comparing yourself to others really can make you furious..."
[Ding! You have obtained [Special Random Item Chest (Rare · Unique)] ×1!]
Daniel took out the chest. Ancient patterns were engraved across its surface, and it emitted a fluctuation that made one’s heart tremble.
[Special Random Item Chest (Rare · Unique)]
Level: ???
Grade: ???
Effect: After opening, randomly obtain one rare item.
Description: Badge, title, talent, potion, skill book... The wheel of fate turns. What you will obtain is completely unknown!
He opened it directly.
[Ding! You have opened [Special Random Item Chest (Rare · Unique)]!]
[Ding! You have obtained rare item [Badge of the Unyielding (Unique)]!]
A dark-golden badge fell into his palm. Engraved upon the badge was a longsword piercing through a divine crown, as though silently declaring something.
[Badge of the Unyielding (Unique)]
[Rare]
Effect: After wearing this badge, whenever you kill an expert above legendary-grade, you may obtain [Divine Stone], [Divine Soul], and [Divine Essence].
[Divine Stone]: A special material that can be used to construct, fill, and charge the Fountain of Rebirth.
[Divine Soul]: A special material that can be used to fill the Fountain of Rebirth.
[Divine Essence]: A special material that can be used to fill the Fountain of Rebirth.
Description: If the gods demand that I bow and scrape, then let them witness an unyielding spine! With the blood, souls, bones, and flesh of the gods, I shall forge my undefeated legendary-grade!
Daniel took a deep breath.
This item was actually a supreme treasure paired with the Fountain of Rebirth.
With it, the materials needed to fill the Fountain of Rebirth would be within easy reach.
Whatever he lacked, he only needed to hunt down the Godkin to obtain.
It was simply perfect!
The Godkin saw the human race as servants.
Likewise, he saw the Godkin as resources to be used and taken at will!

chapters.title: Chapter 198 -198-The Truth Behind the Disappearance of the Human Monarch
paragraphs: "If the Godkin regard the human race as slaves beneath their feet, then I shall regard them as livestock waiting to be slaughtered!"
When Daniel spoke those words in a low voice, his tone was utterly calm.
Yet the flames burning in his eyes were enough to incinerate every hypocritical divine radiance in the world!
The moment his fingertip touched the badge, a dark-golden glow surged like a tide, washing across his chest.
[Ding! You have equipped the [Badge of the Unyielding]!]
Badges, titles, buff statuses... special equipment and enhancements like these did not occupy equipment slots. They could all be stacked without limit.
The instant he fastened the badge, the system prompt arrived as expected.
[Ding! Your class change quest has been completed!]
[Ding! Congratulations, your class change was successful!]
[Notice: You have obtained [Forbidden-grade Archer Class Awakening Scroll] ×1 and [Sacred Spring of Rebirth] ×1!]
Sacred Spring of Rebirth!
Daniel’s eyes flashed. In his hand, a miniature spring model had already appeared.
The entire model had been carved from an unknown, luminous white stone. Though the pool within was completely empty, faint wisps of mist seemed to coil above it.
[Sacred Spring of Rebirth (Rare)] (Unique)
Level: ???
Grade: ???
Effect: After use, you may construct the [Sacred Spring of Rebirth].
Sacred Spring of Rebirth: Used for a player’s rebirth ritual. It is the site where divinity is fused.

Description: The Sacred Spring of Rebirth, also known as the [Divine Spring]. Legend has it that in ancient times, the sages of the human race once used this pool as a foundation to help countless humans step through the gates of Legendary-grade. It is a Supreme-grade creation capable of defying the heavens and changing fate.
Daniel’s gaze lingered on that line of description for a brief moment. Then, with a turn of his hand, he stored the model in his backpack.
This item—he intended to use it in the Aerial Realm.
That place was the true territory that belonged to the human race!
For now, his class change was imminent.
He took out the scroll radiating a faint golden light—the [Forbidden-grade Archer Class Awakening Scroll].
With a single thought, the scroll transformed into countless golden motes of light, all of which poured into his body.
[Notice: The seal on your experience bar has been lifted. You may continue leveling up.]
Daniel did not hesitate.
[Ding! Your level has increased! Current level: 201. You have obtained 20 attribute points.]
[Ding! Your level has increased! Current level: 210. You have obtained 20 attribute points.]
[Ding! Your level has increased! Current level: 220. You have obtained 20 attribute points.]
Golden light erupted from his body again and again.
The surrounding air seemed to retreat before the force of his rising Strength, forming an invisible vortex around him.

[Notice: You have not completed the next stage of your class change. Your level cap has been sealed once more. Excess experience has been temporarily stored in the Exp Pool. Please complete your class change as soon as possible to lift the cap.]
Daniel allocated all his attribute points into Agility, his expression as calm as still water.
Level 220!
He was no longer far from the level 400 threshold of Supreme-grade.
No—his strength had already reached the threshold.
All that remained was to push open that door!
[Ding! You have obtained the Forbidden-grade Archer class change quest. Do you wish to accept?]
"Accept."
His voice was calm, but a trace of anticipation stirred deep in his eyes.
[Ding! You have accepted the Forbidden-grade Archer class change quest: [Mystery of Queen Kelly’s Disappearance (I)]!]
[Notice: Your quest log has been updated. Please open it to view the details.]
Mystery of Queen Kelly’s Disappearance?
Daniel froze slightly.
Kelly!
What had happened to her?
Almost subconsciously, he opened the quest log, his gaze sweeping over the lines of text.
[Mystery of Queen Kelly’s Disappearance]
(Forbidden-grade Archer class change quest)
Restriction: Forbidden-grade Archer
Quest Difficulty: Exalted-grade
Quest Objective:
Enter the [Flame of Heritage] instance and investigate [the truth behind Queen Kelly’s disappearance].
Quest Introduction:
[Queen Kelly], one of the three human emperors of the Chaotic Era.

She appeared out of nowhere one hundred thousand years ago, and in only ten thousand years, she occupied nearly half of Aetheria’s territory. That was an era that belonged to her, later known in history as the [Golden Age of Kelly].
However, one day, one hundred thousand years ago, [Queen Kelly] mysteriously vanished, as though she had been swallowed by time itself.
With her disappearance, the flourishing [Golden Age of Kelly] came to an end. The human race once again fell into the abyss of division and war.

As for the mystery surrounding [Queen Kelly]’s disappearance, it became an unsolved case that countless historians failed to unravel even after devoting their entire lives to it. It seemed that every elusive clue pointed toward the same source...
One hundred thousand years ago.
The turning point that changed everything!
Quest Duration: Long-term
Quest Rewards: [Queen Kelly’s Message] ×1, [Forbidden-grade Archer Class Awakening Scroll] ×1
Daniel closed the quest log.
Kelly!
He slowly raised his right hand and lowered his gaze to his wrist.
Wrapped there was a bracelet woven from seven-colored threads.
The seven colors were like a solidified rainbow, flowing with a warm luster beneath the light.

None of the knots had been tied with much elegance. In fact, they even carried a hint of rough childishness. Yet every knot was firm, as though the person who had woven it had also woven some kind of obsession into it.
He still remembered.
By the lake in Soul Devouring Vale, that smiling girl had suddenly stretched out her hand.
"Look!"
She opened her palm, and a rainbow reflected within it, illuminating those eyes of hers—clear almost to the point of transparency...
Daniel shook his head, forcing those surging memories back into the depths of his heart.
Kelly had disappeared!
And the clue lay within the [Flame of Heritage] instance.
What made him even more curious was that after completing the quest, he would receive a message from Kelly.
What kind of message would it be?
Daniel took a deep breath and suppressed every distracting thought.
Before heading to the instance, he planned to make a trip to the Aerial Realm first.
It was time to open that world!
Whoosh—!
His figure abruptly vanished from where he stood.
Aerial Realm.
Daniel hovered high in the sky, looking down upon this newborn world beneath his feet.
A sea of clouds surged below him. The wind swept past his ears, carrying with it the scent of grass, trees, and soil.
[Ding! Do you wish to use the [Seed of World Tree] on the [Aerial Realm]? Once used, this action cannot be canceled. Please choose carefully!]
Daniel understood better than anyone just how precious the [Seed of World Tree] was.
A supreme treasure capable of allowing an entire world to grow and strengthen—such a thing was among the most top-tier existences even in the Endless Starfield.

Among those ancient powers standing at the peak of the myriad races, which of them had not relied on a foundation of worlds like this to accumulate an indestructible heritage over hundreds of millions of years?
Once he decided to use it in the Aerial Realm, the future of this world would inevitably surpass Aetheria!
Daniel had nothing to hesitate about.
Although he was now the lord of Aetheria, with countless realms bowing before him, the highest authority over that land was ultimately not in his hands.
At the end of the day, that place was still the Godkin’s territory!
But the Aerial Realm was different.
Here, his authority belonged to the first sequence.
This was the true territory of the human race!

When Daniel spoke those words in a low voice, his tone was utterly calm.

Badges, titles, buff statuses... special equipment and enhancements like these did not occupy equipment slots.

chapters.title: Chapter 199 -199-Opening Access to a Brand-New World — Aerial Realm
paragraphs: "Confirm."
[Ding! You have used the [Seed of World Tree] on the [Aerial Realm]!]
The moment the seed sank into the earth—
Rumble!
The entire world began to tremble!
At that instant, it was as though the whole world was roaring in celebration of the birth of something new.
Countless living beings throughout the Aerial Realm raised their heads in confusion.
Savage beasts stopped running. Colossal creatures folded their wings. Even those Legendary-grade beings soaring above the ninth heaven ceased their hunts, letting out uneasy low growls.
They did not know what had happened.
But something deep within their bloodline was telling them—
Everything had changed!
That very day, the chieftain of the Blackstone Tribe led his people, carrying offerings on their backs, all the way to the Sanctum of the Wayfarer.
They knelt within the sacred temple and prayed devoutly to that great Wayfarer who had brought life and hope to the human race.
They prayed for the fate of humanity.
They prayed for the future of this world!
Daniel descended back to the ground.
The land beneath his feet was changing.

The originally hard earth became soft and warm. Withered yellow grass roots regained their green vitality. Flower buds that had yet to bloom all blossomed at the same time, bursting into brilliant colors like a painting personally touched by the hand of a god.
And at the very center of it all, a tiny sapling broke through the soil, revealing a tender green shoot.
It was only as tall as a finger. Two young leaves swayed gently in the wind, so fragile that it seemed a single gust could snap it in half.
Yet the aura emanating from it made even Daniel hold his breath.
It was the aura of life!
Pure, ancient, and boundless, as though it flowed from the very source of time itself.
[World Tree (Sapling State)] (Dormant State)
A faint smile appeared on Daniel’s lips.
He took out a bottle of faintly glowing spring water from his backpack—
[Water of Life].
The World Tree required the nourishment of three supreme treasures in order to keep growing.
[Water of Life], [Sacred Soil], and [Holy Spirit Servant].
Only one of the three was needed.
[Ding! Confirm use of [Water of Life]?]
[Please note! This item is extremely precious. Once used, the action cannot be reversed.]
"Confirm."
Daniel did not hesitate in the slightest.
No matter how precious an item was, its value could only be shown through use.
Using the Water of Life to water the World Tree was making full use of it.
[Notice: You have used [Water of Life].]
[Notice: The current [World Tree] can raise this world’s upper limit to [Small World]!]
Daniel’s eyes lit up at once.
A complete Small World!
Although it was only a Small World, it was still a complete world of its own, not some incomplete World Fragment.
This was the first complete exclusive world in the history of the human race of this land!
Its starting point might be low, but it carried infinite possibilities.
He lowered his head and looked at the World Tree before him.
[World Tree (Sapling State)] (Growing)
Current Upper Limit: [Young Tree State] (Small World)
The numbers were increasing so slowly that they seemed almost frozen.
Yet to Daniel, they were the most beautiful numbers he had ever seen.
After finishing all this, Daniel found another open space.
He took out the model of the [Sacred Spring of Rebirth] and held it in his palm.
[Ding! Please confirm use of [Sacred Spring of Rebirth]. Once confirmed, this item can no longer be transferred.]
"Confirm."
Daniel took a deep breath.
[Notice: You have used [Sacred Spring of Rebirth]!]
The instant the model landed on the ground, brilliant golden light erupted.

A gigantic pool rose from the earth amid the radiance. Its walls were built from luminous white jade, and ancient runes were carved all across them. At the bottom of the pool, one could vaguely see some kind of formation slowly revolving.
However, the pool itself was completely empty.
Not a single drop of spring water could be found within.
To make it truly operate, materials were required!
And at present, the only way to obtain those materials was...
Slaying gods!
Daniel knew what this Sacred Spring of Rebirth represented.
It would be the only path for countless players to become gods.
It would be the bridge for all powerful humans to cross that heavenly chasm.
It concerned the future of everyone.
After arranging both the World Tree and the Sacred Spring of Rebirth, Daniel returned to the Polaris District.
For the first time since becoming the Lord of Worlds, he issued a world announcement.
[World Announcement: Player "Faustus" has opened partial access permissions to the [Aerial Realm]!]
[This access is currently limited to players from World Zone No. 616 and the Polaris District!]
[[Aerial Realm] is an independent world. Players may obtain abundant rewards within. Begin your adventure in another world!]
The moment the announcement appeared, the entire world erupted.
An independent world!
A brand-new map!
No, wait.
Had powerhouse Faustus already become powerful to this extent?
He could even produce an independent world and open it up for players to explore?
The only issue was that the allocation of access rights made players from other regions so envious that their teeth itched.
But what could they do?
Faustus came from World Zone No. 616. It was only natural for him to take care of his own people.
They could only protest weakly.
" powerhouse Faustus, don’t forget us players from other regions! (pitiful face)"
"Ahhh, another world! I really want to go see it!"
"So what we’re saying is... there’ll still be a chance for us in the future, right? I’m going crazy wanting to visit the new map!"
"No, seriously, now I want to transfer World Zones again. I’m so pissed off, stuck in the same world as a bunch of idiots all day..."
"Person upstairs, want to meet offline and have a chat?"
Meanwhile, the players of World Zone No. 616 and the Polaris District had completely exploded with excitement.
Another new world!
What kind of world would it be?
Toward the unknown, humanity had always been filled with curiosity and longing.
And the spirit of adventure had always been a faith engraved in human bones and blood.
"I dare swear on my staff that this new map has probably long since been firmly held in powerhouse Faustus’s grasp!"
"Do you even need to bet on that? Since powerhouse is willing to open the passage for us, that world must already be in his pocket. What, do you think the system is opening the door for us?"
"Invincible. As expected of powerhouse Faustus, the Legendary-grade existence walking among players!"
"I’m really curious. What kind of scenery does that new map have? Is it an ancient primeval forest, a savage wilderness, or countless floating islands?"
"Who knows? Instead of thinking about it so much, why not go explore it yourself?"

"Exactly. In any case, we’re all stuck on class change trials right now. This is the perfect chance to go there and broaden our horizons... Maybe we’ll even find some secret treasure or divine artifact."
During this period, the speed at which players improved their strength had exceeded everyone’s expectations.
Daniel saw it all clearly.
In his previous lives, at this point in time, mainstream players were still struggling in the level 100 quagmire.
But now?

The players had never experienced the collective level loss caused by the World War, and they also had a leveling artifact like the [Phantom Emporium] supporting them. Their growth environment could practically be called invincible.
On top of that, Daniel spared no effort in supporting the guild players...
The warehouse was piled full of top-tier equipment and skill books, while the bank held a constant stream of financial support.
The players’ growth speed was astonishingly fast.
At present, aside from Daniel, who stood far ahead of everyone else at level 200, mainstream players had generally already crossed the level 100 threshold!
Of course, while some hidden classes granted players formidable strength, they also brought with them the most difficult quests at the highest level.
On the other hand, the class change quests for ordinary classes were simpler, so those players actually leveled up faster.
But once they reached the level 100 threshold, the difficulty of their quests suddenly rose by a huge margin.
Large numbers of players were stuck on their class change quests, caught in a dilemma where they could neither advance nor retreat.
For Daniel to open access to the Aerial Realm at this moment—
The timing was perfect!

chapters.title: Chapter 200 -200-The Man with the Greatsword, Ancestor of the Human Race
paragraphs: Allowing players to come into contact with the Aerial Realm was only the first stage of Daniel’s plan.
In the future, he would certainly have the players build, develop, and manage this world, turning the Aerial Realm into a true territory belonging to the human race!
He summoned the executives under his command and gave them instructions one by one.
The main focus was to guard against the possible descent of the Godkin, as well as the follow-up arrangements for the Aerial Realm.
Only after everything had been explained did Daniel finally take out that instance scroll.
[Flame of Heritage (Special Instance)] (Exclusive to Faustus)
This was a rather special exclusive instance scroll.
Only he could use it.
The name of the new version was [Flame of Heritage].
And the name of this instance was also [Flame of Heritage]!
There had to be countless connections between the two.
And Kelly had mysteriously disappeared precisely when this version was opened.
Daniel looked forward to finding, within this instance, the answers that had been buried beneath the dust of time.
He lowered his gaze slightly and murmured in a low voice.
"Heritage flame..."
"When the firewood burns out, the flame is passed on. What burns is only withered, decaying wood, but that leaping light shall cross over ash and dust to illuminate the endless long night."
The shell would decay.
Flesh and blood would wither.
But that will, that cluster of flame passed from hand to hand by countless people, would never be extinguished!
This—
Was the meaning of heritage flame!
Thinking of this, Daniel pressed his fingertip against the scroll.
[Ding! You have used the special instance [Flame of Heritage]!]
[Notice: You are about to witness a piece of history sealed away for one hundred thousand years.]
Whoosh—!
His figure abruptly vanished.
Daniel’s vision blurred in an instant, then became clear again a moment later.
He found himself suspended in a vast and boundless void.
Beneath his feet, countless living worlds were spread out densely like grains of sand in a desert, flickering with lights both bright and dim.
Those worlds of life that had once seemed so vast and immeasurable in his eyes now appeared as tiny as specks of dust.
Billions upon billions of worlds lay beneath his feet.
At this moment, it was as though he stood from the perspective of a creator, overlooking the entire structure of existence.
Then, he saw that river.
It was an immense river stretching across heaven and earth, surging from an unknowable origin toward an unknowable end.
It encircled the entire "desert," embracing countless worlds within its flow.
The river water was not made of water.
Instead, it was woven from countless specks of light, fragments, and illusory shadows...
Those were the remnants of time, the trajectories of fate, the complete imprints of countless living beings from birth to death.
The Time River!
Daniel instinctively held his breath.
Just then, a figure walked over from the depths of the void.
It was a powerful figure dressed in ragged clothes.
He carried a massive battle axe on his back. The axe blade was covered in chips and cracks, as though it had endured countless brutal battles.
His body was riddled with wounds. Golden blood seeped from every injury, yet he kept his head raised and trudged forward step by difficult step.
Countless streaks of sword light circled around him like a swarm of bloodthirsty sharks, frantically tearing into his body.
Every time a sword fell, another wound appeared on him.
But the moment that wound appeared, it healed at a speed visible to the naked eye...
Healing, then being torn open again.
Then healing again.
The cycle repeated endlessly.
It was an unimaginable torment.
Yet he did not even furrow his brow.
Daniel’s eyes widened.
That man with the greatsword...
He was crossing the Time River!
A being capable of stepping into the Time River, even if only by a single step, had already reached a height that countless powerhouses could never hope to attain in their entire lives.
Yet this man was actually crossing the entire long river.
Who exactly was he?
The moment the greatsword man crossed the long river, his body suddenly shrank, vanishing into that star sea like a speck of dust.
Daniel’s perspective shifted along with him, and he too plunged into that vast sea of worlds.
He saw the greatsword man stagger into a certain starry expanse.
At the center of that starry sky floated a barren star region.
There were no living beings there.
No light.
Only endless deathly silence and cold.
The greatsword man suddenly opened his palm.
Countless living beings flew out from his hand...
Men, women, elders, children—densely packed together, like people who had been imprisoned for many years and had finally waited until the moment their cage door opened.
Daniel’s pupils abruptly contracted.
Humans!
Those humans looked around in confusion, their faces filled with fear and exhaustion.
Some sobbed quietly.
Some tightly held the loved ones beside them.
Some collapsed onto the ground, as though they no longer even had the strength to stand.
"Your Majesty, are you all right?"
An old man asked in a trembling voice, his eyes full of concern.
"Your Majesty, have we... escaped?"
Another young man raised his head and looked at this unfamiliar starry sky, the terror of having survived a catastrophe still lingering in his eyes.
The greatsword man took a deep breath, his gaze sweeping over every person present.
On that face carved full of traces by war and time, a faint smile appeared.
"For now, we have escaped."
His voice was hoarse, yet it carried a Strength that put people at ease.
"But the enemy may catch up at any moment."
He paused, his gaze becoming deep.
"You will settle down here first. I am going back."
The moment those words came out, the crowd erupted.
"Your Majesty, you cannot go!"
"Your Majesty, if you go back, we fear you will never return!"
"Let us fight alongside you, Your Majesty! Even if we die, we will die before you do!"
The greatsword man raised a hand, suppressing every voice.
His gaze became sharp, like a blade drawn from its sheath.
"No."
His voice was not loud, but every word was iron.
"There is no need to speak further of how powerful the enemy is. It does not matter if I die, but our race must not perish."
The crowd fell silent.
Some lowered their heads.
Some clenched their fists.
Some wept without a sound.
After a long while, a young voice rang out from within the crowd. It trembled, yet every word was incomparably clear.
"Your Majesty, what if... you never return?"
The greatsword man froze for an instant.
Then he smiled.
That smile was calm and open, as though he were merely stating the most ordinary fact.
"Then I will not return."
He looked around at everyone, his voice low and firm.
"If I die, all of you can live on properly."
"If I do not die, this war will never end."
He raised his head and looked toward the boundless darkness beyond the river of stars. There was no fear in his eyes, only absolute resolve.
"You must live well."
As his words fell, he reached out and covered his left eye.
Then, he dug it out with a violent motion.
Blood splattered!
When his hand withdrew from his eye socket, resting in his palm was an object glowing with faint golden light...
A gemstone?
The gemstone was crystal clear. Within it, it seemed as though a river of stars was flowing, and it emitted an aura that made one’s heart tremble.
"With this supreme treasure as an offering, you will surely be able to find a settlement in this star sea world."
He had actually transformed his own eye into a gemstone!
And all for the sake of allowing his people to exchange it for a place where they could stand and survive.
The human powerhouse took the gemstone with trembling hands, shaking so badly he could barely hold it.
They knew His Majesty had already made up his mind.
Rustle—
Countless humans knelt in unison, their heads lowered. Their voices surged like mountains roaring and seas crashing.
"Farewell, Your Majesty!"
"Farewell, Your Majesty!"
The greatsword man turned around resolutely.
His clothes were ragged.
His body was covered in wounds.
He held his head high and stood tall...
And just like that, he stepped onto the road back.
He walked out of the star region.
He crossed that Time River stretching across all eternity.
Even if he would never return!
